papers.title: Spatial assessment of land suitability for aquaculture in the Tena River basin, Napo‐Ecuador
papers.authors: Villacis, Blanca; Rojas, Byron Maza; Rodes‐Blanco, Marina; Celi, Jorge
papers.journal: Journal of the World Aquaculture Society
papers.abstract: Abstract Aquaculture in the Tena River Basin (Ecuador) is a key contributor to the local economy and food security; however, it also poses environmental risks, including water pollution and the decline of native species. This highlights the need for land‐use planning to identify suitable areas for its development, considering environmental, socioeconomic, and legal criteria. In this research, geographic information systems (GIS) and the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) were used to identify suitable areas for aquaculture. Two sub‐models representing five environmental criteria and four socioeconomic criteria were weighted and integrated. Risk and restriction criteria were also considered to protect the water resource and conservation areas of the basin. The results of the final suitability model identified that 1512 ha (6%) corresponds to suitable areas, 8283 ha (34%) moderately suitable, and 3381 ha (14%) unsuitable. The remaining area of 10.923 ha (45%) of the basin consists of sites where aquaculture cannot be carried out. Model validation using the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve yielded an area under the curve (AUC) value of 0.76, indicating an acceptable predictive performance. These findings provide a robust spatial framework that can guide local decision‐makers in strategically planning and regulating aquaculture activities to balance economic benefits with environmental sustainability and conservation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在通过土地利用规划识别厄瓜多尔Tena河流域适宜水产养殖的区域，综合考虑环境、社会经济和法律标准。采用GIS与层次分析法（AHP）构建两个子模型，分别整合五项环境标准和四项社会经济标准，并纳入风险与限制性标准以保护水资源和保护区。结果表明，流域内适宜养殖面积1512 ha（6%），中等适宜8283 ha（34%），不适宜3381 ha（14%），其余45%（10923 ha）不可开展养殖。ROC曲线验证AUC值为0.76，模型预测性能可接受，可为当地决策者规划与调控水产养殖提供空间框架。

papers.title: Distribution and habitat occurrence of flying fish (Exocoetidae) along a longitudinal gradient in the Southeast Pacific Ocean
papers.authors: Portflitt‐Toro, Matías; Serratosa, Juan; Luna, Nicolás; Luna‐Jorquera, Guillermo
papers.abstract: Abstract We characterized the distribution and relative density of flying fish across the Salas & Gómez, Nazca and Juan Fernández ridges to evaluate their relationship with key oceanographic variables using standardized visual strip‐transect surveys. Our results show that flying fish have a highly restricted distribution, occurring mainly in warm, oligotrophic waters, with peak densities concentrated around the Salas & Gómez Ridge. These observations offer new insight into the environmental constraints shaping Exocoetidae distribution, underscoring the need for further research on this family in the Southeast Pacific.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过标准化目视条带样带调查，描述了飞鱼（Exocoetidae）在东南太平洋Salas & Gómez、Nazca和Juan Fernández海脊沿经度梯度的分布与相对密度，并评估其与关键海洋学变量的关系。结果显示飞鱼分布高度受限，主要出现于温暖贫营养水域，密度峰值集中于Salas & Gómez海脊周边。研究揭示了塑造Exocoetidae分布的环境约束因素，强调需在东南太平洋对该科开展进一步研究。

papers.title: Oceanographic Variability Constrains Recovery of Overexploited Cod and Haddock on the Faroe Bank: Evidence for Environmental Recovery Windows at Low Stock Size
papers.authors: Salter, Ian; Hansen, Bogi; Hátun, Hjálmar; Vang, Helga Bára Mohr; Steingrund, Petur; Eliasen, Sólvá Káradóttir; Danielsen, Jóhannis; Gaard, Eilif; Eriksdóttir, Guðrið; Jacobsen, Sólvá
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT In a changing global ocean certain fish populations are approaching the upper limits of their thermal tolerance. Understanding how a warming climate and plankton dynamics affect stock recovery is thus a central challenge for fisheries management. Here we use the Faroe Bank ecosystem in the northeast Atlantic as a climate‐sensitive case study to investigate how environmental variability influences recovery of demersal fish stocks following overexploitation. Atlantic cod ( Gadus morhua ) and haddock ( Melanogrammus aeglefinus ) on the Faroe Bank declined rapidly after 2003, collapsed in 2005 and remained in a prolonged low‐abundance state until 2018–2020, despite a commercial fishing moratorium implemented in 2008. Using ~25 years of fisheries, biological and oceanographic observations, we evaluate environmental factors associated with this delayed recovery. Initial stock collapse was driven by heavy exploitation, whereas the prolonged low‐abundance state appears to have been reinforced by depensatory dynamics under relatively warm and less productive ecosystem conditions. Stock recovery began only when spring bottom temperatures declined in 2015–2016, coinciding with increased phytoplankton productivity, improved 0‐group fish growth and the return of sandeel ( Ammodytes spp.). We identify two interacting environmental bottlenecks limiting recovery at low abundance: (i) relatively warm and low‐productivity conditions limiting pelagic 0‐group growth and survival and (ii) temperature‐productivity constraints on 0‐group sandeel abundance reducing the availability of a key lipid‐rich prey resource for recovering stocks. The resurgence of 0‐group sandeel preceded increases in adult cod and haddock biomass and coincided with cooler, more productive conditions associated with variability in the subpolar gyre. These results suggest that the success of management actions to rebuild chronically depleted stocks can depend on “environmental recovery windows”, when reduced fishing pressure coincides with favourable temperature and trophic conditions. The Faroe Bank ecosystem therefore demonstrates how modest climatic variability can strongly influence stock rebuilding, with important implications for ecosystem‐based fisheries management under continued ocean warming.
papers.summary_cn: 研究利用法罗群岛浅滩约25年的渔业、生物与海洋学观测数据，探讨过度捕捞后大西洋鳕（Gadus morhua）和黑线鳕（Melanogrammus aeglefinus）种群长期低迷及延迟恢复的环境机制。结果显示，初始种群崩溃由高强度捕捞驱动，而2005年后持续低丰度状态在偏暖、低生产力条件下被depensatory dynamics强化，尽管2008年已实施商业禁渔。恢复仅在2015–2016年春季底层水温下降、浮游植物生产力上升、0-group生长改善及玉筋鱼（Ammodytes spp.）回归后启动，表明低 stock size 下存在温度—生产力双重环境瓶颈。研究提出“environmental recovery windows”概念，即减捕措施需与有利温度和营养条件叠加方能奏效，对变暖背景下基于生态系统的渔业管理具有启示意义。

papers.title:
Comparison of
                    <scp>EBER</scp>
                    flow
                    <scp>FISH</scp>
                    results from two facilities
papers.authors: Nishimura, Madoka; Tomomasa, Dan; Watanabe, Eri; Tsuchiya, Kazumi; Sato, Natsuko; Takachi, Takayuki; Imai, Kohsuke; Akiyama, Hiroki; Ueki, Masahiro; Yoshifuji, Kota
papers.abstract: Abstract Epstein–Barr virus (EBV) primarily infects B cells but can occasionally target T and/or NK cells, leading to chronic active EBV disease or EBV‐associated hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, which are often difficult to treat. EBV‐associated diseases exhibit a wide range of phenotypes. EBV‐infected cells play a major role in pathogenesis, making their identification essential for diagnosis. EBV‐encoded small RNA (EBER) flow fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH), combined with multicolor flow cytometry, allows highly sensitive detection of EBV‐infected cells, even from limited samples. However, EBER flow FISH is labor‐intensive and requires technical expertise, limiting its use in standard facilities. We investigated whether the technique used in our department could be successfully implemented in other facilities. We performed EBER flow FISH at our department (Facility A) on cryopreserved peripheral blood mononuclear cell samples from seven patients diagnosed with EBV‐associated diseases. The same assay was then conducted at Facility B, and results were compared for cell populations and the frequency of EBER‐positive cells within each population. Significant correlations were observed between facilities for both cell fraction proportions and the proportion of EBER‐positive cells. Among data points where both facilities detected ≥5% EBER‐positive cells, 6 of 8 data points (75%) were within the acceptance interval of ±20%. Although one patient with very low proportions of EBER‐positive cells showed inconsistent findings, overall results did not differ significantly between facilities. Although further validation in larger multicenter studies is required, these findings suggest preliminary interlaboratory comparability and support the potential transferability of EBER flow FISH across institutions.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究比较了两个实验室开展EBER flow FISH检测EBV感染细胞的结果一致性，以评估该技术在不同机构间推广的可行性。研究对7例EBV相关疾病患者的冻存外周血单个核细胞样本在A、B两个实验室分别进行EBER flow FISH检测，比较各细胞亚群比例及EBER阳性细胞频率。结果显示两机构间细胞组分比例及EBER阳性细胞比例均呈显著相关，在双方均检出≥5% EBER阳性细胞的8个数据点中有6个（75%）落在±20%的可接受区间内。尽管1例EBER阳性细胞比例极低的患者结果不一致，总体结果无显著差异，提示该技术具有初步的实验室间可比性和跨机构转移潜力。

papers.title: Corrigendum to “Drivers of bull shark (Carcharhinus leucas) occurrence in nearshore waters: Insights from the Queensland Shark Control Program, Australia” [Fish. Res. 303 (2026) 107882]
papers.authors: Banaghan, Riley W.; Levengood, Alexis L.; Holmes, Bonnie J.
papers.summary_cn: 该文为对原文的更正说明，原文研究基于澳大利亚昆士兰鲨鱼控制计划（Queensland Shark Control Program）数据，分析公牛鲨（Carcharhinus leucas）近岸水域出现规律的驱动因素。更正内容未提供摘要，具体修正信息需参见原文。

papers.title: Effects of waterborne exposure to crude mulberry leaf polysaccharides on lipopolysaccharide-induced acute inflammatory responses in gibel carp (Carassius gibelio): insights into host immune and intestinal responses
papers.authors: Fei, Xintong; Xie, Xinyi; Tarique, Imran; Liu, Xiuhong; Fang, Xingxing; Yang, Ping
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以异育银鲫（Carassius gibelio）为对象，探讨水体暴露桑叶粗多糖对LPS诱导急性炎症反应的调节作用，并从宿主免疫与肠道响应角度分析其机制。

papers.title: Comparative analysis of immune responses reveals mechanisms underlying different susceptibility to Cryptocaryon irritans in large yellow croaker (Larimichthys crocea) and red sea bream (Pagrus major)
