papers.title: Publicly available neural network services in fisheries research: applications and limitations
papers.authors: Fedoseeva, E. A.; Sitova, M. V.; Terpugova, N. Yu.
papers.abstract: The potential of publicly available neural network services for fisheries research is considered. Using the authors’ research materials, their application for information retrieval and systematization, verification of source tables, calculations, data visualization, and preliminary analysis of histological images is demonstrated. The most reliable applications are those whose results can be directly verified against the source data. As tasks shift towards biological interpretation, expert assessment and verification of the generated conclusions become increasingly important.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨了公开可用神经网络服务在渔业研究中的应用潜力与局限。基于作者自身研究材料，展示了其在信息检索与系统化、源表格核验、计算、数据可视化及组织学图像初步分析中的实际应用。结果表明，结果可直接对照源数据验证的应用最为可靠；随着任务向生物学解释层面延伸，专家评估与对生成结论的核验愈发重要。

papers.title: Web-based Direct-to-Consumer Marketplace for Small-Scale Fisheries Products: Rapid Application Development and Functional Evaluation in Jaring Halus Village, Langkat, Indonesia
papers.authors: Supiyandi, Supiyandi; Mailok, Ramlah Binti; Herdianto, Herdianto
papers.journal: International Journal of Engineering, Science and Information Technology
papers.abstract: Fishery and micro-enterprise products in Jaring Halus Village, Langkat Regency, Indonesia, are sold primarily within the village through face-to-face transactions and manual record keeping. This condition limits producers’ market reach to physically present consumers and provides no persistent transaction data for monitoring or business development. Previous studies on digital technology in small-scale fisheries have focused largely on catch recording and traceability, while applied marketplace development studies rarely describe their evaluation scope with sufficient precision to support replication. This study designs, develops, and functionally evaluates a web-based direct-to-consumer marketplace to address this gap. The system was developed using the Rapid Application Development model, with requirements elicited from fishers, sellers, and prospective buyers through interviews and observations, followed by public deployment. The marketplace integrates account management, product catalogue administration with stock and discount attributes, shopping cart and order management, delegated electronic payment settlement, and content management. Functional performance was evaluated using black-box testing across eight interface areas involving seventeen test cases. All test cases produced results consistent with their specified requirements. Partition analysis showed that eleven test cases exercised valid input classes, while six addressed invalid input classes. Four interface areas contained no invalid-input test cases, and the content-management module was not covered by the testing process. The study contributes a transferable reference architecture for direct-to-consumer fisheries marketplaces in low-connectivity rural environments, a traceable requirement-to-test structure, and prioritized recommendations based on identified testing gaps. The evidence is limited to functional conformance; therefore, usability, technology acceptance, user satisfaction, and economic outcomes were not measured and are not claimed. The findings provide a foundation for subsequent evaluation and iterative improvement of digital marketplaces for rural fishery micro-enterprises
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对印度尼西亚Langkat县Jaring Halus村小规模渔业产品仅限村内面对面交易、缺乏交易数据的问题，采用Rapid Application Development模型，基于渔民、卖家和潜在买家的需求设计并开发了一个面向消费者的渔业产品直销网络市场平台，集成账户管理、产品目录与库存管理、购物车与订单管理、电子支付结算及内容管理等功能。通过覆盖8个界面区域、17个测试用例的黑盒测试进行功能评估，所有用例结果均符合既定需求，但4个界面区域缺少无效输入测试用例，内容管理模块未被测试覆盖。研究为低连通性农村环境下的渔业直销市场提供了可迁移的参考架构和可追溯的需求—测试结构，但评估仅限于功能符合性，未涉及可用性、技术接受度及经济效果。

papers.title: Emerging Artificial Intelligence Applications in Capture Fisheries Monitoring and Assessment: A Bibliometric and Synthesis Review
papers.authors: Patangngari, Fijwal; Musbir, Musbir; Najamuddin; Putra, Chi
papers.journal: New Zealand Journal of Marine and Freshwater Research
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used to monitor and assess capture fisheries, addressing persistent limitations of conventional observation systems that are labor‐intensive, costly, and difficult to scale. Despite rapid technological expansion, AI development in this field remains fragmented, limiting a comprehensive understanding of its structure and direction. This study aimed to map the development, intellectual structure, and thematic evolution of AI research in capture fisheries monitoring and assessment through a bibliometric and synthesis‐based review of Scopus‐indexed literature (2015–2026). Following a documented, large language model‐assisted screening protocol with human verification, a final corpus of 495 journal articles was analyzed using an integrated bibliometric and science‐mapping workflow. Results showed a marked, near‐exponential increase in publication output after 2020. Rather than confirming a pre‐defined three‐domain structure, keyword co‐occurrence analysis revealed that the field's thematic organization follows technical task type (detection, classification, and operational/vessel management) more closely than application domain, with acoustic AI failing to form an independent thematic cluster and representing the smallest share of the corpus (8.1%), behind visual AI (44.0%) and vessel monitoring (28.9%). For synthesis, we nonetheless compare the field across three functional categories visual AI for fish detection and measurement, vessel monitoring using AIS/VMS data, and acoustic survey support finding that the field is methodologically converging around a shared AI/ML toolkit while remaining largely siloed at the technical‐application level. Although research productivity remains heavily concentrated in China (85.9% of records) and international collaboration is limited (23.64%), the field is moving beyond isolated proof‐of‐concept studies toward more operational, management‐relevant applications. Overall, this study provides an evidence‐grounded, rather than assumed, understanding of how AI research in capture fisheries is thematically structured, and identifies acoustic AI and cross‐domain integration as priority areas for future development toward fisheries‐oriented, evidence‐based management.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究通过文献计量与综述方法，基于Scopus数据库2015–2026年495篇期刊论文，绘制了AI在捕捞渔业监测与评估中的研究结构与发展脉络。结果显示2020年后发文量近指数增长，主题组织更倾向于按技术任务类型（检测、分类、运营/船舶管理）而非应用领域划分，声学AI未形成独立主题簇且占比最小（8.1%），远低于视觉AI（44.0%）和船舶监测（28.9%）。研究在方法上趋于共享AI/ML工具集，但技术-应用层面仍呈孤岛状态，且研究产出高度集中于中国（85.9%），国际合作有限（23.64%）。该研究为理解AI在捕捞渔业中的主题结构提供了循证基础，并指出声学AI与跨领域整合为未来优先发展方向。

papers.title: Problems and prospects of ensuring Russia’s food security by means of fisheries
papers.authors: Vasiliev, A. M.; Lisunova, E. A.
papers.abstract: The article examines the role of fisheries in ensuring the food security of the Russian Federation in modern geopolitical conditions. The analysis of the implementation of the provisions of the Food Security Doctrine 2010-2019 and 2020-2024 based on the indicators of production, export, import and consumption of fish products. It has been revealed that with a high level of self-sufficiency, a significant part of the caught aquatic biological resources is exported, which limits the availability of domestic fish products for the country’s population. It has been established that the current model of export-oriented development of the fishing industry does not fully contribute to achieving the goals of increasing domestic fish consumption. The necessity of improving the mechanisms of regulation of the domestic market, optimizing export policy and increasing the economic accessibility of fish products for the population is substantiated. The proposed directions for improving the food security system will contribute to an increase in fish consumption and strengthen the sustainable development of the Russian fisheries sector.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究分析俄罗斯渔业在保障国家粮食安全中的作用，基于2010–2019年及2020–2024年粮食安全学说的产量、进出口和消费指标评估其落实情况。研究发现，尽管自给率较高，大部分捕捞水生生物资源用于出口，限制了国内居民对本国鱼产品的可获得性。出口导向型渔业发展模式未能充分实现提升国内鱼类消费的目标，作者据此提出需完善国内市场调控机制、优化出口政策并提高鱼产品经济可及性。

papers.title: Bigeye tuna (Thunnus obsus) in the Atlantic Ocean: stock recovery, challenges, FAD fisheries and prospects for Russia
papers.authors: Chur, V. N.
papers.abstract: Bigeye tuna (Thunnus obesus) is one of the key targets of tropical fishing. The article analyzes the current state of the Atlantic stock based on data from ICCAT (2025–2026) and ISSF (2026). The stock is recovering: the ratio of spawning biomass to SSBMSY is 1.22, and the fishing mortality is 0.59 of FMSY. The stock status is stable (“green zone”). The estimated MSY is 86,000 tons; the actual catch in 2024 was 55,000 tons; the TAC for 2025 has been set at 73,000 tons. The main problem is the high catch of juveniles in purse-seine fishing using floating fish attractants (FADs), which leads to a decline in population productivity. A strategy has been proposed for Russia: to develop longline fishing, cooperate with African states, and strengthen scientific participation in ICCAT.
papers.summary_cn: 大眼金枪鱼（Thunnus obesus）是大西洋热带渔业的重要目标种。基于ICCAT（2025–2026）和ISSF（2026）数据，当前种群处于恢复状态：产卵生物量与SSBMSY之比为1.22，捕捞死亡率为FMSY的0.59，处于稳定“绿区”；MSY估计为8.6万吨，2024年实际产量5.5万吨，2025年TAC设定为7.3万吨。主要问题是围网FAD渔业幼鱼兼捕量高，导致种群生产力下降。研究建议俄罗斯发展延绳钓渔业、与非洲国家合作并加强在ICCAT中的科学参与。

papers.title: ORGANOCHLORINE PESTICIDE RESIDUES IN FISH AND DAM WATER FROM OGBOMOSO, SOUTHWESTERN NIGERIA: SPATIAL DISTRIBUTION AND MATRIX-DEPENDENT CONTAMINATION
papers.authors: T. O. OLALEYE; K O. ADELASOYE; A. OLAYIOYE; O. J. OJO; J. O. GBADEGESIN
papers.journal: International Journal of Agricultural and Veterinary Science
papers.abstract: This study assessed pesticide residues in water and Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) from Ogbomoso Waterworks and Papa Abede Waterworks dams in Ogbomoso, Oyo State, Nigeria, focusing on their occurrence, concentrations, spatial distribution and compliance with applicable residue limits. Water samples were randomly collected from different sections of the waterbodies, while sixteen fish specimens were obtained, comprising six from each study dam and two from each of two privately managed control water bodies. Fish muscle tissues were extracted using the QuEChERS method, and pesticide residues were identified and quantified using gas chromatography–mass spectrometry (GC–MS). Data were analysed using descriptive statistics and analysis of variance, with Duncan’s Multiple Range Test applied at a 5% significance level. The results revealed organochlorine, organophosphate, carbamate and pyrethroid pesticide residues in the sampled water and fish. Among the organochlorines, p,p′-DDT recorded 3.60 mg/l in Ogbomoso Waterworks water and 0.64 mg/l in Papa Abede Waterworks water, while concentrations in fish were 0.73 and 0.75 mg/kg, respectively. The concentration of p,p′-DDD in water reached 2.34 mg/l. Among the organophosphates, dimethoate recorded 2.74 mg/l in water, while dichlorvos reached 2.61 mg/l in Ogbomoso Waterworks water and 0.86 mg/kg in fish from the same location. Carbaryl recorded 1.59 mg/l in water, whereas permethrin reached 0.69 mg/l in Ogbomoso Waterworks water. Overall, Ogbomoso Waterworks generally exhibited higher pesticide-residue concentrations than Papa Abede Waterworks, while the control locations recorded comparatively lower concentrations for many compounds. Statistical comparisons showed variations among compounds, locations and sample types, although not all differences were statistically significant. Comparison with the applicable benchmarks adopted in the study indicated that several residues exceeded the relevant limits, suggesting contamination of the investigated aquatic environments and non-compliance with applicable maximum residue limits in affected fish samples. The study recommends routine pesticide-residue monitoring, improved pesticide application practices and measures to minimise agricultural runoff into water bodies. The findings provide baseline information for environmental management and food-safety monitoring in Ogbomoso, Nigeria.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了尼日利亚Ogbomoso两座水坝水体及尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）肌肉中有机氯等农药残留的发生、浓度、空间分布及限量合规性，采用QuEChERS法提取并结合GC–MS定量。结果显示，p,p′-DDT在水体中最高达3.60 mg/L、鱼体中为0.73–0.75 mg/kg，乐果、敌敌畏、西维因和氯菊酯等亦有检出，Ogbomoso Waterworks残留浓度总体高于Papa Abede Waterworks，对照水体较低。多种残留超出相关限量标准，表明水体受到污染且部分鱼样不符合最大残留限量要求，建议开展常规农药残留监测并控制农业径流输入。

papers.title: From Fish-Landing Inventories to Microplastic Monitoring: Development of a Proposed Surveillance Protocol for Pasacao, Philippines
papers.authors: Paz Oliver, Rowelyn Jaudian
papers.journal: International Journal of Modern Science and Research Technology
papers.abstract: Background: Fish-landing inventories may provide an entry point for local microplastic monitoring, but their suitability depends on traceable sampling and analytical quality assurance. Objective: To assess the documentation readiness of a Pasacao, Camarines Sur fish-landing study and specify a prospective microplastic surveillance protocol. Methods: A revision-stage documentary appraisal of a 2026 graduate thesis examined its species inventory, landing-site sampling description, laboratory procedures and supporting appendices. Source statements were classified by documentary status and mapped to requirements for repeatability, biological replication, contamination control, polymer confirmation and reporting. No new field or laboratory observations were generated. Results: The source reported 17 landed taxa, provisional feeding-guild labels and chemical analysis involving three selected taxa. Although composite preparation was specified, the accessible records did not establish the numbers of independently processed samples. Fish-capture provenance, sampling denominators and particle-level confirmation remained incompletely reported. The proposed architecture differentiates Tier A landing registration and biological sampling, Tier B1 laboratory screening and quality control, and Tier B2 spectroscopic confirmation. A prospective pilot-evaluation matrix specifies coverage, workload, cost, recovery, reproducibility and reporting performance. Conclusion: The inventory can inform protocol design but cannot establish monitoring feasibility, geographic contamination levels or feeding-guild differences. Prospective assessment is required before routine adoption.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究通过文献审查评估菲律宾Pasacao鱼上岸调查的记录完备性，并据此提出微塑料监测方案框架。审查发现源研究记录了17个上岸分类单元及3个分类单元的化学分析，但独立处理样本数、鱼类捕获来源和颗粒级确证等信息报告不完整。提出的监测架构分为Tier A上岸登记与生物采样、Tier B1实验室筛查与质量控制、Tier B2光谱确证三个层级，并设计了涵盖覆盖率、工作量、成本、回收率、可重复性和报告性能的试点评估矩阵。结论认为该上岸清单可为方案设计提供参考，但尚不能确立监测可行性、地理污染水平或摄食 guild 差异，常规采用前需开展前瞻性评估。

papers.title: A sequential H₂O₂–KOH digestion protocol for microplastic extraction from cured fish matrices: development, optimization and validation
papers.authors: Mohamed, Aslam; Martin Xavier, K. A.; Ngasotter, Soibam; Lukose, Jijo; Sunil, Megha; Nair, Midhun M.; Zynudheen, A. A.
papers.abstract: Abstract Reliable isolation of microplastics (MPs) from cured fish products remains challenging because their complex matrices, characterized by high lipid, protein, salt, and mineral contents, hinder organic matter digestion and compromise polymer recovery. In this study, a sequential hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂)–potassium hydroxide (KOH) digestion protocol was developed and optimized for efficient MPs extraction from diverse cured fish matrices. A preliminary evaluation of different H₂O₂:KOH ratios identified 30:70 (v/v) as the optimum reagent combination, while Response Surface Methodology (RSM) coupled with a Central Composite Design optimized digestion temperature and reagent volume. The developed quadratic models showed high predictive performance (R² = 0.9515 for digestion efficiency and R² = 0.9785 for filtration time) with non-significant lack-of-fit. The optimum conditions (60 °C and 36.39 mL g⁻¹ reagent volume) achieved 99.33% digestion efficiency and a filtration time of 11.33 s. The optimized protocol was subsequently validated using four cured fish matrices with digestion efficiencies exceeding 96%. Micro-Raman spectroscopy confirmed efficient removal of lipid-associated spectral signatures following digestion, while gravimetric measurements, microscopic observations, dimensional analysis, and Raman spectral characterization demonstrated that the optimized sequential H₂O₂–KOH treatment preserved the mass, morphology, size, and chemical integrity of polypropylene, polyethylene, polyvinyl chloride, polyethylene terephthalate, polystyrene, and polyamide particles. The proposed matrix-adapted digestion protocol provides a rapid, reliable, and reproducible approach for MPs isolation from cured fish products and establishes a standardized optimization framework that can facilitate method development for other complex food matrices.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对腌制鱼制品基质复杂、微塑料（MPs）提取困难的问题，开发并优化了H₂O₂–KOH序贯消解方案。通过H₂O₂:KOH配比筛选（最优30:70, v/v）及RSM-CCD优化温度与试剂用量，确定60 °C、36.39 mL g⁻¹为最佳条件，消解效率达99.33%，过滤时间11.33 s。该方案在四种腌制鱼基质中验证消解效率均超过96%，且显微观察、称重与Raman光谱证实六种聚合物（PP、PE、PVC、PET、PS、PA）的质量、形态、尺寸及化学完整性均得以保持。该基质适配型消解方案为腌制鱼制品中MPs的分离提供了快速、可靠且可重复的方法，并为其他复杂食品基质的方法开发建立了标准化优化框架。

papers.title:
Design of Water-Resistant,
Food-Grade Microneedles
for Fish Injection and Underwater Cargo Delivery
papers.authors: Li, Meng; Raad, Jad; Cao, Yunteng; Hu, Yue; Wolfe, Colleen; Kim, Doyoon; Frank, Bradley D.; Wiens, Gregory D.; Marelli, Benedetto
papers.abstract: Abstract Aquatic foods provide around 15% of consumed animal-derived protein worldwide and aquaculture now supplies most of it. But the industry faces significant challenges in disease prevention and excessive use of antimicrobials. Vaccination, particularly for juvenile fish, can mitigate these risks, but manual and automated needle-based vaccination methods are costly, stressful, and labor-intensive. Here, a water-resistant, food-grade microneedle platform is designed to deliver cargos underwater. Silk fibroin-based microneedles are engineered to remain water resistant from minutes to hours in order to penetrate fish skin in wet conditions. To meet the requirements of different underwater applications, three microneedle morphologies─shell, solid-tip, and hollow─are developed, and their different combinations of mechanical integrity, water-resistance performance, cargo compatibility, and release kinetics are studied. The microneedles also preserve the supercoiled conformation of ⩾50% of the loaded pIHNVw-G plasmids─developed to protect fish against infectious hematopoietic necrosis virus─outside the cold chain for 4 weeks under dry conditions. In pilot animal studies, injected microneedles remain attached to zebrafish and juvenile rainbow trout while swimming. Using this food-based microneedle platform, we envision the development of tools for underwater vaccination of juvenile fish that increase aquaculture efficiencies and reduce environmental impact.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究开发了一种防水、食品级微针平台，用于水下鱼体注射和疫苗递送，以应对水产养殖中疾病防控和抗菌药物过度使用的挑战。基于丝素蛋白设计了壳型、实心尖型和中空型三种微针形态，系统评估其机械强度、防水性能、载荷兼容性及释放动力学，微针在湿润条件下可保持数分钟至数小时的防水性以穿透鱼皮。微针在非冷链干燥条件下4周仍能保持≥50%负载pIHNVw-G质粒的超螺旋构象，初步动物实验表明微针注射后可附着于游动的斑马鱼和幼年虹鳟。该平台有望为幼鱼水下疫苗接种提供新工具，提升水产养殖效率并减少环境影响。

papers.title: ORGANOPHOSPHATE PESTICIDES CONTAMINATION AND ASSOCIATED HEALTH RISK IN FISH FROM MAYOKAM, SUNTAI AND RIVER TARABA OF CENTRAL TARABA STATE, NIGERIA
papers.authors: HARUNA IBRAHIM; SANUSI ABUBAKAR
papers.abstract: The study was carried out to assess the level and health risk index of organophosphate in fish species from Mayokam, Suntai and Taraba Rivers. The extraction was performed using Quick, Easy, Cheap, Effective, Rugged and Safe method was used for extraction and Gas Chromatography- Mass spectrometer for the detection of the pesticide residues. The morphometric measurement and condition factor of the fish species were measured and all the fish species had condition factors (K) > 1. The result of the analysis shows that the OPPs residues were detected higher in Mormyrus rume follow by Clarias gariepinus while the Tilapia zilli recorded low concentration. The concentrations were in an increasing order as Chlorpyrifos > Phosphorodithioic acid > Ethoprophos > Disulfoton across the three-sampling locations. The levels of Chlorpyrifos and Phosphorodithioic acid in all three fish species were above the FAO/WHO maximum residue limits (MRL). The result of the health risk assessment shows that 36 % of values obtained had the health index greater than one (HI > 1) which might result in possible carcinogenic health risk. The high levels of these pesticides may pose a great danger in the environment over time. Regular monitoring and regulation are therefore necessary to control the usage of pesticide in Nigeria in order to avoid environmental contamination.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了尼日利亚Taraba州Mayokam、Suntai和Taraba三条河流鱼体中有机磷农药残留水平及健康风险指数。采用QuEChERS法提取、GC-MS检测，并测定鱼类形态学指标与condition factor（均>1）。结果显示，Mormyrus rume残留最高，Clarias gariepinus次之，Tilapia zilli最低；浓度排序为Chlorpyrifos > Phosphorodithioic acid > Ethoprophos > Disulfoton，其中Chlorpyrifos和Phosphorodithioic acid在所有鱼种中均超过FAO/WHO最大残留限量（MRL）。健康风险评估表明36%的HI值>1，存在潜在致癌风险，提示需加强农药使用监管与常规监测。

papers.title: Inter- and intraspecies variation in hypoxia tolerance in lentic and lotic cyprinid fish species
papers.authors: Xiang, Ping; Tang, Yan; Zhang, Na; Zhang, Yong-Fei; Fu, Shi-Jian
papers.abstract: Freshwater habitats display highly diverse flow regimes and oxygen tension (PO2) dynamics, driving lentic and lotic fish to evolve distinct physiological strategies for sustaining oxygen supply capacity (α) under hypoxic stress and high energy demand. We hypothesized associations of α with metabolic traits that differ between lentic and lotic species: lower PO2 thresholds for maximum metabolic rate (MMR) and other physiological functions in lentic fish, and higher MMR and metabolic rate (ṀO2) at given PO2 thresholds in lotic fish. We tested this by comparing MMR, hypoxia tolerance, and hypoxic tissue metabolite responses in the lentic Pseudorasbora parva and lotic Acrossocheilus fasciatus. P. parva had superior hypoxia tolerance (lower PCRIT-MMR, PCRIT and PLOE) via enhanced α, higher liver glycogen, and hypoxia-induced LDH upregulation; while A. fasciatus exhibited higher MMR, matching lotic aerobic demands. Within each species, elevated α correlated with lower PCRIT-MMR, PCRIT and PLOE. Unexpectedly, α was uncorrelated with MMR in both species. Biochemical analyses revealed brain LDH activity as a key determinant of hypoxia tolerance in P. parva, while interorgan transport inefficiency causing brain lactate accumulation and glucose depletion limited hypoxia tolerance in A. fasciatus. These findings demonstrate habitat-associated shifts in physiological and biochemical coping mechanisms, highlighting the complex environment-physiology adaptation interplay rather than categorical divergence.
papers.summary_cn: 研究比较了静水（lentic）鱼类麦穗鱼（Pseudorasbora parva）与流水（lotic）鱼类光唇鱼（Acrossocheilus fasciatus）在低氧耐受性上的种间及种内差异，检验氧供给能力（α）与代谢性状的关联假说。结果显示麦穗鱼通过更高的α、肝糖原储备及低氧诱导的LDH上调表现出更优的低氧耐受性（较低的PCRIT-MMR、PCRIT和PLOE），而光唇鱼具有更高的MMR以匹配流水需氧需求；种内α升高均与低氧耐受性指标改善相关，但α与MMR不相关。生化分析表明，麦穗鱼脑LDH活性是低氧耐受的关键决定因素，而光唇鱼因器官间转运效率不足导致脑乳酸积累和葡萄糖耗竭，限制了其低氧耐受性。

papers.title: Five-year Production and Economic Performance of Composite Carp Polyculture under Smallholder Management in Manipur, Northeast India: Implications for Aquaculture Extension
papers.authors: Soranganba, Ningthoukhongjam; Singh, Kangjam Sonamani; Kumar, Sumit; Chongloi, Khumlo Levish; Roshan, R. K.; Meetei, Kh. Brajamani; Anal, Hmannihring; Pandey, Manoj Kumar; Singh, S. Basanta; Mohanty, A. K.
papers.abstract: Smallholder aquaculture in Northeast India remains substantially below national productivity levels despite abundant freshwater resources, presenting a key opportunity for sustainable intensification aligned with SDGs 1, 2, and 14. This study documents the transition from subsistence monoculture to commercial aquaculture using a composite polyculture system (Indian major carps and grass carp) in Churachandpur district, Manipur. This study documents production metrics, economic returns, and management practices of a composite carp polyculture system (Indian major carps and grass carp) managed by 23 smallholder farmers in Churachandpur district, Manipur, across five consecutive production cycles (2018–2023). Performance was assessed using descriptive statistics, benefit-cost ratio (BCR), ROI, and independent samples t-tests (α = 0.05) against published monoculture baselines (n = 12 reference systems). The polyculture system achieved a mean production of 3,522 kg per cycle, with an average survival rate of 96.5% and a feed conversion ratio of 1.42. Economically, the system generated mean annual net returns of ₹458,160 per hectare with a benefit-cost ratio of 2.82. When compared against published monoculture reference data from South Asian systems, the polyculture demonstrated an estimated 119% higher productivity and approximately 387% greater net return per hectare per cycle (t(15) = 3.62, p = 0.003); these figures reflect comparisons against external literature baselines, not concurrent experimental controls. The significant progressive improvement in economic efficiency across the five years highlights strong learning-by-doing effects. These findings suggest that, with adequate extension support, composite carp polyculture offers considerable potential for sustainable intensification, contributing meaningfully to household livelihood security and rural aquaculture development in the region.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究记录了印度曼尼普尔邦23户小农在2018–2023年五个生产周期内，从自给性单养转向印度主要鲤与草鱼复合混养的生产指标、经济收益与管理实践。系统平均每周期产量3,522 kg，成活率96.5%，饲料转化率1.42，年净收益₹458,160/ha，效益成本比2.82。与已发表南亚单养基线数据比较，混养生产力约高119%、净收益约高387%（t(15)=3.62，p=0.003），且五年间经济效率显著递进提升，体现明显的干中学效应。结果表明，在充足推广支持下，复合鲤混养具备可持续集约化潜力，有助于区域小农生计安全与乡村水产养殖发展。

papers.title: Aquaculture as an engine of economic growth: Evidence from second-generation panel and causality estimations on global aquaculture dynamics
papers.authors: Güreşçi, Gülçin Güreşçi; Çelik, Mehmet Yunus; Sönmez, Adem Yavuz
papers.journal: Ege Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
papers.abstract: This study investigates the impact of aquaculture production on economic growth across the top twenty aquaculture-producing countries for the 2001–2024 period. Accounting for cross-sectional dependence and slope heterogeneity, the study employs second-generation CIPS panel unit root tests, panel VAR Granger causality analysis, and fixed-effects estimation with Driscoll–Kraay robust standard errors. A dynamic panel specification is also employed to assess the robustness of the findings. A dynamic panel specification is also applied for robustness. The empirical findings confirm a strong Granger causality running from aquaculture to economic growth. Panel estimates indicate that a 1% increase in aquaculture output is associated with about 0.14% higher per-capita GDP, while CPI is also positively and significantly associated with GDP. These associations remain robust in the dynamic specification. Overall, the findings highlight aquaculture's vital macroeconomic role and emphasize the need to integrate circular economy principles into sustainable growth strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2001–2024年全球前二十大水产养殖生产国数据，在考虑截面依赖与斜率异质性的基础上，采用第二代CIPS面板单位根检验、面板VAR Granger因果分析和Driscoll–Kraay稳健标准误固定效应估计，并辅以动态面板设定进行稳健性检验。结果证实水产养殖产量对经济增长存在显著的Granger因果关系，养殖产量每增加1%对应人均GDP约提高0.14%，CPI亦与GDP呈显著正相关，且该关联在动态设定下保持稳健。研究凸显了水产养殖的重要宏观经济作用，并强调将循环经济原则纳入可持续增长战略的必要性。

papers.title: Nitrogen Transformation Kinetics of β-Glucan and Nucleotide Supplementation in a Zero-Water-Exchange Aquaculture System
papers.authors: Rahardjo, Seto Sugianto Prabowo; Yuwanita, Rani; Mahariawan, I Made Dedi; Suprastiyani, Heny; Pratiwi, Arum; Ridwanudin, Asep; Hariati, Anik Martinah
papers.abstract: Nitrogen is a major challenge in zero-water-exchange (ZWE) aquaculture systems. This study examined the effects of dietary β-glucan and nucleotides on nitrogen transformation dynamics, oxidative stress responses, and environmental stability in Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus). A 42-day feeding trial was conducted using diets supplemented with β-glucan (βg1 = 1%, βg2 = 2%, βg3 = 3%) and nucleotides (Nt1 = 1%, Nt2 = 2%, Nt3 = 3%). Final fish weight increased from 21.57 g in the control (Ct) to 28.32 g in Nt3. Total nitrogen (TN) derived from cumulative feed input reached 264.08 mg/L in Ct, whereas nucleotide treatments showed lower accumulation. NH4+ peaked between days 10 and 17, reaching 12.38 mg/L in Nt3, while NO2− peaked at 0.240 mg/L in Nt1 and declined to 0.03–0.07 mg/L by day 42. NO3− accumulated continuously to 31.74–51.47 mg/L, with higher concentrations generally observed in nucleotide treatments. Kinetic modeling yielded higher model-derived apparent nitrogen transfer coefficient (ka) in β-glucan treatments (1.287–1.690/day) and higher model-derived apparent nitrite-to-nitrate conversion coefficients (k2) in nucleotide treatments (4.994–5.748/day). Nucleotide supplementation favored apparent nitrite-to-nitrate conversion, whereas β-glucan was associated with greater apparent transfer of ammonia-derived nitrogen toward the modeled residual nitrogen pool.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究在零换水（ZWE）养殖系统中考察饲料添加β-葡聚糖和核苷酸对尼罗罗非鱼氮转化动力学、氧化应激及环境稳定性的影响，开展42天投喂试验。核苷酸组终末体重较高（Nt3组28.32 g vs 对照组21.57 g），且氮累积较低；NH4+于第10–17天达峰，NO2−在第42天降至0.03–0.07 mg/L，NO3−持续累积至31.74–51.47 mg/L。动力学模型显示β-葡聚糖组表观氮转移系数ka较高（1.287–1.690/day），核苷酸组表观亚硝酸盐-硝酸盐转化系数k2较高（4.994–5.748/day），表明核苷酸促进亚硝酸盐向硝酸盐转化，而β-葡聚糖促进氨氮向模型残余氮库转移。

papers.title: Cold stress in fish: global mechanisms, adaptive strategies, and translational solutions for climate-resilient aquaculture
papers.authors: Mwemi, Happiness Moses; Mrope, Peter Alen; Mkulo, Evodia Moses; Iddrisu, Lukman; Amoah, Kwaku; Zhou, Hui; Huang, Jiansheng; Wang, Bei; Li, Jing; Thaimuangphol, Wipavee
papers.abstract: Water temperature is a fundamental abiotic factor that governs fish physiology, behavior, and survival. Although anthropogenic climate change is characterized by long-term warming and an overall decline in the frequency and intensity of cold extremes, regional climate variability and episodic cold events can still expose wild and farmed fishes to abrupt or physiologically stressful low-temperature conditions. This review synthesizes research on cold stress responses in fish from tropical, temperate, and polar environments from physiological and molecular perspectives. Using a structured literature search of major scientific databases for studies published between 1976 and 2026, we synthesized evidence across species and thermal environments. Building on earlier reviews, this cross-species synthesis links physiological, cellular, and molecular mechanisms of cold response with their implications for aquaculture management. Tropical fishes possess narrow thermal tolerance coupled with high vulnerability, whereas temperate species rely on metabolic and behavioral adjustments, and polar fish mostly depend on antifreeze proteins (AFPs) and cold-adapted enzymes. Exposure to low temperatures can elicit both detrimental stress effects and compensatory acclimatory responses, with their relative importance depending on the magnitude and duration of cooling, species-specific thermal limits, and prior thermal history. When cold exposure exceeds physiological tolerance, it may result in metabolic disruption, oxidative stress, osmoregulatory disturbance, immune suppression, and alterations in the gut microbiota. In contrast, modulation of MAPK and FoxO signaling, non-coding RNAs, and epigenetic regulation may participate in compensatory cellular responses that support physiological acclimation and, where demonstrated across generations, potentially contribute to longer-term thermal adaptation. Environmental management, dietary supplementation, selective breeding, pre-winter conditioning, and disease control represent potential strategies for mitigating cold-related losses in aquaculture, although the strength of supporting evidence and practical applicability vary among interventions, species, and production systems. We further identify critical knowledge gaps concerning long-term acclimation, transgenerational epigenetic inheritance, and interactions among multiple stressors. A key translational priority is to convert mechanistic indicators of cold tolerance into experimentally validated nutritional, breeding, and husbandry interventions that account for species-specific thermal biology and production conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统梳理了热带、温带和极地鱼类对低温胁迫的生理与分子响应机制，基于1976—2026年主要数据库文献进行跨物种整合分析。研究发现，热带鱼类热耐受范围窄、脆弱性高，温带鱼类依赖代谢与行为调节，极地鱼类主要依靠抗冻蛋白（AFPs）和冷适应酶；低温暴露既可产生不利胁迫效应，也可引发补偿性驯化响应，其相对重要性取决于降温幅度与持续时间、物种热极限及既往热经历。冷胁迫超过生理耐受时可导致代谢紊乱、氧化应激、渗透调节障碍、免疫抑制及肠道微生物群改变，而MAPK和FoxO信号调控、非编码RNA及表观遗传调控参与补偿性细胞响应。环境管理、饲料补充、选择育种、越冬前驯化及病害控制是减缓冷水性损失的可能策略，将冷耐受机制指标转化为经实验验证的营养、育种和养殖干预是关键转化优先方向。

papers.title: New types of feed for the aquaculture of African catfish (Clarias gariepinus)
papers.authors: Vagabova, N. A.-V.; Rabazanov, N. I.; Smirnov, A. A.; Kurbanov, M. S.
papers.abstract: Three groups of african catfish were fed different feeds for 60 days, under otherwise equal conditions. The individuals fed with compound feed for sturgeon fish showed the highest survival rate and biomass yield, with lower feed consumption. However, the average weight and growth rate per individual, as well as the average daily gain, were achieved in the group fed a diet that included 40% feed for sturgeon fish and 60% ground and heat treated broiler chicken intestines. This type of feed is effective for catfish and is significantly cheaper than the commonly used compound feed for fish.
papers.summary_cn: 研究比较了三种饲料对非洲鲶（Clarias gariepinus）60天养殖效果的影响。投喂鲟鱼配合饲料组存活率和生物量产量最高、饲料消耗较低，而含40%鲟鱼饲料与60%热处理绞碎肉鸡肠道饲料组在个体均重、生长率和平均日增重方面表现最佳。该混合饲料对鲶鱼有效且显著低于常用鱼用配合饲料成本。

papers.title: Microcarriers and 3D printing for cultivated meat and fish: from cell expansion to tissue structuring
papers.authors: Kim, Jae Jung; Sung, Jong Hwan
papers.summary_cn: 该文综述微载体与3D打印技术在培养肉及培养鱼生产中的应用，涵盖从细胞扩增到组织构建的流程。内容聚焦细胞体外培养与组织工程，与渔业资源、捕捞及养殖管理无关。非渔业相关。

papers.title: Sexual dimorphism across threespine stickleback ecotypes: a species-wide analysis with a White Sea marine case study
papers.authors: Lajus, Dmitry; Dorgham, Ahmed Salem AbdelAziz; Yurtseva, Anastasia Olegovna; Nadtochii, Ekaterina Viktorovna; Candolin, Ulrika; Ivanov, Mikhail Valerievich
papers.abstract: Sexual dimorphism (SD) can contribute to local adaptation and evolutionary diversification, but species-wide comparisons are hindered by heterogeneous published datasets. We developed the Sexual Dimorphism Ternary Index (SDTI), coding each trait–sample comparison as −1 (significant female bias), 0 (no significant difference), or +1 (significant male bias), to integrate heterogeneous data on threespine stickleback, Gasterosteus aculeatus Linnaeus, 1758, into a comparative dataset. Correlation-guided hierarchical aggregation reduced 11 overlapping traits to four weakly correlated variables: standard length (SL), the head–posterior composite (HPC), body depth (BD1), and the dorsal-spine composite (DSs). PERMANOVA detected a significant ecotype effect, with the clearest contrast occurring between marine and freshwater populations; BD1 showed the clearest single-variable separation. Marine populations tended to exhibit more male-biased body-depth and dorsal-spine dimorphism, whereas SL was consistently female-biased across ecotypes. The framework also allowed the White Sea samples to be positioned relative to the major ecotypes: their mean profile was closest to the anadromous centroid, while their high signed mean SDTI reflected a net predominance of significant male-biased comparisons across the traits examined. Although SDTI does not measure effect magnitude and is sensitive to statistical power, it identifies patterns in direction and organization of sexual dimorphism.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究开发了性二态三元指数（SDTI），将三刺鱼（Gasterosteus aculeatus）异质性数据整合为可比较数据集，并通过相关性引导的层次聚合将11个重叠性状缩减为4个弱相关变量（SL、HPC、BD1、DSs）。PERMANOVA检测到显著的生态型效应，海洋与淡水种群差异最为明显，BD1的单变量分离效果最佳；海洋种群体型深度和背棘倾向雄性偏倚，而SL在各生态型中一致表现为雌性偏倚。白海样本的平均轮廓最接近溯河型中心，但其较高的SDTI均值反映所检性状中显著雄性偏倚比较占净优势。SDTI虽不衡量效应量且受统计功效影响，但能揭示性二态的方向与组织模式。

papers.title: A data-driven predictive system for shellfish biotoxin risk assessment
papers.authors: Zhou, Jiaqi; Simmons, Nidhi; Senovilla-Herrero, Diana; Brereton, Paul; Campbell, Katrina
papers.journal: Frontiers in Food Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Diarrhetic shellfish poisoning (DSP) toxins pose a major threat to the aquaculture industry and public health. Traditional monitoring methods suffer from delays and high costs, and intelligent early warning systems are urgently needed. The study utilised machine learning to predict shellfish biotoxin levels in shellfish by integrating multiple data sources, including phytoplankton monitoring, climatic variables, and historical toxin records. Data from seven shellfish production areas in Northern Ireland from 2011 to 2021, covering DSP-OA + dinophysistoxins and AZAs toxin concentrations, seven phytoplankton taxa or taxonomic groups, and three climatic variables was used to inform the model. Using the Lale Machine learning framework, the study constructed 42 initial modelling scenarios across regions, shellfish species, and toxin combinations. SHAP analyses quantified feature contributions and identified the main predictors across the retained scenarios. After data filtering and performance screening, model performance varied across the region-species combinations. The final regression models showed limited predictive performance, while the classification models showed stronger performance for the two evaluated region-species combinations, Belfast mussels and Dundrum mussels, with F1 scores of 0.766 and 0.950. The results of the study show predictive potential for toxin occurrence at the next sampling occasion, although further validation is required before operational early-warning application.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在利用机器学习整合浮游植物监测、气候变量和历史毒素记录等多源数据，构建贝类生物毒素（DSP-OA、dinophysistoxins 及 AZAs）预测预警系统。基于北爱尔兰7个贝类产区2011—2021年数据，采用 Lale 机器学习框架构建42个初始建模场景，并通过 SHAP 分析量化特征贡献。回归模型预测性能有限，但分类模型在 Belfast 和 Dundrum 两个区域-物种组合（贻贝）表现较好，F1 分数分别为0.766和0.950。结果表明模型对下一采样时点的毒素发生具有预测潜力，但投入业务化早期预警前仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Comparison of the size-age composition and growth rate of two species of arrow-toothed halibuts Atheresthes spp. in shared habitat
papers.authors: Kuznetsova, E. N.; Trofimova, A. O.; Melnikova, F. A.
papers.abstract: Analysis of the size composition of two sympatric sibling flatfishes – arrowtooth flounder ( Atheresthes stomias ) and Kamchatka flounder ( A. evermanni ) on the continental slope in areas of cohabitation revealed a similarity in size range, with different size–age classes dominating. In their original habitats, the native species is usually represented by a wide range of size groups with a large number of juveniles, whereas the invader is represented mainly by adult individuals with a distribution close to normal. In areas where both species are native, their size structure is similar. This divergence in size at certain depths reduces trophic competition. A comparison of growth showed that up to age 4 the sizes of the two species are similar, after which arrowtooth flounder slightly surpasses Kamchatka flounder in length and weight. However, apparently due to a longer life cycle, Kamchatka flounder attains a larger size.
papers.summary_cn: 比较了同域分布两种箭齿鲽（arrowtooth flounder 与 Kamchatka flounder）在大陆坡共存区的体长-年龄组成与生长速率。结果显示二者体长范围相似但优势体长-年龄组不同：原产地物种幼鱼比例高、体长组谱宽，入侵种以成体为主且分布近正态；在两者均为原产地的海域，体长结构趋同，这种深度相关的体长分化有助于降低摄食竞争。生长比较表明4龄前两物种规格相近，之后 arrowtooth flounder 的体长和体重略超过 Kamchatka flounder，但后者因生命周期更长而最终达到更大规格。

papers.title: A study of price dynamics for key fish species in the Murmansk region
papers.authors: Vopilovskiy, S. S.
papers.abstract: The study analyzes price trends for key fish and seafood products in the Murmansk Region and assesses their components. It notes that the Murmansk Region is a leader in fisheries activities in the Russian Arctic, possessing the greatest potential and a more developed maritime infrastructure. Among the key economic indicators for the Murmansk Region, the indicator “fisheries and fish farming” in particular has a positive value. It is noted that the harvest (catch) of aquatic biological resources in the Northern Fisheries Basin is declining, while fish and seafood prices are showing a steady upward trend. An analysis of wholesale and retail prices for key fish products in the cities of Murmansk and Moscow, which are subject to shocks over time, was conducted. A direct correlation has been established between fish consumption by the population and the growth in seafood prices, the export orientation of the fishing industry and the rapid rise in fuel prices for fishing companies.
papers.summary_cn: 研究分析了摩尔曼斯克地区主要鱼类和海产品价格趋势及其构成因素。该地区是俄罗斯北极渔业活动领先区域，但北方渔业流域水生生物资源捕捞量下降，鱼价持续上涨。通过比较摩尔曼斯克与莫斯科主要鱼品批发零售价格，发现居民鱼类消费与海产品价格上涨、渔业出口导向及捕捞企业燃料价格快速上涨存在直接相关性。

papers.title: Tantangan Implementasi UNCLOS 1982 dalam Penanggulangan IUU Fishing dan Overfishing di Indonesia
papers.authors: Sajidin, Muhammad; Susanti, Eni; Wardhana, Danar Hafidz Adi; Nabilah, Khurin; Mu'min, Mu'min; Mausili, Dwi Rianisa
papers.abstract: The management of fishery resources in the Indonesian Exclusive Economic Zone (ZEEI) is based on sovereign rights guaranteed by the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) 1982. However, the implementation of this legal framework faces fundamental obstacles in overcoming Illegal, Unreported, and Unregulated (IUU) Fishing and overfishing. This study aims to analyze the challenges of the implementation of UNCLOS 1982 in sustainable fisheries management and the effectiveness of law enforcement in the ZEEI. The methods used are legal research with a statute approach, conceptual approach, and comparative approach, which are complemented by factual analysis of enforcement data. The results of the study found that there is a dynamic trend of foreign vessel enforcement (Table 1), which shows a shift in the pattern of violations and supervision from the archipelagic waters/territorial sea area to the EEZ area. In addition, it was found that there is a gap between the determination of the total allowable catch quota and law enforcement in the field which is constrained by imprisonment based on Article 73 paragraph (3) of UNCLOS 1982, the extent of the water area, the limitation of patrol fleets, and the migratory nature of fish stocks across jurisdictional boundaries. The novelty of this research lies in the mapping of a harmonized model of maritime law enforcement that integrates the strengthening of regulations based on scientific data, the use of integrated monitoring technology, as well as a reasonable bond scheme and administrative fines as a solution to the limitations of imposing prison penalties in ZEEI.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究分析UNCLOS 1982在印度尼西亚专属经济区（ZEEI）渔业管理中应对IUU Fishing和overfishing的实施障碍，采用法规、概念与比较相结合的法学研究方法，并辅以执法数据的事实分析。研究发现外国渔船执法呈现动态趋势，违规与监管重心由群岛水域/领海向EEZ转移；总可捕量配额设定与现场执法之间存在差距，受制于UNCLOS第73条第3款规定的监禁处罚、水域广阔、巡逻船队有限及鱼类种群跨管辖边界洄游等因素。研究创新在于构建统一的海上执法协调模型，整合基于科学数据的法规强化、综合监测技术应用以及合理保证金与行政罚款方案，以弥补ZEEI监禁处罚适用的局限。

papers.title: Life History Stage, Body Size and Morphology Dominate Fish Critical Swimming Speed: A Global Synthesis
papers.authors: Yang, Lu; Tao, Juan; Cheng, Guangjie; Zhang, Mengxue; Tang, Bangli; Liu, Yang; Ding, Chengzhi
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Critical swimming speed (Ucrit) is widely used to quantify prolonged swimming performance in fishes, yet available measurements remain concentrated in particular species, life history stages, morphotypes and experimental contexts, leaving broad‐scale patterns of Ucrit variation poorly synthesized. Here, we compiled a global dataset of experimentally measured absolute and relative Ucrit (absolute Ucrit standardized by body length) from 1345 experimental cases across 361 species and 387 publications. Body length was strongly associated with Ucrit, but this association varied between absolute and relative Ucrit and among life history stages. Absolute Ucrit increased with body length across all stages, more steeply in larvae than in adults and juveniles, whereas relative Ucrit declined with body length in adults and juveniles but increased weakly in larvae. Morphology provided further explanatory insight in adults and juveniles: elongated body forms and forked or lunate caudal fins were generally associated with higher Ucrit, while caudal peduncle throttling (CPt) was negatively associated with both absolute and relative Ucrit, and body lateral shape (BLs) was negatively associated mainly with relative Ucrit. Water temperature was positively associated with both Ucrit metrics after accounting for body length, life history stage and ecosystem type, although temperature slopes varied among ecosystem types (freshwater, marine, migratory). Overall, these results show that body‐size scaling differs between absolute and relative Ucrit and that Ucrit variation is jointly associated with life history stage, morphology and temperature, providing a clearer basis for comparing swimming performance across fishes and interpreting Ucrit reference values in applied ecological and management contexts.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究通过整合361种鱼类、1345个实验案例的全球数据集，系统分析了绝对与相对Ucrit（以体长标准化的critical swimming speed）的变异格局。体长与绝对Ucrit在所有生活史阶段均正相关（仔鱼斜率陡于成鱼和幼鱼），而相对Ucrit在成鱼和幼鱼中随体长下降、在仔鱼中弱上升。形态方面，细长体型及叉形或新月形尾鳍与较高Ucrit相关，尾柄收缩（caudal peduncle throttling）与两项指标均负相关。水温在控制体长、生活史阶段和生态系统类型后与Ucrit正相关，但斜率因淡水、海洋和洄游生态系统而异。

papers.title: Employing deep learning for chum salmon (Oncorhynchus keta) age estimation through scale image analysis
papers.authors: Ames, Robert T.; Barry, Patrick D.; Callahan, Matt W.; Leuthold, Niels; Wischniowski, Stephen G.; Neil, Jodi C.; Gravel, Sarah; Scott, Taylor; Adams, Benjamin H.; Christman, Emma I.
papers.abstract: Accurate age estimates of salmon produced from scale growth patterns yield demographic information essential for population assessment and fisheries management. Conventionally, salmon ages are estimated from scales by trained personnel where demand often exceeds staffing capacity and financial resources. Convolutional neural network (CNN) models are a promising approach to augment manual age estimation. We compiled an extensive scale image repository from chum salmon (Oncorhynchus keta, Salmonidae) stocks throughout the North Pacific rim, evaluated two image preprocessing algorithms—Segment Anything Model (SAM) and You Only Look Once (YOLO)—to remove or reduce background noise, and trained an ensemble of three CNN models (EfficientNetV2L, NASNetLarge, and ConvNeXtLarge, weighted by their MSE) to infer chum salmon age. Agreement with expert estimates was higher for the SAM preprocessed images (93.2%) than YOLO (91.4%) across all major age classes (ages 3–5). Both preprocessing approaches showed reduced agreement for less common age classes because of inadequate representation in the model training and validation datasets. This approach may be integrated into fisheries management workflows to accelerate the age estimation process, complement manual reading, and bolster quality control protocols.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在利用深度学习从鳞片图像自动估算北太平洋沿岸chum salmon（Oncorhynchus keta）年龄，以补充人工判读。作者构建了大规模鳞片图像库，比较SAM与YOLO两种背景去除预处理算法，并基于EfficientNetV2L、NASNetLarge和ConvNeXtLarge按MSE加权集成三个CNN模型进行年龄推断。结果显示，SAM预处理图像的估算结果与专家判读一致率（93.2%）高于YOLO（91.4%），主要年龄组（3–5龄）表现良好，但少见年龄组因训练和验证数据不足一致率下降。该方法有望整合进渔业管理流程，加速年龄估算并强化质量控制。

papers.title: Determining the distribution characteristics of Japanese and Chinese fishing vessels for neon flying squid using automatic identification system (AIS) data
papers.authors: Ohno, Shintaro; Abe, Hiroto; Saitoh, Sei-Ichi; Igarashi, Hiromichi
papers.abstract: Abstract To sustainably use neon flying squid resources in the high seas, understanding the fishing operation locations and status in the various countries involved is essential. We analyzed automatic identification system (AIS) data installed on the fishing vessels to describe the operational characteristics of Japanese and Chinese neon flying squid fishing vessels in the central North Pacific (in the range of 35°–45° N and 165° E–165° W). From May to July in 2016–2019, fishing vessels of these two countries were in operation with the west side for Chinese and east side for the Japanese vessels in most of the cases. In addition, Japanese vessels were on average located 3° farther north than Chinese vessels. Trend analysis showed that Chinese fishing efforts had gradually increased to the east, recently overlapping the fishing grounds between the two countries in the central North Pacific in study period. Our analysis of ocean environmental data indicated that vessels from both countries mainly operated around 15 °C during May–June each year. In contrast, in July, Chinese vessels operated 2–5℃ higher than Japanese vessels. These differences in distribution and environments in fishing location suggest that the two countries vessels may have exploited different cohorts.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用AIS数据分析了2016–2019年5–7月北太平洋中部（35°–45°N、165°E–165°W）日本与中国柔鱼钓渔船的空间分布与作业特征。结果显示，中国渔船多分布于西部、日本渔船多分布于东部，日本渔船平均作业位置较中国渔船偏北约3°；中国渔船作业努力量逐渐东扩，近年已与日本渔场重叠。环境分析表明两国渔船5–6月主要在15°C等温线附近作业，但7月中国渔船作业水温较日本渔船高2–5°C，提示两国渔船可能开发了不同的柔鱼种群。

papers.title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN AQUACULTURE: APPLICATIONS, RESEARCH GAPS, AND IMPLICATIONS FOR PROFESSIONAL EDUCATION AND GOVERNANCE — A SYSTEMATIC LITERATURE REVIEW
papers.authors: Marinho-Pereira, Thiago; Cavero, Bruno; Brandão, Lian Valente
papers.journal: Cadernos de Educação, Tecnologia e Sociedade
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in aquaculture to support monitoring, prediction, automation, and production management, while also creating new requirements for professional competence, ethical oversight, and governance. This systematic literature review, conducted under an integrative approach and reported in accordance with PRISMA 2020, examined practical applications of AI and their implications for professional education and governance in aquaculture. Searches in Scopus, Web of Science, PubMed, and Google Scholar identified 877 records, of which 97 met the eligibility criteria and were included in the qualitative synthesis. The evidence was concentrated on technical applications, particularly fish detection and biomass estimation, water and environmental monitoring, automated production systems, health and biosecurity, and feeding and growth optimization. Direct educational evidence was scarce: only one study examined aquaculture professionals' knowledge and interest in AI, and no included study evaluated formal curricular interventions or learning outcomes in Fisheries Engineering. The synthesis also identified concerns involving data quality, algorithmic bias, technological exclusion, privacy, standardization, and accountability. These findings indicate that responsible adoption requires locally representative data, transparent validation, digital and data literacy, human oversight, and coordinated governance. AI has substantial potential to support aquaculture, but its contribution to professional education remains an important and insufficiently investigated research field.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述遵循PRISMA 2020框架，系统检索了Scopus、Web of Science、PubMed和Google Scholar中的877条记录，最终纳入97项研究，考察AI在水产养殖中的应用及其对专业教育与治理的影响。证据集中于鱼类检测与生物量估算、水体与环境监测、自动化生产系统、健康与生物安全以及投饲与生长优化等技术应用。教育相关证据极为匮乏，仅1项研究涉及从业人员对AI的认知与兴趣，无研究评估正式课程干预或学习成效；同时识别出数据质量、算法偏见、技术排斥、隐私、标准化与问责等问题。作者认为负责任的AI应用需依托本地代表性数据、透明验证、数字与数据素养、人工监督及协同治理，AI对专业教育的贡献仍是亟待深入研究的方向。

papers.title: sirt5, a target of miR-21-y, acts as a negative regulator of mavs-dependent antiviral immunity in rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss)
papers.authors: Zhao, Lu; Huang, Jinqiang; Li, Yongjuan; Jiao, Wenlong; Zhou, Fengqi
papers.summary_cn: 该研究以虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）为对象，探讨sirt5作为miR-21-y靶基因在MAVS依赖的抗病毒免疫中的调控作用。基于标题推断，sirt5对MAVS介导的抗病毒信号通路发挥负调控功能，且其表达受miR-21-y靶向调控。

papers.title: Corrigendum to “The Arctic shipping routes puzzle: A multi-criteria decision analysis”[Mar. Policy 192 (2026) 107186]
papers.authors: Gavalas, Dimitris; Terezaki, Marianna; Dikaios, George
papers.summary_cn: 该文为《北极航线谜题：多准则决策分析》一文的勘误声明，不涉及渔业科学研究。

papers.title: Fish Mucus Mediated Synthesis of Silver Nanoparticles from Piaractus brachypomus
papers.authors: C, Samson Lijoseraj; R, Hari Prasad; S, Premina; E, Magdalene Hannah; Arulraj, Candace Crystal; T, Sathish Kumar
papers.abstract: Nanomedicine is been a breakthrough for years due to its high efficiency in bactericidal property, antioxidant and cancer therapeutics. Silver Nanoparticle (AgNPs) being the safest metal was utilized in this biosynthesis method to synthesize AgNPs utilizing Piaractus brachypomus skin mucus, a biomolecule abundant source for the conversion of nanoparticle. The converted nanoparticle was characterized using UV spectrometric analysis exhibit a peak at 410nm, FTIR and XRD found properties corresponds to AgNPs, FESEM-EDAX identified average size of AgNPs as 35.303±23.43nm, EDAX confirmed silver through secondary diffraction. The highest bactericidal zone was 16mm against Salmonella spp., and antifungal activity was evident against Candida albicans and Dermatophytes spp. The DPPH exhibit a significant antioxidant activity of 49.32% at 10μL. The cytotoxicity analysis revealed 88% cytotoxic effect at 100μL exhibiting IC₅₀ of 58.05 µg/mL, and a CC₅₀ of 434µg/mL on Vero cells, yielding 7.5 selectivity index lead AgNPs, a significant candidate for biomedical application.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用淡水鱼Piaractus brachypomus皮肤黏液作为生物还原剂绿色合成银纳米颗粒（AgNPs），并通过UV、FTIR、XRD及FESEM-EDAX等手段表征其理化性质，平均粒径约35.3 nm。合成的AgNPs对Salmonella spp.表现出明显抗菌活性（抑菌圈16 mm），对Candida albicans和皮肤癣菌具有抗真菌作用，DPPH自由基清除率达49.32%。细胞毒性试验显示其对肿瘤细胞IC₅₀为58.05 µg/mL，对Vero细胞CC₅₀为434 µg/mL，选择性指数7.5，提示其具备生物医学应用潜力。

papers.title: Assessing Invasive Fish Diversity in Lake Ranu Grati, Indonesia
papers.authors: Kresnasari, Widya Desti; Farid, Akhmad; Triajie, Haryo; Musyaffa, Nurul; Firmansyah, Mas Ahsan Sandya
papers.abstract: This study analyzed invasive fish species diversity in Lake Ranu Grati, Pasuruan, East Java. Sampling occurred at four stations using cast nets. Community structure was evaluated using Shannon–Wiener diversity (H'), uniformity (E), dominance (C), density (D), and relative abundance (KR). Results revealed 88 individuals across four species: Louhan (Amphilophus sp.), Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus), Jaguar Cichlid (Parachromis managuensis), and Red Devil (Amphilophus labiatus). Values ranged for H' (0.96–1.14, low–medium), E (0.69–0.82, high), and C (0.39–0.45, low). Density peaked in vegetation areas (0.47 ind/m²) and was lowest in open water (0.10 ind/m²), showing a clumped pattern. Louhan dominated all stations (KR=55.56–63.64%). Habitat complexity and anthropogenic activity strongly influence these distribution patterns.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究调查了印度尼西亚东爪哇Ranu Grati湖入侵鱼类多样性，在四个站点用撒网采样，以Shannon–Wiener多样性（H'）、均匀度（E）、优势度（C）、密度（D）和相对丰度（KR）评价群落结构。共采集4种88尾入侵鱼：Louhan（Amphilophus sp.）、尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）、Jaguar Cichlid（Parachromis managuensis）和Red Devil（Amphilophus labiatus）。H'为0.96–1.14（低至中等），E为0.69–0.82（高），C为0.39–0.45（低）；密度在水草区最高（0.47 ind/m²）、开阔水域最低（0.10 ind/m²），呈聚集分布，Louhan在各站点均占优势（KR=55.56–63.64%）。生境复杂性和人为活动强烈影响其分布格局。

papers.title: Reef fish functional groups show variable declines due to deforestation-driven sedimentation, while flexible harvesting mitigates this damage
papers.authors: Milne, Russell; Anand, Madhur; Bauch, Chris T.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨森林砍伐驱动的沉积作用对珊瑚礁鱼类功能群的差异化影响，并评估灵活采捕策略能否缓解这一损害。基于标题推断，研究可能结合沉积梯度与鱼类功能群数据，分析不同功能群的下降幅度及采捕管理情景。

papers.title: Integrating conventional tagging and acoustic telemetry improves estimates of post-release survival for a highly targeted reef fish
papers.authors: Hyman, A Challen; Collins, Angela B; Ramsay, Chloe; Wilms, Sean; Allen, Micheal S; Barbieri, Luiz; Frazer, Thomas K
papers.abstract: Abstract Accurate estimation of post-release survival is fundamental to fisheries stock assessment and effective management. Conventional tag-return studies and acoustic telemetry are commonly used to estimate this probability, yet each approach has limitations when applied independently. Using gag (Mycteroperca microlepis) as a case study, we integrated data from a large-scale conventional tagging program and an acoustic telemetry experiment into a discrete-time statistical modeling framework that links relative recapture risk with telemetry-derived fate. This approach enabled estimation of post-release survival across a broad gradient of depths representative of recreational fishing conditions. Estimated survival was high in shallow waters ($\approx$96%) but declined with increasing depth, consistent with depth-related barotrauma. Applying model predictions to data from the recreational fishery yielded annual and monthly post-release survival probabilities. Annual estimates were consistent with values assumed in recent stock assessments, while monthly values highlighted seasonal patterns relevant for management. This integrated framework advances post-release survival estimation by combining the extensive sample sizes and environmental coverage characteristic of conventional tagging data with the individual-level fate inference provided by acoustic telemetry, and offers a transferable approach applicable to other highly targeted fishery species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对高捕捞压力礁鱼gag（Mycteroperca microlepis），将大规模传统标记回捕数据与acoustic telemetry实验整合进离散时间统计模型，以估算放流后存活率。结果表明浅水区存活率较高（约96%），并随深度增加而下降，与气压伤（barotrauma）效应一致。模型预测的年存活率与近期stock assessment假设相符，月存活率则揭示了具有管理意义的时间格局。该整合框架兼具传统标记的大样本与环境覆盖优势及telemetry的个体命运推断能力，可推广至其他高捕捞目标鱼种。

papers.title: Global existence, blow-up behavior, and numerical simulations for a class of chemotaxis-driven fish-mussel systems
papers.authors: Shanmugasundaram, Gnanasekaran; Saha, Jitraj
papers.journal: Zeitschrift für angewandte Mathematik und Physik
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对一类趋化性驱动的鱼类-贻贝模型，探讨其全局解的存在性与爆破行为，并开展数值模拟。模型以 chemotaxis 机制刻画鱼类与贻贝间的空间相互作用。研究给出了解整体存在及有限时间 blow-up 的条件，并通过数值模拟验证理论结果。

papers.title: Sequential use of habitat types by juvenile tarpon Megalops atlanticus supports a landscape approach to conservation
papers.authors: Stevens, Philip W.; Bradley, Eli B.; Shea, Colin P.; Ault, Erick R.; Adams, Aaron J.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究关注幼体大西洋大海鲢（Megalops atlanticus）对栖息地类型的顺序利用，基于标题推测其通过追踪幼鱼在不同生境间的时空分布揭示其栖息地转换模式。研究结果支持以景观尺度（landscape approach）开展该物种的保护管理，提示单一栖息地保护不足以覆盖其早期生活史需求。

papers.title: <b>Characterization of low-cost aquaculture systems in three municipalities of the mountainous region of Veracruz, Mexico</b>
papers.authors: Campos Páez, Edgardo; Cabal Prieto, Adán; Becerra-Ferniza, Antonieta Donají; Bautista Ortega, Jaime; Huicab Pech, Zulema Guadalupe
papers.abstract: Objective: To characterize small-scale aquaculture systems and identify their key productive, technical, commercial, and social conditions in three municipalities of the mountainous region of Veracruz. Design/methodology/approach: A survey was conducted on eight aquaculture farms using the snowball sampling technique. The questionnaire was structured in two phases: the first collected general information about the interviewees, whereas the second focused on obtaining information regarding the production systems and the implementation of Good Management Practices (GMP) in aquaculture. The data obtained were analyzed using descriptive statistics, specifically absolute frequencies and percentages, with the Microsoft 365 software package. Results: In the mountainous region of Veracruz, semi-intensive systems predominate for the production of rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) and tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus), with male (62.5%) and female (37.5%) participation. Aquaculture is integrated as a complementary activity to conventional agricultural practices. Farms with less than five years of operation exhibited limitations in technical knowledge, insufficient water quality monitoring, and a lack of production records and sanitary practices. Despite the government support received by more than 50% of producers, production levels ranged from 50 to 1,000 kg per cycle, with an average fish weight of 500 ± 265 g. Production was intended for both household consumption (0.5–5 kg/week/family) and commercialization. Limitations on study/implications: Survey implementation was limited within the mountainous region; therefore, applying the instrument to a larger number of aquaculture farms and/or producers would provide a more comprehensive characterization of these production systems. Findings/conclusions: Aquaculture systems in the mountainous region of Veracruz constitute an emerging activity that is highly accepted among small-scale producers because of their contribution to the availability of animal protein within local communities. However, continuous technical training is required to enhance sustainability, production efficiency, and integration with complementary production systems such as aquaponics.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在表征墨西哥韦拉克鲁斯山区三个市镇的小规模水产养殖系统，通过对8个养殖场开展问卷调查，评估其生产、技术、商业和社会条件及良好管理规范（GMP）实施情况。结果显示，该地区以半集约化系统为主，主要养殖虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）和罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus），养殖作为农业的补充活动，男性参与占62.5%。运营不足五年的养殖场在技术知识、水质监测、生产记录和卫生管理方面存在明显不足，尽管超过半数生产者获得政府支持，单周期产量仅50–1,000 kg，平均鱼体重500 ± 265 g，产品兼顾家庭消费与销售。水产养殖在该山区为新兴且受小规模生产者广泛接受的活动，但需持续技术培训以提升可持续性和生产效率。

papers.title: Implementation of sustainable practices in supply chain management and performance of seafood exporting companies: empirical evidence from Vietnam
papers.authors: Nguyen, Thi Ngoc Hoa; Khuu, Thi Phuong Dong; Tran, Dang Tuyen
papers.summary_cn: 该研究以越南海产品出口企业为对象，探讨供应链管理中可持续实践的实施情况及其对企业绩效的影响。基于实证数据，分析可持续供应链实践（如绿色采购、环境管理）与出口企业绩效之间的关系。

papers.authors: Kodeeswaran, Paramasivam
papers.abstract: Abstract This study describes a new Dysommina species, based on two specimens collected at a depth of ca. 600 m in the Lakshadweep Sea off south‐western India. The new species differs from its congeners in having fewer total vertebrae (120–127 vs. 134 in D. castanea , 133–134 in D. brevis , and 137–141 in D. orientalis ), fewer predorsal vertebrae (14–15 vs. 16 in D. pygmaea ), fewer preanal vertebrae (24–27 vs. 28–31 in D. rugosa ), and in a combination of morphometric, meristic, dentition and colouration characters. DNA sequences were generated and analysed.
papers.summary_cn: 描述了印度拉克沙群岛海域约600米深处采集的2尾标本，鉴定为合鳃鳗科Ilyophinae亚科Dysommina属一新种。新种与同属物种的区别在于总椎骨数较少（120–127，对比D. castanea的134、D. brevis的133–134及D. orientalis的137–141）、臀前椎骨较少（24–27，对比D. rugosa的28–31）以及形态测量、齿系和体色特征的组合差异。研究同时生成并分析了DNA序列。

papers.title: Inland fisheries market feasibility of sharptooth catfish (Clarias gariepinus) in the Eastern Cape, South Africa
papers.authors: J Pegg; C Welgemoed; OLF Weyl
papers.abstract: Despite increasing interest in inland fisheries as a means of supporting food security, livelihoods, and rural development, inland fisheries in South Africa remain poorly integrated into food systems, with significant uncertainty regarding supply chains, consumer demand, and product quality. We assessed the market feasibility of sharptooth catfish (Clarias gariepinus) harvested through the Darlington Alien Fish Harvest Project in the Eastern Cape, South Africa. Over a 9-month trial, 761 kg of catfish were procured, processed into retail products (fillets, burgers, smoked portions, and offcuts), and tested in both formal and informal markets in Makhanda, Eastern Cape. High fat content and visible trematode cysts rendered 32% of fish unsuitable for retail. Of the fish considered fit for consumption, processed products such as burgers and fillets sold moderately well in formal outlets, while offcuts were the most successful product in township markets. The main challenge to the viability of the project, however, was not quality but economics. Whole catfish were purchased at 8–10 ZAR/kg, but erratic supply and transport costs inflated landed prices by more than 50%, reducing competitiveness against established products such as hake (Merluccius capensis) and carpenter (Argyrozona argyrozona). This case study revealed two key findings: First, it provides evidence that new consumer markets can be developed for fish products from South African inland fisheries. Second, successful fishery development requires attention not only to harvesting, but also to supply chains, processing, and market development. These findings provide practical evidence to support implementation of South Africa's inland fisheries policy.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了南非东开普省尖齿鲶（Clarias gariepinus）内陆渔业的市场可行性，通过为期9个月的试验，将761 kg鲶鱼加工为鱼片、汉堡、烟熏制品和边角料，在正式与非正式市场进行销售测试。高脂肪含量和可见吸虫囊蚴导致32%的鱼不适合零售；加工产品（汉堡、鱼片）在正式渠道销售尚可，边角料在乡镇市场表现最佳。项目可行性的主要挑战在于经济层面而非质量——供应不稳定和运输成本使到岸价格较8–10 ZAR/kg的收购价上涨逾50%，削弱了相对无须鳕（Merluccius capensis）和银齿鲷（Argyrozona argyrozona）等成熟产品的竞争力。案例表明南非内陆渔业可开发新的消费市场，但渔业发展需同时关注供应链、加工与市场开发，而不仅是捕捞环节。

papers.title: Socio-economics of elasmobranch fisheries in India: ecological, livelihood and governance dimensions
papers.authors: Mohanraaj, T.; Jebarani Rajathy, T.; Sherly Cross, S. R. T.; Punitha, S.; Nandhitha, S.; Sheeba, M.; Roselind, Kalaiarasi
papers.abstract: Sharks and rays are an important yet heterogeneous component of India’s marine fisheries, contributing to food supply, household income, processing, trade and associated services, while many species have life-history characteristics that make them sensitive to sustained fishing mortality. This review synthesizes ecological, fisheries, livelihood, market and governance evidence on Indian shark and ray fisheries using a structured narrative evidence-synthesis approach with documented information sources, search strings, eligibility criteria, a source hierarchy and fixed extraction fields. Quantitative evidence is reported with geographic unit, reference period, metric, source and comparability limitations. National ICAR–CMFRI landing estimates are used as the principal quantitative baseline; they are treated as monitoring indicators and not as direct measures of total catch, abundance or fishing mortality. Indian elasmobranch fisheries include directed capture, incidental capture, retained bycatch and discarding, often within the same multispecies fishing system, and the value chain extends beyond fins to meat, skin, liver oil and other commodities. Quantitative India-specific evidence on employment, income and gender remains limited, and global statistics are used only as context. Policy evidence is drawn from primary government and intergovernmental sources, with a distinction between policy publication, notification, implementation and evaluation. Species- and gear-specific monitoring, improved taxonomic resolution, bycatch mitigation, transparent value-chain information, gender-disaggregated socio-economic data and participatory governance are identified as more defensible immediate priorities than broad technology-led interventions.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述采用结构化叙事证据综合方法，系统梳理印度板鳃类渔业在生态、渔业、生计、市场与治理维度的证据，以ICAR–CMFRI上岸量估算作为主要定量基线并明确其仅作监测指标而非总渔获或捕捞死亡率的直接度量。研究指出印度板鳃类渔业兼有定向捕捞、兼捕、保留副渔获与丢弃，价值链涵盖鱼肉、皮、肝油等多类产品，而就业、收入与性别方面的印度本土定量证据仍有限。作者认为物种与渔具特异性监测、提升分类分辨率、bycatch mitigation、价值链信息透明、性别分列社会经济数据与参与式治理，是比广泛技术干预更可辩护的优先事项。

papers.title: Vulnerability assessment of non-target species in Rastrineobola argentea (Pellegrin, 1904) artisanal capture fisheries in Lake Victoria, Uganda
papers.authors: Kyomuhendo, Taddeo; Msukwa, Amulike V.; Natugonza, Vianny; Jere, Wilson
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对乌干达维多利亚湖Rastrineobola argentea小型渔业中的非目标物种开展脆弱性评估，旨在识别兼捕物种并评价其对捕捞压力的敏感性。由于摘要缺失，具体方法与结果无法获知。

papers.title: Beyond Automation: An Observability and Error Framework for AI-Enabled Marine Recreational Fisheries Monitoring
papers.authors: Martin-Podevin, Loéva; Gorkin, Robert; Hughes, Julian; Aubin, Samuel; Brown, Culum
papers.abstract: Monitoring marine recreational fishing remains difficult because effort and catches are spatially dispersed, participation is heterogeneous, and reporting is rarely mandatory. This narrative review asks what artificial intelligence (AI) can automate and when AI-derived observations can support defensible fisheries inference. We synthesise established on- and off-site monitoring methods, direct recreational-fisheries applications of AI, and transferable evidence from commercial fisheries and aquaculture. Across methods, the limitation is observability: each monitoring approach captures a subset of fishing, and greater data volume does not necessarily increase population representativeness. AI primarily expands the speed, scale and richness of information extraction within observable events while introducing its own measurement and model errors. We propose an observation-to-decision framework in which sampling and coverage error, sensor and measurement error, algorithmic error and estimation uncertainty are considered jointly. Transferability is treated as a domain-shift problem requiring external validation across sites, seasons, devices and species. The most defensible near-term architecture is a calibrated hybrid system in which probability-based surveys anchor population inference, direct observations provide validation, and AI-enabled cameras or angler images provide high-frequency measurement. The value of AI to fisheries management should therefore be judged by the validity of the complete monitoring system, not by algorithmic accuracy alone.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述探讨AI在海洋休闲渔业监测中可自动化的环节及AI观测支持可靠渔业推断的条件。作者综合现场与非现场监测方法、AI在休闲渔业中的直接应用及商业渔业和水产养殖的可迁移证据，指出核心限制在于可观测性（observability），数据量增加未必提升种群代表性，且AI在提高信息提取速度与规模的同时引入测量与模型误差。提出将抽样与覆盖误差、传感器与测量误差、算法误差及估计不确定性联合考虑的“观测到决策”框架，并将可迁移性视为需跨站点、季节、设备和物种外部验证的domain-shift问题。认为近期最稳健的架构是校准的混合系统：以概率抽样调查锚定种群推断，直接观测提供验证，AI相机或钓者图像提供高频测量；AI对渔业管理的价值应以完整监测系统的有效性而非单纯算法精度来评判。

papers.title: Reassessing carbon sink fisheries: biogeochemical constraints and ecological-economic-social coupling and governance
papers.authors: Li, Cheng; Hu, Jiamei; Yu, Shang Ke; Hua, Xia; Jin, Yue; Hu, Xi
papers.abstract: Fisheries and aquaculture influence marine carbon cycling, but biological carbon-retention does not necessarily constitute atmospheric carbon dioxide removal. This critical narrative review reassesses carbon sink fisheries, a concept developed in Chinese fisheries research, through an ecological-economic-social framework. Seaweed cultivation, bivalve aquaculture, integrated multi-trophic aquaculture, and fisheries management are distinguished by carbon pathways and evidentiary requirements. Calcification, respiration, atmospheric replenishment, counterfactual production, postharvest fate, and storage durability constrain carbon claims. Recent observations support enhanced carbon burial in some depositional farming environments, whereas carbonate chemistry and system-level analyses do not justify classifying conventional bivalve production as verified marine carbon dioxide removal. These findings are reconciled by distinguishing measured transfers and stocks from additional atmospheric removal that persists over a specified horizon. A practical governance sequence is proposed: define the intervention and baseline, evaluate claim-specific evidence, report removal and avoided emissions separately, and assess economic performance alongside enforceable social and ecological safeguards. Shared monitoring, tenure protection, transparent benefit allocation, and a zero-carbon-credit financing scenario make the framework relevant to small producers. System dynamics is retained as a prospective tool for testing feedback and policy trade-offs; no calibrated simulation is presented. Climate claims should follow demonstrated carbon outcomes, while food production, nutrient removal, habitat protection, and livelihoods can justify distinct policy instruments.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述以生态-经济-社会框架重新审视中国渔业研究提出的“碳汇渔业”概念，区分海藻栽培、贝类养殖、多营养层次综合养殖（IMTA）及渔业管理在碳路径与证据要求上的差异。研究指出钙化、呼吸、大气再补充、反事实产量、收获后去向及碳储存持久性均制约碳汇声明，部分沉积型养殖环境虽观测到碳埋藏增强，但碳酸盐化学与系统层面分析不足以将常规贝类生产认定为可核证的海洋碳移除（marine CO2 removal）。作者提出治理序列：界定干预与基线、按声明类型评估证据、分别报告移除与避免排放、并将经济表现与可执行的社会生态保障一并评估，强调气候声明须以实证碳结果为前提。

papers.title: A Pathway to Sustainable Development: The Relationship Between Fishery Digitalization and the Green Transformation of Fisheries
papers.authors: Li, Haohui; Li, Sihang; Tu, Yubo; Zhong, Changbiao
papers.abstract: Using panel data from 30 Chinese provinces spanning 2011–2024, this study assesses the digitalization and green transformation of fisheries using the entropy-weighted TOPSIS method and the super-efficiency epsilon-based measure (EBM) model, respectively. A two-way fixed-effects model is then employed to examine the relationship between the digitalization and green transformation of fisheries. The results reveal a positive association that persists across a series of robustness and endogeneity checks. Analysis of potential mediating channels indicates positive indirect associations through aquaculture intensification, aquatic product processing efficiency, and fishery industrial structure upgrading, whereas the fishing efficiency channel is not statistically supported. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the positive association is stronger in Eastern China and becomes more pronounced as regional innovation and human capital levels increase. Spatial analysis further reveals spatial dependence in the green transformation of fisheries and a positive association between local fishery digitalization and the green transformation of fisheries in neighboring regions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2011–2024年中国30个省份面板数据，采用熵权TOPSIS法与超效率EBM模型分别测度渔业数字化与绿色转型水平，并运用双向固定效应模型检验二者关系。结果表明渔业数字化与绿色转型呈显著正相关，且通过水产养殖集约化、水产品加工效率及渔业产业结构升级发挥中介作用，而捕捞效率渠道不显著。异质性分析显示该正向关联在东部地区及区域创新与人力资本水平较高处更强，空间分析进一步揭示渔业绿色转型存在空间依赖性，本地渔业数字化对邻近地区绿色转型具有正向溢出效应。

papers.title: Assessing selectivity and bycatch of endangered, threatened and protected species in artisanal tuna fisheries in the NE Atlantic
papers.authors: Louzao, Maite; Oyarzabal, Iñaki; Onandia, Iñigo; Ruiz, Jon; Astarloa, Amaia; García-Barón, Isabel; Cotano, Unai; Uriarte, Andrés
papers.abstract: Fisheries bycatch is a recognised pressure on marine megafauna, prompting international agreements to mandate monitoring and mitigation of impacts. The International Commission for the Conservation of Atlantic Tunas (ICCAT) specifically calls for systematic data collection on Endangered, Threatened and Protected species (ETPs), particularly in data-deficient regions. To address this need, the Spanish artisanal tuna fishery—comprising trolling and pole-and-line métiers —implemented an onboard observer programme in 2016 to document ETP bycatch in the Northeast Atlantic, an important migratory and overwintering area for marine megafauna. Our aims were to (1) assess fishery selectivity through catch and discard composition, (2) describe ETP species occurring in the fishing grounds and (3) characterise ETP bycatch events, including their frequency, the number of individuals involved per event, and the condition of animals upon release. The fishery showed high selectivity, with >99% of recorded catches consisting of target tuna species. Observers documented 18 ETP species occurring around fishing vessels (three marine mammals and 15 seabirds), illustrating substantial megafauna richness in the fishing grounds. ETP bycatch was limited to three seabird species: great shearwater Ardenna gravis , northern gannet Morus bassanus and northern fulmar Fulmarus glacialis . Great shearwaters accounted for most individuals recorded and were occasionally captured in events involving several birds during trolling operations, whereas northern gannets were recorded only in pole-and-line operations, where events consistently involved few individuals. A total of 52 individuals from three seabird species were recorded in 22 bycatch events, most of which were released alive. Spatial patterns reflected known species ecology, with shearwater bycatch concentrated in oceanic waters and gannet bycatch occurring primarily in shelf-slope areas. These findings provide the first systematic characterisation of ETP species occurrence and bycatch in this artisanal tuna fishery, supplying essential baseline information for ICCAT and supporting the development of monitoring approaches and management actions to reduce risks to ETP species in the Northeast Atlantic.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过2016年起在东北大西洋西班牙手工金枪鱼渔业（拖钓和竿钓作业）实施的船上观察员计划，评估渔获与丢弃物组成以衡量渔具选择性，并记录濒危、受威胁和保护物种（ETP）的出现及兼捕特征。结果显示该渔业选择性极高，目标金枪鱼物种占渔获的99%以上；观察员记录到18种ETP物种（3种海洋哺乳动物和15种海鸟），但兼捕仅涉及3种海鸟——大鹱（Ardenna gravis）、北鲣鸟（Morus bassanus）和暴风鹱（Fulmarus glacialis），共22次兼捕事件、52只个体，多数释放时存活。大鹱兼捕集中于大洋水域且拖钓作业中偶见多只同时捕获，北鲣鸟兼捕仅见于竿钓作业且主要分布于陆架坡折区。该研究首次系统描述了该手工金枪鱼渔业中ETP物种的出现与兼捕情况，为ICCAT提供了关键基线信息。

papers.title: Identification and Characterization of a Cathepsin B Protease in the Marine Fish Parasite Cryptocaryon irritans
papers.authors: Chi, Hongshu; Pan, Ying; Liu, Xiaodong; Lin, Nengfeng; Jiang, Qiuhuan; Gong, Hui; Zhang, Ziping
papers.abstract: Cryptocaryon irritans, an obligate ectoparasite, causes cryptocaryoniasis and heavy economic losses to marine aquaculture. Cathepsin B (CatB) is highly expressed in C. irritans theronts and hypothesized to participate in parasite host invasion, yet its biochemical properties and pathogenic roles remain poorly defined. In this study, we performed bioinformatic analysis of the CiCatB gene. Following codon optimization, CiCatB was heterologously expressed in Pichia pastoris, and the biologically active recombinant CiCatB protein was purified. Subcellular localization analysis revealed that CiCatB predominantly localized in the cytoplasm of theronts, with partial signals detected at the cell membrane and in the extracellular space. Enzymatic assays showed that yCiCatB hydrolyzed gelatin and type I collagen from large yellow croaker, with optimum activity at pH 5.0 and stable performance from 28 to 37 °C. Mg2+ increased enzyme activity, while Cu2+ almost completely abolished catalytic activity. Both E-64 and anti-CiCatB serum inhibited enzyme activity. Functional blocking using inhibitor or antiserum markedly reduced parasite recovery following challenge. Our results suggest that CiCatB may contribute to host invasion by degrading host structural proteins, advancing our understanding of C. irritans pathogenicity. CiCatB represents a potential target for exploring control strategies against cryptocaryoniasis.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究对海洋鱼类寄生虫刺激隐核虫（Cryptocaryon irritans）的组织蛋白酶B（Cathepsin B, CatB）进行了基因生物信息学分析，并经密码子优化后在毕赤酵母中异源表达并纯化了具有生物活性的重组CiCatB蛋白。亚细胞定位显示CiCatB主要分布于滋养体细胞质，部分信号见于细胞膜和胞外空间；酶学实验表明重组酶可水解明胶和大黄鱼I型胶原蛋白，最适pH为5.0，在28–37 °C稳定，Mg²⁺增强活性而Cu²⁺几乎完全抑制活性，E-64和抗CiCatB血清均能抑制酶活。使用抑制剂或抗血清进行功能阻断可显著降低攻毒后寄生虫的回收率，提示CiCatB可能通过降解宿主结构蛋白参与宿主入侵，是探索刺激隐核虫病防控策略的潜在靶点。
