papers.title: Integrated technology for processing salmonid fish milt to obtain biologically active DNA and hyaluronidase
papers.authors: Gerasimchik, Georgii; Mukhametshina, Ekaterina; Kuprina, Elena; Gupalo, Tatyana; Pratsiuk, Olga; Broiko, Yuliya; Shestopalova, Irina
papers.journal: Bioactive Compounds in Health and Disease - Online ISSN 2574-0334 Print ISSN 2769-2426
papers.abstract: Introduction: Fish milt is currently used predominantly as a culinary product, despite containing numerous biologically active compounds with high value-added potential, including nucleoproteins, enzymes, and proteins. Its integrated processing creates an opportunity to recover biologically valuable compounds, including DNA and hyaluronidase, within a single technological cycle. Objective: To develop an integrated technology for the processing of fish milt with the sequential recovery of DNA and hyaluronidase while preserving their target properties. Materials and Methods: Frozen fish milt was mechanically homogenized and extracted at reduced temperature with acetic acid using a raw material-to-extractant ratio of 1:2. Following centrifugation, the soluble fraction containing hyaluronidase was clarified and concentrated by ultrafiltration. The precipitate containing the DNA–protein complex was hydrolyzed with trypsin at a water-to-precipitate-to-trypsin ratio of 2:1:0.3 and subsequently centrifuged to isolate the DNA fraction. Hyaluronidase activity was determined using a pharmacopeial method. The enzyme-containing fraction was additionally characterized by Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy. DNA quality was assessed by spectrophotometry; residual protein in the DNA fraction was quantified using the micro-biuret method, and the preparation was additionally characterized by infrared spectroscopy. The yields of DNA and the hyaluronidase-containing fraction were determined using a rapid drying method at 170 °C. Results: The developed technological scheme enabled recovery of the target products from a single raw material. The DNA yield was 11.3% of the initial raw material mass. The final fraction contained 60–65% DNA, and the A260/A280 ratio ranged from 1.80 to 1.90, indicating relatively high purity. The yield of the hyaluronidase-containing fraction was 4.8% of the initial raw material mass on a dry-weight basis. Ultrafiltration increased specific activity of hyaluronidase-containing fraction 1.77-fold, from 1375 to 2437 IU/mg. Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy confirmed the proteinaceous nature of the enzyme-containing preparation. Novelty of the Study: This study proposes an integrated technological scheme for fish milt processing that enables the sequential recovery of a hyaluronidase-containing fraction and a DNA fraction from a single raw material. The use of ultrafiltration as a concentration step increases enzyme activity without requiring expensive chromatographic purification, thereby improving the practical feasibility of the process. Conclusions: The proposed technology enables rational utilization of fish milt as a secondary biological raw material and allows recovery of biologically valuable DNA and a hyaluronidase-containing fraction within a single production cycle. The developed approach is technologically feasible and promising for further application in biotechnology, food processing, and pharmaceutical production. Keywords: fish milt, DNA, hyaluronidase, ultrafiltration, integrated processing, bioactive compounds.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在开发一种鱼精 integrated processing 技术，在同一工艺周期内依次提取 DNA 和 hyaluronidase。方法包括低温乙酸提取、离心、超滤浓缩含酶组分，以及胰蛋白酶水解 DNA-蛋白复合物沉淀后分离 DNA。结果显示 DNA 得率为原料质量的 11.3%（纯度 A260/A280 为 1.80–1.90），hyaluronidase 组分得率为 4.8%（干重），超滤使比活提高 1.77 倍至 2437 IU/mg。该工艺无需昂贵色谱纯化即可提升酶活，为鱼精作为 secondary biological raw material 的高值化利用提供了可行方案。

papers.title: Optimization Production of Hydrolyzed Protein of Fish from Milkfish Scales Enzymatically Using Response Surface Methodology (RSM)

papers.abstract: This study optimized HPF production from milkfish scales via enzymatic hydrolysis using commercial papain, employing Response Surface Methodology (RSM) with the Box-Behnken model. The three factors were enzyme concentration (0.23, 0.31, and 0.38 U), incubation temperature (40, 60, and 80 °C), and incubation time (1, 3, and 5 h). The predicted optimal condition was 0.31 U of papain at 60 °C for 3 h, yielding 13.40% HPF. Under this condition, HPF solubility was 89.25 ± 2.45%, and soluble protein content was 0.30 ± 0.01 mg/mL. Cadmium content was 0.07 mg/kg, whereas lead content was 0.89 mg/kg. Antioxidant inhibition reached 25.25 ± 0.41% at 5,000 ppm and 40.19 ± 1.78% inhibition at 10,000 ppm, equivalent to 0.23 and 0.36 mM Trolox, respectively.

papers.title: Comparative distribution of antimicrobial resistance genes in non-typhoidal Salmonella from chicken and aquaculture production systems, 2010–2025: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Bahadur, Sami Ullah Khan; Rao, Sangeeta; Talib, Usman; Ferri, Anna; Zaheer, Muhammad Usman; Salman, Mo
papers.abstract: Abstract To compare the prevalence and distribution of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) genes in non-typhoidal Salmonella from chicken and aquaculture production systems and assess regional and temporal patterns of resistance genes, six databases were searched for studies published between 2010 and 2025 reporting AMR genes in non-typhoidal Salmonella. Seventy-six studies met the inclusion criteria, including 68 from chicken and eight from aquaculture. Random-effects meta-analysis was used to estimate pooled prevalence. Pooled Salmonella prevalence was 21.0% (95% CI 15.3–28.2) in chicken and 44.3% (95% CI 22.6–68.4) in aquaculture, although aquaculture estimates were based on fewer studies. Resistance genes associated with tetracyclines, β-lactams and sulfonamides were frequently detected, particularly tet(A), blaTEM, blaCTX and sul2. Chicken isolates showed substantial regional heterogeneity, with higher prevalence in the Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia regions. Prevalence of selected genes, including tet(A), sul2, aadA and qnrS, increased across sampling periods. Overlapping AMR gene profiles across chicken and aquaculture suggest interconnected resistance reservoirs that may increase opportunities for human exposure through the food chain, highlighting the importance of integrated AMR surveillance and antimicrobial stewardship strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 该系统综述与meta分析比较了2010–2025年鸡源与水产养殖源非伤寒沙门氏菌中AMR基因的流行率与分布，并评估其区域和时间趋势。共纳入76项研究（鸡68项、水产8项），采用随机效应模型估计合并流行率。鸡源沙门氏菌合并流行率为21.0%，水产源为44.3%（后者研究数较少）；tet(A)、blaTEM、blaCTX和sul2等四环素类、β-内酰胺类和磺胺类耐药基因检出频繁，鸡源分离株存在明显区域异质性，且tet(A)、sul2、aadA和qnrS等基因流行率随时间上升。两系统间AMR基因谱重叠，提示存在相互关联的耐药储库，凸显整合性AMR监测与抗菌药物管理策略的重要性。

papers.title: Design and Field Evaluation of a Portable IoT-Based Water Quality Monitoring System for Mud Crab Aquaculture
papers.authors: Rachmat, Fayyaza Naira Sophan; Muhammad, Abdul Kadir; Mukhtar, Mukhtar
papers.abstract: Water quality monitoring is important for maintaining suitable environmental conditions in mud crab (Scylla serrata) aquaculture. Conventional monitoring is commonly performed manually and does not provide continuous observation or automatic data recording when network connectivity is unavailable. This study presents a portable Internet of Things (IoT)-based water quality monitoring system for measuring pH, electrical conductivity (EC), salinity, dissolved oxygen (DO), and temperature. The system employs an Arduino Nano with an ADS1115 16-bit ADC for sensor data acquisition and an ESP32 for wireless communication. Measurement data are displayed locally, transmitted through MQTT to a Node-RED dashboard, and stored on an SD card to support offline data logging. Sensor calibration and system testing were followed by approximately seven hours of field monitoring at the Marana Silvofishery Pond Installation, Maros, South Sulawesi. The field results showed pH values of 7.42–8.07 with an average of 7.76, EC of 39.97–41.25 mS/cm with an average of 40.68 mS/cm, salinity of 27.98–28.88 ppt with an average of 28.48 ppt, DO of 4.75–6.06 mg/L with an average of 5.39 mg/L, and temperature of 28.75–29.81 °C with an average of 29.41 °C. The pH sensor produced an average error of 0.28% during calibration, while the EC sensor produced an error of 0.16% against a 12.88 mS/cm standard solution. The system successfully recorded measurement data in online and offline conditions and displayed the measurements on the monitoring dashboard. The results demonstrate that the developed portable system can support continuous field-oriented water quality monitoring in mud crab aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究设计了一套基于IoT的便携式水质监测系统，用于青蟹（Scylla serrata）养殖中pH、电导率（EC）、盐度、溶解氧（DO）和温度的测量，采用Arduino Nano配合ADS1115 16位ADC采集数据、ESP32进行无线通信，并通过MQTT传输至Node-RED仪表板及SD卡实现离线数据记录。系统经传感器校准后在印尼南苏拉威西Maros的Silvofishery池塘开展了约7小时现场监测，pH平均7.76、EC平均40.68 mS/cm、盐度平均28.48 ppt、DO平均5.39 mg/L、温度平均29.41 °C，pH与EC传感器校准平均误差分别为0.28%和0.16%。系统在在线与离线条件下均成功记录并显示数据，表明该便携系统可支持青蟹养殖的现场连续水质监测。

papers.title: Assessment of Dietary Sources in a Tropical Coastal Fish (Blackspotted Croaker Protonibea diacanthus)
papers.authors: Randall, Jo; Kaestli, Mirjam; Adair, Brendan; Wedd, Dion; Gibb, Karen; Kopf, Keller; Roberts, Brien H.; King, Alison J.; Saunders, Thor M.; Brewer, Elizabeth A.
papers.abstract: Abstract Energy and nutrients from rivers and coastal floodplains are widely recognised as key drivers of productivity in coastal marine food webs, but these inputs may increase productivity for some species while having negligible or negative effects on others. Understanding the sources of nutrition supporting commercially important fishes is therefore critical for effective management. Here, we quantify the relative contribution of terrestrial, freshwater, and marine resources to the diet of the marine sciaenid Protonibea diacanthus in the wet–dry tropics of northern Australia. Bulk stable isotopes (δ¹³C, δ¹⁵N, δ³⁴S) and compound-specific stable isotope analysis of essential amino acids (δ¹³C) were used to resolve trophic pathways, alongside microbial source tracking to assess the influence of freshwater and marine water sources at aggregation sites. Across all approaches, results consistently indicated a dominant reliance on marine-derived resources. Mixing models identified marine sources, particularly marine fish, as the primary contributors to diet, while CSIA-AA independently demonstrated that carbon supporting P. diacanthus was overwhelmingly marine in origin. There was little evidence of freshwater or terrestrial influence in either trophic pathways or microbial assemblages, regardless of season or proximity to river outflows. These findings contrast with studies of other tropical fisheries species that show strong positive relationships with freshwater flow, and suggest that the nutrition of P. diacanthus is supported primarily by marine trophic pathways rather than riverine subsidies. This study highlights the need for caution when generalising the role of freshwater inputs across species and emphasises the importance of species-specific trophic dynamics in coastal ecosystem management.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在量化陆源、淡水和海洋资源对澳大利亚北部热带海岸经济鱼类黑斑白姑鱼（Protonibea diacanthus）饵料来源的相对贡献。采用bulk稳定同位素（δ¹³C、δ¹⁵N、δ³⁴S）、必需氨基酸compound-specific isotope analysis（CSIA-AA）及微生物源追踪技术解析营养途径。结果显示该鱼主要依赖海洋来源资源，尤其是海洋鱼类，未发现淡水或陆源输入的显著影响，且不受季节或河流排出距离影响。研究表明该鱼营养由海洋营养途径主导而非河流补贴，提示在海岸生态系统管理中应谨慎推广淡水输入作用的物种普适性结论。

papers.title: Processing–Property Relationships in Fish Protein Hydrolysates: From Controlled Hydrolysis and Peptidomics to Sensory Performance and Translational Readiness
papers.authors: Gubaidullin, Nurtay; Gajimuradova, Aisarat; Syzdykova, Alfiya; Zhumalin, Aibek; Igenbayev, Aidyn; Zhaskairat, Shynaray; Azhgereeva, Zhulduz; Makangali, Kadyrzhan
papers.abstract: Fish processing generates protein-rich side streams representing 30–70% of whole-fish mass, creating potential for production of fish protein hydrolysates (FPHs). However, their translation into food or nutraceutical ingredients is limited by variable feedstocks, incomplete process reporting and an evidence base dominated by in vitro assays. This review examines how feedstock origin and pre-analytical quality, controlled enzymatic hydrolysis and downstream processing determine peptide composition and techno-functional, sensory and biological performance. It also evaluates peptidomic workflows and grades evidence from chemical assays through randomized human interventions. Across the reviewed literature, FPHs emerge as heterogeneous, lot-defined products rather than a uniform ingredient class. Maximum degree of hydrolysis is not a universally optimal endpoint: extensive proteolysis may improve solubility and assay responses while reducing protein recovery, interfacial functionality and sensory acceptability. Peptide numbers and candidate sequences depend on liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry (LC–MS/MS) acquisition, database selection, search strategy and false-discovery control. In silico predictions therefore require confirmation with synthetic standards, targeted quantification in the hydrolysate and evaluation of gastrointestinal stability and intestinal transport. Human findings remain limited and inconsistent, precluding class-wide health claims. Translation is further constrained by matrix-dependent acceptable doses and product-specific risks related to contaminants, biogenic amines, microbial and oxidative stability, residual protease activity and allergens. This review proposes minimum reporting requirements and an application-driven translational readiness framework linking feedstock qualification, reproducible processing, molecular identity, biological exposure, matrix compatibility, safety, pilot-scale manufacture and human validation. This approach is required to develop standardized FPHs that deliver prespecified benefits at safe, consumer-acceptable doses while remaining economically and environmentally feasible.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统梳理鱼蛋白水解物（FPH）从原料来源、受控酶解与下游加工到肽组学、感官及生物性能的加工—性质关系，指出FPH实为批次依赖的异质性产品而非均一配料类别，最大水解度并非普适最优终点（过度水解可提升溶解性却降低蛋白回收率、界面功能与感官可接受性）。肽组学结果高度依赖LC–MS/MS采集、数据库与搜索策略及FDR控制，in silico预测须经标准品确认、水解物靶向定量及胃肠道稳定性与肠道转运评估。人体证据有限且不一致，尚不足以支持类别级健康声称，转化还受基质依赖有效剂量及污染物、生物胺、微生物与氧化稳定性、残留蛋白酶活性和过敏原等产品特异性风险制约；作者据此提出最低报告要求与以应用为导向的translational readiness框架。

papers.title: Variability and Drivers of the Feeding Guild Structure of Small Pelagic Fishes in the Western North Pacific Ocean During 1980–2022
papers.authors: Yatsu, Akihiko; Yukami, Ryuuji; Ubukata, Hiroki; Sakurai, Yasunori; Watanabe, Kazuyoshi; Wada, Tokio
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Pacific stocks of Japanese anchovy ( Engraulis japonicus ), chub mackerel ( Scomber japonicus ), Japanese sardine ( Sardinops melanostictus ), and Pacific saury ( Cololabis saira ) are dominant small pelagic fishes sharing common food (zooplankton) in the western North Pacific, thus forming a feeding guild. Here, we present temporal changes in the guild structure based on their biomass and recruitment trajectories with nonmetric multidimensional scaling (NMDS) and cluster analyses. NMDS outputs were compared with harvest rates (HR) and environmental indices. These results on biomass indicated that (1) the sardine‐dominated era (1980s) was characterized by a positive Pacific Decadal Oscillation Index and Siberian High Index, southward Oyashio, and low sardine HR, (2) anchovy‐dominated era (1900s–2000s) was characterized by the opposite environment and high sardine HR, and (3) mackerel‐dominated and saury‐depleted era (2010s–) was characterized by low mackerel HR and high HR of saury and anchovy. Results for recruitment were similar to those for biomass but not identical. Published knowledge on interspecies interactions among the feeding guild suggests that the effects of sardine and mackerel are prevailing; specifically predation by sardine on zooplankton may decrease the carrying capacity of the feeding guild. The four guild species shared a common feeding habitat along a temperature gradient with slight differences in their optimum temperatures. The previously suggested interspecies competition hypothesis for space between sardine and mackerel was not supported by the present results. Environment, fishing, and interspecies interactions (excluding spatial competition) are considered key factors in the variability of the guild structure, and marine heatwaves may increase uncertainties in assessing the future environmental effects.
papers.summary_cn: 研究基于1980–2022年西北太平洋日本鳀（Engraulis japonicus）、日本鲭（Scomber japonicus）、日本沙丁鱼（Sardinops melanostictus）和秋刀鱼（Cololabis saira）的生物量与补充量轨迹，采用NMDS和聚类分析揭示摄食guild结构的年代际变化，并与harvest rate（HR）及环境指数比较。结果表明：1980年代沙丁鱼主导期对应PDO正相位、西伯利亚高压偏强、亲潮南侵及低沙丁鱼HR；1990s–2000s鳀主导期环境相反且沙丁鱼HR高；2010s以来为鲭主导、秋刀鱼衰退期，伴随鲭低HR及秋刀鱼和鳀高HR。补充量结果与生物量类似但不完全一致，种间互作中以沙丁鱼和鲭的影响为主，沙丁鱼对浮游动物的捕食可能降低guild的环境容纳量，而空间竞争假说未获支持；环境、捕捞和种间互作（除空间竞争外）是guild结构变异的关键因素，marine heatwaves增加了未来环境效应评估的不确定性。

papers.title: New Insights Into the Spatial Zones of High Scomberomorus sierra Habitat Suitability in the Eastern Pacific Ocean Based on Ecological Niche Modeling
papers.authors: Marín‐Enríquez, Emigdio; Cruz‐Escalona, Víctor H.; Burgos‐Vázquez, María I.; Valladares‐Alfonso, Liesvy; del Pino‐Machado, Arturo
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Understanding the environmental niche and potential distribution of the Pacific sierra ( Scomberomorus sierra ) is critical for fisheries management across the eastern Pacific Ocean (EPO). We used MaxEnt to model S. sierra habitat suitability across the EPO (30° N–30° S to 120° W) using 169 vetted occurrence records and monthly CMEMS environmental layers (2004–2018): sea surface temperature (Temp), sea surface salinity (Sal), surface geostrophic currents (UCOMP, VCOMP), mixed layer depth (MLD), and sea surface anomalies (SSA). Models were tuned with ENMeval (20 feature/regularization combinations) and evaluated with AUC and AICc. The best model (linear–quadratic features, RM = 1) had AUC = 0.846. Variable importance (percent contribution and permutation importance) identified SSA, Temp, and MLD as primary drivers of habitat suitability. Predicted high‐suitability areas occur off northern Mexico including the Gulf of California, in the Gulfs of Tehuantepec and Panama (as a continuous band below ~10° N), and as a coastal/insular band off Ecuador–Peru extending toward the Galapagos. Clustering of pixels with probabilities of occurrence > 0.67 revealed four environmentally distinct high‐suitability zones: northern (Mexico–Gulf of California; deeper MLD), Tehuantepec (distinct surface‐current regime), central (Colombia–Central America; warmer, lower salinity), and southern (Ecuador–northern Peru and Galápagos; cooler, higher salinity). These findings suggest environmental heterogeneity may underlie regional variations in habitat use and have implications for regionally tailored management and monitoring. Future work should integrate life‐stage data, finer resolution oceanographic drivers, and genetic or movement data to test population connectivity and improve management‐relevant projections.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用MaxEnt生态位模型，结合169条经验证的分布记录与2004–2018年CMEMS环境图层（海表温度、盐度、地转流、混合层深度及海表异常），对东太平洋（EPO）马鲛（Scomberomorus sierra）的栖息地适宜性进行空间建模，最优模型AUC=0.846。海表异常、温度和混合层深度是栖息地适宜性的主要驱动因子。高适宜区分布于墨西哥北部及加利福尼亚湾、特万特佩克湾与巴拿马湾（约10°N以南呈连续带）以及厄瓜多尔–秘鲁沿岸至加拉帕戈斯的沿岸/岛屿带。基于出现概率>0.67的像素聚类识别出四个环境特征迥异的高适宜区（北部、特万特佩克、中部和南部），提示环境异质性可能驱动区域间栖息地利用差异，对区域化管理与监测具有参考意义。

papers.title: Gender‐Based Violence in Pacific Fisheries
papers.authors: Mangubhai, Sangeeta; Barclay, Kate M.; Makhoul, Natalie; Houng Lee, Gina
papers.journal: New Zealand Journal of Marine and Freshwater Research
papers.abstract: Coastal and offshore fisheries play a vital role in the Pacific Island economies, food security and cultural heritage. While the past two decades has seen increased recognition of gender dimensions of fisheries, managers, practitioners and industry partners have not yet tackled the problem of gender‐based violence (GBV) in the sector. Empirical research of GBV across Pacific fisheries is necessary to prevent the sector from inadvertently exacerbating violence, as well as to actively combat it. We conducted a scoping review to synthesise the evidence of GBV within formal and informal fisheries, including along value chains in the Pacific Island region, and to identify research gaps and interventions that should be prioritised for the sector. GBV in fisheries has been documented in five main areas: (1) industrial fishing; (2) ports and transhipment areas; (3) fish factories and canneries; (4) small‐scale fishing; and (5) seafood markets and in the home. GBV impacted various fisheries actors, and was often exacerbated by structural inequities, societal norms and a hypermasculine work culture. Physically demanding environments and rigid gender roles perpetuated exclusion and harmful behaviours, impacting economic stability, health and safety. The review underscores the urgent need for research and targeted interventions to address the issue of GBV within Pacific fisheries, considering different nodes along value chains.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过范围综述（scoping review）综合了太平洋岛国区域正规与非正规渔业（含价值链各环节）中性别暴力（GBV）的现有证据，旨在识别研究空白与优先干预方向。GBV主要见于五个领域：工业捕捞、港口与转运区、鱼类加工厂与罐头厂、小规模渔业、海产品市场及家庭。结构性不平等、社会规范和过度男性化的工作文化往往加剧了GBV，对渔业从业者的经济稳定、健康与安全造成负面影响。综述强调亟需针对太平洋渔业价值链不同节点开展研究与针对性干预。

papers.title: Effects of fisheries on the foraging habitat selection of chick-rearing black-browed albatrosses
papers.authors: Becker, Sarah L.; Ventura, Francesco; Collet, Julien; Delord, Karine; Doak, Daniel F.; Brooks, Cassandra M.; Gasco, Nicolas; Barbraud, Christophe; Jenouvrier, Stephanie; Weimerskirch, Henri
papers.summary_cn: 研究聚焦渔业活动对育雏期黑眉信天翁（black-browed albatrosses）觅食栖息地选择的影响。由于摘要缺失，具体方法与结果无法获知，建议查阅全文以了解渔业干扰与海鸟觅食行为间的关联机制。

papers.title: Effects of dietary marine protein hydrolysates derived from fisheries processing by-products on growth performance, innate immunity, digestive capacity, intestinal health and disease resistance against Edwardsiella piscicida of olive flounder (Paralichthys olivaceus)
papers.authors: Jayathilake, Nalika; Kim, Suhyeok; Hasanthi, Mirasha; Levallois, Thomas; Lee, Kyeong-Jun
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以牙鲆（Paralichthys olivaceus）为对象，评估由渔业加工副产物制备的海洋蛋白水解物作为饲料添加剂的效果。通过饲养试验测定生长性能、先天免疫、消化能力、肠道健康及抗 Edwardsiella piscicida 感染能力。

papers.title: Fish Responses to Total Dissolved Gas Supersaturation: From the Perspective of Historical Experimental Data in the Upper Yangtze River
papers.authors: Rao, Jianing; Pan, Rongxuan; Wang, Yuanming; Feng, Jingjie; Li, Xintong; Li, Kefeng
papers.abstract: During discharge from high dams, the high-velocity water flows mix with air, causing downstream total dissolved gas (TDG) supersaturation, threatening fish survival. However, a systematic understanding on fish response patterns under the coupled influence of multiple environmental and biological factors remains limited. This study synthesized historical experimental data to explore fish tolerance and avoidance in response to TDG supersaturation in the upper Yangtze River. Economic fish species demonstrated overall stronger tolerance than the rare fish species under all TDG levels. Significant interspecific differences in economic fish tolerance were observed with increasing TDG levels. Aristichthys nobilis demonstrated stronger tolerance than Hypophthalmichthys molitrix. For the rare fish, Procypris rabaudi showed the weakest tolerance. Exposure time, TDG level, species and water temperature were identified as the primary factors influencing fish mortality. Based on these, mortality prediction formulas for rare and economic fish were established, achieving an R2 over 0.59. The avoidance ability of fish increased significantly with increasing TDG levels and reached 50% at 130% TDG. Significant interspecific differences in fish avoidance were observed at a 140% TDG level or above, and Schizothorax prenanti showed the weakest avoidance ability. TDG level was the dominant factor influencing fish avoidance ability, followed by body length. Accordingly, a prediction formula for fish avoidance rates was proposed with an R2 of 0.88. The findings offer critical insights for ecological risk management and the development of fish conservation strategies downstream of high dams.
papers.summary_cn: 研究整合长江上游历史实验数据，分析鱼类对总溶解气体（TDG）过饱和的耐受与回避行为。经济鱼类在各TDG水平下耐受性总体强于珍稀鱼类，且种间差异随TDG升高而显著（鳙强于鲢）；珍稀鱼类中岩原鲤耐受性最弱。暴露时间、TDG水平、物种和水温是影响死亡率的主要因素，据此建立的死亡率预测公式R²>0.59；鱼类回避能力随TDG升高显著增强，130% TDG时回避率达50%，140%以上种间差异显著（齐口裂腹鱼最弱），TDG水平为主导因素、体长次之，回避率预测公式R²=0.88。

papers.title: Schooling Fish May Have Just One Influencer
papers.authors: Schirber, Michael
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨鱼群中是否存在单一“影响者”主导群体行为，属于鱼类集群行为的理论/模型研究，与渔业资源评估或管理无直接关联。

papers.title: Advance more drugs for China’s aquaculture
papers.authors: Pan, Houjun; Wang, Qing
papers.summary_cn: 该文呼吁为中国水产养殖研发更多药物，以应对养殖病害防控需求。

papers.title: Navigating Blue Risk: Divergent Pathways in Tasmanian Aquaculture
papers.authors: Condie, Corrine; Hobday, Alistair; Lacey, Justine; Kelly, Rachel; Condie, Scott
papers.abstract: The blue economy is commonly framed as a pathway to sustainability, promising the reconciliation of economic growth with environmental protection and social equity. In practice, however, industries seeking to operate <em>blue</em> face significant challenges translating high-level principles into practice. The study examines how the Tasmanian aquaculture sector (i.e., salmon, oyster, and seaweed industries) operationalise blue economy principles on the ground, and where gaps and burdens emerge. Survey data were drawn from the <em>CSIRO Tasmanian Coastal Waters and Seas Survey 2025</em>, a statewide stakeholder survey (<em>n</em> = 931). Results suggest widespread stakeholder concern in relation to environmental decline, strong expectations for transparency and accountability, and low perceived public influence over marine decision-making. While these conditions appear to have intensified social risk, the response by industry has been varied and includes enhanced environmental monitoring, regulatory compliance beyond minimum requirements, third-party certification, community engagement, and investment in mitigation and adaptation measures. However, stakeholder perceptions of the effectiveness and legitimacy of these actions vary markedly. Salmon aquaculture remains highly contested, with polarised views reflecting tensions around environmental performance and governance, while oyster and seaweed farming sit in lower conflict but more uncertain spaces. The findings suggest that navigating social risk in the blue economy requires industry-specific strategies that extend beyond formal policy alignment and regulatory compliance to provide the nuance and innovation needed to address cumulative impacts, accountability, and community expectations.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2025年塔斯马尼亚沿海水域与海洋调查（n=931）的问卷数据，考察三文鱼、牡蛎和海藻养殖业如何将blue economy原则落地实施，并识别其中的差距与负担。结果显示，利益相关者普遍关注环境退化，对透明度和问责制期望较高，但认为公众对海洋决策影响力低。三文鱼养殖仍高度争议、观点两极分化，牡蛎和海藻养殖冲突较低但不确定性更大；行业应对措施（环境监测、超规合规、第三方认证、社区参与等）的感知有效性和合法性差异显著。研究认为，blue economy中的社会风险治理需超越政策对齐与合规，采取行业特异性策略以应对累积影响、问责制和社区期望。

papers.title: Identifying Strategic Drivers and Development Priorities for Sustainable Pearl Lobster Grow-Out Aquaculture: An Integrated MICMAC-AHP Framework
papers.authors: Haj, Muhammad Hairul; Baso, Aris; Adhawati, Sri Suro
papers.abstract: The sustainable farming of pearl lobsters (Panulirus ornatus) demands strategic measures that account for institutional, economic, ecological, technological, and social factors. This study identifies the main strategic drivers of sustainable grow-out aquaculture and prioritizes development interventions in South Sulawesi, Indonesia. Data were obtained from 54 key informants representing government agencies, researchers, extension officers, exporters, collectors, aquaculture workers, and coastal communities through interviews, focus-group discussions, observations, and structured questionnaires. The Matrix of Cross-Impact Multiplications Applied to Classification (MICMAC) was used to identify structural drivers, while the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) was used to establish relative development priorities. The direct MICMAC analysis identified Regulatory Framework as linkage variables, while Multi-Actor Coordination and Aquaculture Innovation occupied the linkage position. The AHP results (CR = 0.047) assigned the highest criterion weight to institutional factors (0.339), followed by economic (0.242), technological (0.154), ecological (0.154), and social (0.111) factors. The highest global priorities were Multi-Actor Coordination (0.176), Regulatory Framework (0.163), Production Cost (0.109), and Aquaculture Innovation (0.100). The integrated MICMAC–AHP framework indicates that governance capacity, coordination, and technological innovation are important leverage points for sustainable pearl lobster grow-out aquaculture in South Sulawesi.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在识别印尼南苏拉威西珍珠龙虾（Panulirus ornatus）可持续养成 aquaculture 的战略驱动因子并确定发展优先序。通过54名关键知情人访谈、焦点小组讨论和结构化问卷获取数据，采用 MICMAC 方法识别结构驱动变量，结合 AHP 确定发展优先序。MICMAC 分析将 Regulatory Framework、Multi-Actor Coordination 和 Aquaculture Innovation 归为 linkage 变量；AHP 结果显示制度因素权重最高（0.339），其次为经济（0.242）、技术（0.154）、生态（0.154）和社会因素（0.111），全球优先序最高的干预措施为 Multi-Actor Coordination（0.176）、Regulatory Framework（0.163）、Production Cost（0.109）和 Aquaculture Innovation（0.100）。研究表明治理能力、多主体协调与技术创新是南苏拉威西珍珠龙虾可持续养成 aquaculture 的关键杠杆点。

papers.title: Aquaculture Wastewater as a Feedstock for Functional Seaweed Polysaccharides: Linking Nutrient Recovery, Macromolecular Architecture and Agricultural Valorization
papers.authors: Herrera-Moreno, Maria Nancy; Renganathan, Prabhaharan; Rueda-Puente, Edgar Omar; García-Rodríguez, Luis Daniel; Montoya-Mejía, Magnolia; Sainz-Hernandez, Juan Carlos
papers.abstract: Aquaculture wastewater supplies nutrients for seaweed cultivation, but its suitability for producing functional polysaccharides remains uncertain. This critical review examines the evidence connecting wastewater composition, nutrient assimilation, polysaccharide production, macromolecular architecture, and agricultural performance. Studies of wastewater-grown seaweeds were compared with controlled cultivation, extraction, and agricultural application studies, with attention to nitrogen and phosphorus availability, C:N balance, salinity, and dissolved inorganic carbon. Evidence indicates that nutrient enrichment can improve biomass production without corresponding increases in polysaccharide yield. Measurements linking wastewater chemistry to molecular weight distribution, monosaccharide composition, sulfation, and polymer conformation remain scarce. Differences among species, growth conditions, and nutrient exposure regimes complicate comparisons across studies. Extraction and purification can alter polymer characteristics, limiting the attribution of observed differences to cultivation conditions. Reported agricultural responses may depend on polymer structure and formulation. However, the independent effects of molecular weight and other structural descriptors remain poorly established experimentally. Contaminant transfer from wastewater to purified products and subsequent exposure of soil and crops are inadequately characterized. Future research should combine matched wastewater and conventional cultivation controls, standardized extraction, polymer characterization, contaminant mass balances, and dose–response bioassays. Integrated economic and environmental assessment is also required before product safety, functional equivalence, and practical feasibility can be established.
papers.summary_cn: 综述探讨水产养殖废水作为功能性海藻多糖生产原料的可行性，重点分析废水组成、养分同化、多糖产量、大分子结构及农业应用效果之间的关联。通过比较废水培养与受控培养、提取及农业应用研究，发现养分富集可提高生物量但未必增加多糖产量，且废水化学特征与分子量分布、单糖组成、硫酸化及聚合物构象之间的定量关联数据仍十分匮乏。提取纯化过程可能改变聚合物特性，污染物从废水向纯化产品及土壤-作物系统的转移亦缺乏充分表征。未来需结合匹配对照实验、标准化提取、聚合物表征、污染物质量平衡及剂量-效应生物测定，并开展经济与环境综合评价，以确证产品安全性与功能等效性。

papers.title: Elucidating the relationships between host-associated (intestinal and gill) and environmental (water and sand) microbial communities across water exchange rates in Babylonia areolata aquaculture
papers.authors: Tang, Di; Tu, Zhigang; Liu, Hongtao; Yu, Feng; Zou, Weiguang; Shen, Minghui
papers.abstract: Water exchange is linked to survival in aquaculture, but its relationship with host–environment microbial interactions remains unclear. We aimed to characterize host-associated and environmental microbiota in Babylonia areolata (ivory shell) aquaculture, focusing on community relationships, environmental source contributions, associations with water quality, and host survival across water exchange rates. Ivory shells were reared for 60 days at high (100% d −1 ), medium (50% d −1 ), and low (0% d −1 ) water exchange rates. On day 60, water, sand, intestinal, and gill samples (12 samples per treatment) were profiled using 16S rRNA gene V3-V4 amplicon sequencing. The results showed that survival was lower only in the low-exchange group ( p &lt; 0.001). Analysis of similarities (ANOSIM) showed that the host microbiota differed significantly from environmental communities (R = 0.739, p = 0.001). SourceTracker identified sand as the largest environmental contributor; its contribution declined from 48.0 to 21.0% in the intestine and from 65.7 to 30.2% in the gills as the water exchange rate decreased. Reduced water exchange rates were also associated with declines in the relative abundance of intestinal Nautella and gill-associated Ruegeria . Linear discriminant analysis effect size (LEfSe) identified Halodesulfovibrio as a shared biomarker in both tissues under low water exchange conditions. Redundancy analysis (RDA) identified NO 3 − -N and pH as the environmental variables most strongly associated with environmental microbial community structure. Exploratory genus-level correlations showed that rearing water pH was negatively associated with Halodesulfovibrio in both tissues. Collectively, these results indicate that the water exchange rate is associated with host-associated microbial community composition, environmental source contributions, and ivory shell survival. Future studies should investigate the mechanisms underlying the associations among environmental microbial communities, water quality conditions, and host survival, thereby informing microecological management in low water exchange aquaculture systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以象牙贝（Babylonia areolata）养殖为对象，设置高（100% d⁻¹）、中（50% d⁻¹）、低（0% d⁻¹）三档换水率进行60天养殖实验，采用16S rRNA基因V3-V4扩增子测序分析水体、沙、肠道和鳃的微生物群落。结果发现仅低换水组存活率显著降低，宿主微生物群落与环境群落差异显著，沙是最大的环境来源贡献者，且其贡献随换水率降低而下降。低换水还伴随肠道Nautella和鳃Ruegeria相对丰度下降，Halodesulfovibrio成为低换水条件下两种组织的共同生物标志物，NO₃⁻-N和pH是与环境微生物群落结构最相关的环境因子。研究表明换水率与宿主微生物群落组成、环境来源贡献及象牙贝存活相关。

papers.title: Modulation of Off-Flavor Compounds and Microbial Community Structure in Acrossocheilus fasciatus Aquaculture by Bacillus licheniformis Strain 23
papers.authors: Cui, Yanna; Xu, Lingwei; Liu, Xiao; Shao, Guojian; Yu, Juan; Hu, Mingyou; Shen, Yafang; Wang, Jiangqi; Hu, Qiuyue; Li, Yuanyuan
papers.abstract: Geosmin (GSM) and 2-methylisoborneol (2-MIB) are the primary off-flavor compounds in freshwater fish and can severely reduce product quality and market value. Biological regulation using probiotics has emerged as a promising eco-friendly strategy for controlling these off-flavors. In this study, Bacillus licheniformis strain 23 was applied to Acrossocheilus fasciatus culture systems through two practical modes: direct water spraying (water quality regulation group, A) and dietary supplementation (feed regulation group, S), with a control group (D) receiving no probiotic. GSM and 2-MIB concentrations in water and fish muscle were measured by HS-SPME-GC-MS, and microbial community structures in water and fish gut were analyzed by high-throughput sequencing of the 16S rRNA gene. Due to the limited number of available ponds, each treatment was applied to a single pond (n = 1 pond per treatment), and the three samples collected per group were spatial subsamples rather than independent biological replicates. Therefore, between-treatment comparisons are presented as descriptive and exploratory. Under the conditions tested, both treatments were associated with reduced GSM and 2-MIB levels in fish muscle and water. After 48 days, GSM and 2-MIB in the feed regulation group decreased to 0.754 μg/kg and 0.103 μg/kg, respectively, representing reductions of 46.8% and 63.2% compared with the control. The water quality regulation group showed a 52.9% reduction in GSM, while its 2-MIB did not differ markedly from that of the feed regulation group on day 48. Both treatments were associated with changes in microbial community structure. Water quality regulation increased species richness in the water and promoted chlorophyta and cyanobacteriota, whereas feed supplementation simplified the water community, with chlorophyta becoming overwhelmingly dominant. In the fish gut, water quality regulation induced marked community restructuring, characterized by a sharp decline in cyanobacteriota and an increase in Planctomycetota, whereas feed supplementation caused only moderate disturbance. Correlation analysis suggested that Geminiocystis PCC-6308 was strongly positively correlated with 2-MIB concentration, whereas several taxa within Pseudomonas and Planctomycetota were negatively correlated with off-flavor compounds. These findings suggest that B. licheniformis strain 23 may be useful for reducing earthy–musty off-flavors in A. fasciatus aquaculture by reshaping microbial communities. However, given the lack of independent pond-level replication, these results should be regarded as preliminary and hypothesis-generating, and further validation in replicated pond experiments is needed.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在探究地衣芽孢杆菌（Bacillus licheniformis）菌株23对带纹光唇鱼（Acrossocheilus fasciatus）养殖系统中异味化合物（GSM和2-MIB）及微生物群落结构的调控作用，采用水体喷洒和饲料添加两种实际应用模式，通过HS-SPME-GC-MS测定水体和鱼肌肉中异味物质浓度，并利用16S rRNA基因高通量测序分析水体和肠道微生物群落。结果显示，两种处理均与鱼肌肉和水体中GSM、2-MIB水平降低相关，饲料添加组48天后GSM和2-MIB分别降低46.8%和63.2%，水体调控组GSM降低52.9%；两种处理均改变了微生物群落结构，水体调控增加了水体物种丰富度，饲料添加则使绿藻门占据绝对优势。相关性分析表明Geminiocystis PCC-6308与2-MIB浓度呈强正相关，而Pseudomonas和Planctomycetota中多个类群与异味化合物呈负相关。由于缺乏独立池塘重复，上述结果应视为初步性和假设生成性的，需进一步在重复池塘实验中验证。

papers.title: Performance of Floating Chart in Utilization of Small Pelagic Fish Resources in Makassar Strait Waters, Donggala, Central Sulawesi
papers.authors: Rukka, Andi Heryanti; Masyahoro, Abdul; Riza, Femi
papers.abstract: Small-scale capture fisheries are important for utilizing small pelagic fish resources and sustaining coastal livelihoods. This study analyzes the effects of fishermen’s capabilities and operational effectiveness on small pelagic fish resource utilization and floating lift net performance in the Makassar Strait waters off Sabang Village, Balaesang District, Donggala Regency, Central Sulawesi, Indonesia. A quantitative explanatory approach with a cross-sectional design was employed. Primary data were collected from 300 fishermen directly involved in floating lift net operations using a structured five-point Likert-scale questionnaire and purposive sampling. Data were analyzed using Structural Equation Modeling-Partial Least Squares (SEM-PLS) with SmartPLS. The results show that fishermen’s capabilities positively affect operational effectiveness, resource utilization, and floating lift net performance. Operational effectiveness positively affects resource utilization but has no significant direct effect on floating lift net performance at the 5% level. Resource utilization positively affects performance and serves as a key mediating mechanism linking fishermen’s capabilities and operational effectiveness to performance. The model explains 42.5% of the variance in floating lift net performance. These findings highlight the importance of strengthening fishermen’s capabilities, improving operational effectiveness, and promoting productive, selective, and sustainable resource utilization.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于印度尼西亚望加锡海峡300名浮式升网（floating lift net）渔民的问卷调查数据，采用SEM-PLS分析渔民能力与作业有效性对小型中上层鱼类资源利用及浮式升网绩效的影响。结果表明，渔民能力正向影响作业有效性、资源利用和网具绩效；作业有效性正向影响资源利用，但对网具绩效无显著直接效应；资源利用是连接渔民能力、作业有效性与网具绩效的关键中介机制，模型解释了42.5%的绩效变异。研究强调提升渔民能力、改善作业有效性及促进选择性可持续资源利用的重要性。

papers.title: Some like it hot, but others might not: the implications of climate change for the conservation of South African freshwater crab species
papers.authors: Grobler, Petrus C. J.; Cumberlidge, Neil; van der Colff, Dewidine; Daniels, Savel R.
papers.abstract: Abstract Primary freshwater crabs are keystone aquatic species, yet the potential impact of climate change on their distribution and conservation status remains unknown, particularly in biodiversity-rich areas such as South Africa. We employed maximum entropy and climatic niche modelling to evaluate the effects of climate change on the distribution of 17 Potamonautes species in South Africa and estimate protected area coverage for suitable habitats under both current and future climate projections of increased temperature, and the impact on the conservation of these species. Our results indicate that six of the 17 species are likely to experience a net loss of suitable habitat, and seven are projected to experience net habitat gains. Habitat changes for four of the 17 species are dependent on the climate scenario applied. Under predicted temperature increases, P. barbarai and P. isimangaliso are expected to experience significant habitat reduction, with P. isimangaliso being sensitive as a result of substantial predicted losses in both suitable and protected habitat. Conversely, P. depressus , P. flavusjo and P. warreni appear to be the least sensitive to climate change, gaining suitable habitat under both climate models. Unsurprisingly, we found precipitation to be a critical predictor of suitable habitat as these crabs are dependent on freshwater ecosystems. Our results underscore the importance of conservation strategies tailored to the unique predicted response of each species to climate change.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用最大熵模型和气候生态位模型，评估气候变化对南非17种Potamonautes淡水蟹分布的影响，并估算当前与未来气候情景下适宜栖息地的保护区覆盖情况。结果显示，6种预计净丧失适宜栖息地，7种净增加，4种变化取决于气候情景；P. barbarai和P. isimangaliso在升温下栖息地显著缩减，后者因适宜及保护栖息地双重损失尤为敏感，而P. depressus、P. flavusjo和P. warreni对气候变化最不敏感。降水是适宜栖息地的关键预测因子，研究强调需针对各物种的差异化响应制定保护策略。

papers.title: Habitat Use and Foraging Activity as Behavioural Indicators of Thermal Stress in Juvenile Brook Trout (Salvelinus fontinalis)
papers.authors: Hannah, Claire M.; Cockburn, Jaclyn M. H.; Monczka, John; Noakes, Steve; Williams, David
papers.abstract: Across North America, Brook Trout (Salvelinus fontinalis) populations are declining in response to rising water temperatures, habitat degradation, and other environmental stressors. Behavioural responses such as changes in habitat use and foraging activity can provide early indicators of thermal stress, yet relatively few studies have examined both behaviours simultaneously in natural stream environments. We analyzed three years of publicly available Remote Underwater Video (RUV) footage collected by the Coalition for the West Credit River (CWCR), together with instream temperature records, to quantify juvenile Brook Trout habitat occupancy (MaxN) and foraging activity (s fish−1) within a coldwater reach of the West Credit River (Ontario, Canada). Occupancy within the monitored habitat increased when water temperatures exceeded commonly reported thermal thresholds for Brook Trout (>20 °C) and peaked during a prolonged summer heat event in 2025. In contrast, foraging activity declined under elevated temperatures and remained consistently low throughout the heat event. Together, these findings suggest that juvenile Brook Trout increasingly relied on the monitored habitat during periods of thermal stress while reducing foraging activity, indicating a behavioural trade-off between energy conservation and energy acquisition.
papers.summary_cn: 研究利用加拿大West Credit River冷水河段三年的Remote Underwater Video (RUV)影像与水温记录，量化幼体Brook Trout（Salvelinus fontinalis）的栖息地占用（MaxN）与摄食活动。结果显示，水温超过20 °C热阈值时占用率上升，并在2025年夏季持续高温事件中达到峰值，而摄食活动随温度升高而下降且在整个热事件期间维持低位。这表明幼鱼在热胁迫下更依赖监测栖息地并减少摄食，体现能量节约与能量获取之间的行为权衡。

papers.title: Saurichthys majiashanensis Tintori et al., 2014 from the Spathian (Lower Triassic) of China, a Predatory Fish with Asymmetrical Upward Thrust
papers.authors: Tintori, Andrea; Huang, Jian-Dong; Conedera, Davide; Liu, Li; Motani, Ryosuke; Tan, Yichen; Jiang, Da-Yong
papers.abstract: New, well-preserved specimens of Saurichthys majiashanensis Tintori et al., 2014 from the Majiashan quarry (Chaohu, Anhui Province, China) proved this species to be a powerful predatory fish reaching 1 m in length. The skull is very elongated, and the jaws bear teeth of different sizes but relatively small. Scales are arranged in four scale rows that are greatly enlarged in the caudal peduncle, almost totally enclosing it, improving its stiffness. Dorsal and anal fins are very large and show a peculiar free posterior lobe, similar to that of the dorsal fins of sharks, since the endoskeleton of both fins is missing in the posteriormost part, where large modified mid-dorsal and mid-ventral scales lie underneath the free-standing lobe (as it possibly occurs in several other Saurichthys species). The caudal fin is made of very large lobes, with the ventral lobe larger than the dorsal one, implying an upward thrust during the attack. This character appears to be a unique specialization among Saurichthys species and could be related to predation on organisms living near the surface.
papers.summary_cn: 马家山龙鱼（Saurichthys majiashanensis）为早三叠世Spathian期一种体长可达1 m的强力捕食性鱼类。其头骨极度延长，牙齿相对较小；尾部鳞列增大几乎完全包裹尾柄以增强刚度，背鳍和臀鳍具独特的游离后叶。尾鳍下叶大于上叶，暗示攻击时产生向上推力，此特化可能与其捕食近水面生物有关。

papers.title: Taxonomy‐informed hierarchical deep learning for otolith image identification in coral reef fishes
papers.authors: Kang, Zhipeng; Wang, Teng; Liu, Yu; Shen, Jianzhong; Xie, Hongyu; Ao, Xuefu; Dong, Xianghong; Liu, Yong
papers.abstract: Abstract Existing studies on automatic fish otolith identification have predominantly adopted classification frameworks that use species as the sole output level, limiting the effective use of hierarchical information embedded in fish taxonomy. In this study, using otolith images of coral reef fishes collected from the Qilianyu Islands, Xisha Islands, China, during 2020–2025, we developed a hierarchical deep learning model incorporating taxonomic constraints and compared it with a non‐hierarchical baseline model. Both models were trained, validated and tested on otolith images from 25 species, and the generalization performance of the hierarchical model was further evaluated on 33 species not included in model training. The results showed that the hierarchical model achieved higher recognition accuracy than the non‐hierarchical model at the family, genus and species levels, with species‐level accuracy improving from 94.80% to 98.00%. Both micro‐averaged and macro‐averaged metrics also improved, and misclassifications across families and genera were markedly reduced. UMAP and Grad‐CAM visualizations showed that the hierarchical model learned discriminative embedding features with clear species‐level separation, and that its high‐response regions were mainly concentrated along the otolith contour and local structural features. External validation further showed that, under unseen‐species conditions, the hierarchical model achieved strong species recognition with only a small number of support samples. Overall, these results show that taxonomic hierarchy constraints can improve otolith image identification and support the development of a biologically informed framework that is extensible to unseen species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于中国西沙群岛七连屿2020–2025年采集的珊瑚礁鱼类耳石图像，构建了融入分类学约束的层次化深度学习模型，并与非层次化基线模型进行对比。两种模型在25个物种的耳石图像上完成训练、验证和测试，层次化模型进一步在33个未参与训练的物种上评估泛化性能。结果显示，层次化模型在科、属、种水平的识别准确率均优于基线模型，种级准确率由94.80%提升至98.00%，跨科、跨属误分类明显减少；UMAP和Grad-CAM可视化表明模型学到了具明显种级分离度的判别性嵌入特征，高响应区域集中于耳石轮廓及局部结构特征。外部验证表明，在未见物种条件下，层次化模型仅需少量支持样本即可实现较强的物种识别能力，表明分类学层次约束可有效提升耳石图像识别性能，并支持构建可扩展至未见物种的生物学启发框架。

papers.title: Essential habitats are context-dependent for the cosmopolitan scalloped hammerhead shark (Sphyrna lewini)
papers.authors: Faul, Sasha I.; Lubitz, Nicolas; Dwyer, Ross G.; Sheaves, Marcus; Barnett, Adam
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.abstract: Abstract Essential habitats often shift throughout ontogeny as different life stages have distinct life history requirements. The scalloped hammerhead shark (Sphyrna lewini) is a cosmopolitan species known to undergo ontogenetic habitat shifts. However, the characteristics of habitats considered important for the species varies among and within geographic regions. While research into habitat use in scalloped hammerhead sharks has been extensively documented in the Eastern Tropical Pacific, information from other parts of their global range remains limited. To address this gap, we conducted a literature review to: (1) examine global similarities and differences in habitat use across ontogeny; (2) identify contextual drivers of variation in habitat use; and (3) identify plausible essential habitats in data-poor areas. Across regions, scalloped hammerheads appeared to follow two main life history strategies, where they used either predominantly coastal (Model 1) or offshore (Model 2) habitats. Both strategies were observed in all well-studied areas (e.g., the East Pacific) and were associated with environmental contexts, notably the proximity to oceanographic features related to either inshore or offshore habitats. Connectivity between both model scenarios was evident, especially between oceanic females and coastal nursery areas. By synthesising variation in habitat use across ontogeny, this review provides a framework and future directions for identifying essential habitats for threatened elasmobranchs in data-poor regions. Furthermore, this work highlights that environmental context can have a profound influence on the life cycle of a species and should be considered when defining essential habitats.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究通过文献综述，探讨了全球分布的路氏双髻鲨（Sphyrna lewini）在不同发育阶段的栖息地利用模式。研究发现该物种存在两种主要生活史策略：以近岸栖息地为主（Model 1）和以离岸栖息地为主（Model 2），两种策略在充分研究区域均有出现，并与环境背景（尤其是与近岸或离岸海洋学特征的距离）密切相关。研究还发现两种模式之间存在连通性，特别是大洋雌性与近岸育幼区之间的关联。该综述为数据匮乏区域中受威胁板鳃类 essential habitats 的识别提供了框架，并强调环境背景在定义 essential habitats 时的重要性。

papers.authors: Sayer, Carl D.; Tarkan, Ali Serhan; Emson, Dave; Patmore, Ian R.; Wesley, Keith J.; Greaves, Helen M.; Pearson, Luke; Grady, Roger; Wiseman, Glenn; Gamble, Graham
papers.abstract: Abstract Successful scientifically informed fish conservation requires a good knowledge of how fishes have and will be affected by multiple stresses over the decadal‐centennial timescales relevant to real‐life fish‐environment responses. By combining palaeoecological and monitoring data (regular sampling over 16 years), we studied the long‐term response of an English pond population of crucian carp ( Carassius carassius ) to environmental stress (likely anoxia) posed by episodic periods of duckweed (Lemnaceae) dominance. Despite at least three major phases of prolonged high duckweed cover, in addition to historically recorded low water events, crucian carp persisted in the study pond for at least two centuries until the present day. During the most recent duckweed phase (spanning 6 years – 1999–2005), the crucian carp population edged close to extinction, with a few large individuals surviving and an elimination of recruitment (or at least severely reduced recruitment) over 4 years. Crucian carp recruitment resumed 1 year post‐duckweed, however, and occurred at regular intervals subsequently leading to a population structure dominated by individuals of age 2–4 years. After 2002, a broader and more even population size and age structure was evident, suggestive of full recovery. The remarkable resilience of crucian carp to dense duckweed cover and likely associated anoxia is deserving of future research. Clearly, duckweed dominance in small hydrologically isolated ponds, as may be more prevalent under climate change, is one of the major threats to the crucian carp. Pond management aimed at decreasing tree canopy cover may help mitigate this by increasing surface wind movement of duckweed. Given multiple pressures on crucian carp populations throughout its range, we call for more active local‐scale conservation projects to help reverse its current decline.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究结合古生态学与16年定期监测数据，探讨英国东部一小池塘中鲫鱼（Carassius carassius）种群对浮萍（Lemnaceae）优势期所引发的环境胁迫（可能为缺氧）的长期响应。尽管经历至少三次浮萍长期覆盖高峰期及历史记录的低水位事件，鲫鱼在该池塘持续存在至少两个世纪。1999–2005年浮萍覆盖的6年间种群濒临灭绝，补充量中断约4年，但浮萍消退1年后补充恢复，随后形成以2–4龄个体为主的种群结构，2002年后种群规模和年龄结构趋于完整，显示完全恢复。研究表明鲫鱼对密集浮萍覆盖及相关缺氧具有显著恢复力，而浮萍在小型的、水文隔离的池塘中占优势（在气候变化下可能更为普遍）是鲫鱼的主要威胁之一，建议通过减少树冠覆盖以增加水面风力推动浮萍移动的池塘管理措施加以缓解。

papers.title: FUTURE PERSPECTIVES OF CARBON QUANTUM DOTS: SYNTHESIS, APPLICATIONS, AND ENVIRONMENTAL IMPLICATIONS IN AQUACULTURE
papers.authors: Marlinda, Shella; Octavera, Anna; Ariyatna, Harits Atika; Effendi, Irzal; Rohmy, Sulasy; Miranti, Shavika; Nuryati, Sri; Alimuddin
papers.abstract: ARTICLE HIGLIGHTS- Carbon quantum dots enable sustainable applications in modern aquaculture- Biomass-derived carbon dots support green synthesis and circular economy- Fluorescent carbon dots enable rapid sensing of pollutants in aquatic systems- Carbon dots support bioimaging, antimicrobial activity, and gene delivery- Toxicity risks highlight the need for safety standards and life cycle assessment ABSTRACTCarbon quantum dots (CQDs) have emerged as promising carbon-based nanomaterials owing to their excellent optical properties, high biocompatibility, and versatile synthesis routes. Recent research trends have shifted from fundamental synthesis and characterization to functional applications in bioimaging, biosensing, biomedical therapy, food safety, and aquaculture. Green synthesis using renewable biomass has become the dominant approach, supporting circular economy concepts while reducing hazardous waste. Numerous studies demonstrate that CQDs can act as sensitive sensors for heavy metals and pollutants, stable probes for cellular and in vivo imaging, antimicrobial agents, and efficient nanocarriers for drug and gene delivery. Despite these advances, toxicological findings reveal that CQDs may induce oxidative stress, developmental abnormalities, and ecological risks in aquatic organisms, particularly at high concentrations or when heteroatom-doped. Moreover, the absence of specific regulations highlights the urgent need for standardized safety protocols and life-cycle assessments. This review outlines the progress, applications, challenges, and regulatory considerations of CQDs, emphasizing their potential role in advancing sustainable biotechnology and modern aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述碳量子点（CQDs）的合成、应用及其在水产养殖中的环境风险。CQDs因优异光学性能和高生物相容性，已从基础合成表征转向生物成像、生物传感、抗菌及药物/基因递送等功能应用，基于生物质的绿色合成成为主流。研究表明CQDs可灵敏检测重金属与污染物，但毒理学发现其在高浓度或杂原子掺杂时可能引发氧化应激、发育异常及生态风险。目前缺乏专门法规，亟需建立标准化安全规范与生命周期评估。
