papers.title: Fishery monitoring reveals a rare and seasonal occurrence of the threatened tope shark Galeorhinus galeus (Linnaeus, 1758) within a restricted bathymetric range in the state of Santa Catarina, southern Brazil
papers.authors: Santos, P. R. S.; Vasconcellos, J. C. S.; Maribelto, R.; Lebedeff, V.; Cenci, H.; Rodrigues‐Filho, J. L.
papers.abstract: Abstract This study aimed to report new records of the tope shark Galeorhinus galeus , a critically endangered species in Brazil, based on onboard monitoring of artisanal bottom gillnet fisheries in southern Brazil, emphasizing its seasonal occurrence and strong association with a narrow depth range. Data were collected between 2021 and 2025 across 168 monitored fishing operations. A total of 14 individuals were recorded in only eight operations, suggesting the contemporary occurrence of the species in the region, where it was consistently recorded at low frequency throughout the monitoring period. All captures were restricted to winter and early spring and occurred within a narrow bathymetric range (48–52 m). Only juveniles were recorded, with similar proportions of males and females. These findings indicate that, despite its rarity, the species continues to use the region in a highly specific and seasonal manner. Overall, the results highlight the importance of continuous fishery monitoring for detecting remnant populations and emphasize the relevance of specific coastal habitats for the conservation of this threatened species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2021—2025年对巴西南部圣卡塔琳娜州手工底刺网渔业的168次随船监测，报道了极危物种翅鲨（Galeorhinus galeus）的新记录。共在8次作业中记录到14尾个体，出现频率低，且全部集中于冬季至初春、水深48–52 m的狭窄范围，均为幼鱼，雌雄比例相近。结果表明该物种虽稀有，仍以高度特异的季节性和水深偏好利用该区域，凸显了持续渔业监测对发现残存种群及沿海特定生境保护的重要性。

papers.authors: Lu, Qifeng; Zhang, Huai; Liu, Junhui; Jiang, Liqi; Zhang, Han; Lin, Li; Li, Qingqing
papers.abstract: Abstract Food deprivation is a pre‐harvest management practice that can alter body composition and muscle quality in cultured fish. This study compared growth performance, physiological indices, histological characteristics, muscle texture, proximate, fatty acid and amino acid content between food‐deprived and normally fed Oreochromis niloticus over a 30‐day period. Food deprivation significantly reduced specific growth rate (SGR), and liver somatic index (LSI) after 15 days and body weight (BW), weight gain rate (WGR), SGR, viscerosomatic index (VSI) and LSI after 30 days ( p < 0.05), whereas condition factor (CF) and visceral fat index (VAI) did not differ significantly between treatments. There were no significant changes in activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD), glutathione peroxidase (GSH‐Px) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) after food deprivation. Muscle hardness was significantly greater in food‐deprived O. niloticus than in normally fed O. niloticus after 15 days ( p < 0.05). Micrographs from food‐deprived O. niloticus showed liver cells to be slightly irregular in shape, with some showing signs of dispersion and vacuolization; in addition, the intestine showed substantially more pronounced vacuolation, enlarged intercellular spaces and shortened villi compared with normally fed fish. Muscle crude protein content was significantly higher in food‐deprived O. niloticus than in normally fed O. niloticus ( p < 0.05); however, this increase may partly reflect a relative concentration effect associated with lipid depletion rather than an increase in absolute protein deposition. Serine and tyrosine concentrations were significantly higher after 15 days of food deprivation than in normally fed fish; the reverse was seen for total lipid content ( p < 0.05). After 30 days of food deprivation, muscle n‐3 PUFA content was significantly lower, whereas the n‐6/n‐3 PUFA ratio was significantly higher, than in normally fed fish ( p < 0.05). These findings indicate that a 30‐day food deprivation period reduced growth performance and altered muscle composition and texture, while producing only limited changes in the physiological indicators examined.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）为对象，比较了30天禁食与正常投喂组在生长性能、生理指标、组织学特征及肌肉品质上的差异。禁食显著降低了15天后的SGR和LSI以及30天后的BW、WGR、SGR、VSI和LSI，而CF和VAI无显著变化；SOD、GSH-Px和AST活性亦无显著改变。禁食15天后肌肉硬度显著升高，肝细胞形态轻度不规则并出现空泡化，肠道绒毛缩短、细胞间隙增大；肌肉粗蛋白含量升高（部分为脂质消耗所致的相对浓缩效应），总脂含量下降，30天后n-3 PUFA降低、n-6/n-3比值升高。结果表明30天禁食抑制生长并改变肌肉组成与质地，但对所测生理指标影响有限。

papers.title: AI-Assisted Transcription of Handwritten and Audio Data in Fisheries
papers.authors: Fisk, Jonathan M.; Chaney, Sam; Kim, Hae; Ligon, Day B.; Parnell, Todd B.; Phelps, Quinton E.
papers.abstract: Natural resource agencies routinely collect handwritten and audio field data that must be transcribed before analysis, creating a persistent bottleneck in data management. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) may help automate portions of this work, yet their utility in routine fisheries applications remains largely untested. We evaluated commercially available AI-assisted workflows against standard manual transcription. The evaluation considered total processing time and initial transcription accuracy. Across the AI pilot datasets, initial accuracy averaged 97% for handwritten records and 95% for audio recordings. After quality control, the AI-assisted workflows reduced total processing time by approximately 37% for handwritten transcription and 49% for audio transcription. The larger operational datasets produced reductions of approximately 30% and 57%, respectively. Initial accuracy for the larger handwritten dataset declined to 82.3%, but all identified errors were corrected during quality control. These findings show that commercially available AI can improve a time-intensive aspect of natural resource data management without specialized programming or custom software. Incorporating AI-assisted transcription into existing workflows can reduce administrative workload and move field observations into management and research applications sooner.
papers.summary_cn: 研究评估商用AI辅助转录流程在渔业手写与音频野外数据中的应用效果，以总处理时间和初始转录准确率为指标，与人工转录进行对比。AI试点数据集的初始准确率分别为手写记录97%、音频记录95%；经质量控制后，总处理时间分别缩短约37%和49%。较大规模业务数据集的处理时间缩减约30%和57%，其中手写数据集初始准确率降至82.3%，但所有识别错误均在质量控制中得到纠正。结果表明，无需专门编程或定制软件即可将AI辅助转录整合进现有工作流程，从而减少行政负担并加快野外观测数据进入管理与研究应用。

papers.title: Pacific Tuna Fisheries Value-Chain Opportunities
papers.authors: Bennett, Michael; March, Antaya; Li, Hanjin; Greer, Ray; Failler, Pierre
papers.abstract: The Western and Central Pacific Ocean (WCPO) supports the largest tuna fishery in the world and provides most of the global catch of albacore, bigeye, skipjack, and yellowfin tuna. The WCPO tuna fisheries are critical for the development prospects of Pacific Island Countries (PICs) and other territories, as they have limited other economically valuable resources to harness. Socio-economic development across various PICs is hindered by the inability to harness the maximum potential of these fisheries, in particular through the lack of identifying targeted development needs for this industry. The aim of this paper is thus to identify priority development opportunities for the value-chains of WCPO tuna fisheries, such that additional value can be extracted from existing and emerging tuna fisheries products, for the benefit of PICs. An adopted segmentation methodology, developed by the World Bank, was used to identify five value-chains: canned tuna; environmentally friendly canned tuna; ultra-low temperature tuna; chilled tuna exports; and premium chilled tuna and bottom-fish export (collectively). Porter’s Five Forces framework was used as the basis for value-chain analyses, from which strategic repositioning considerations and areas for investment support were identified. Harnessing greater return from access fees to national fishing grounds, the development of a secondary market for trading fishery access rights, facilitating sustainability certification, facilitating airfreight connections, and the development of phytosanitary standards for import and export have been identified for external investment support.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在识别中西太平洋（WCPO）金枪鱼渔业价值链的优先发展机会，以期为太平洋岛国（PICs）从现有及新兴金枪鱼产品中获取更多价值。采用世界银行的分段方法识别出五条价值链：罐装金枪鱼、环保罐装金枪鱼、超低温金枪鱼、冰鲜金枪鱼出口以及高端冰鲜金枪鱼与底鱼出口，并运用Porter五力框架进行价值链分析。研究提出战略重新定位考量及外部投资支持领域，包括提高国家渔场准入费回报、发展捕捞权交易二级市场、推动可持续认证、改善空运连接及制定进出口植物检疫标准。

papers.title: Three ‘Generations’ of Compliance Studies in Fisheries– and Four Clusters of Enforcement Studies
papers.authors: Hønneland, Geir
papers.abstract: The article provides an overview of three ‘generations’ of social science literature on compliance in fisheries: the ‘basic deterrence model’, which emphasises strict enforcement of regulations; the ‘enriched model’, which brings in legitimacy and morality as determinants of compliance; and the ‘multi-dimensional models’, which question the assumption that compliance can be explained by a stable set of individual motivations and that behaviour can be divided straightforwardly into compliance and non-compliance. Non-compliance is assumed to result from an interaction between a motivated actor and an opportunity to violate the rules. Economic motivations, personal morality and perceptions of legitimacy remain relevant, but their effects are mediated by the actor’s surroundings. The article then identifies four strands of literature on fisheries enforcement: the (bio-)economic literature, the legal and ‘blue crime’ literature, the literature on new technology in fisheries enforcement, and the literature on the organisation of enforcement agencies and enforcement styles, which builds on the ‘enriched’ and ‘multi-dimensional’ models of compliance. The latter resonates with the assumptions and findings of the three ‘generations’ of compliance studies: from deterrence via communication to nudges. Communication implies that compliance is negotiated, not simply imposed. Nudges seek to encourage voluntary compliance through positive reinforcement or indirect suggestion.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述渔业合规社会科学文献的三代发展：基础威慑模型强调严格执法；丰富模型引入合法性与道德作为合规决定因素；多维模型质疑合规可由稳定个体动机解释及行为可简单二分为合规与不合规的假设，认为不合规源于有动机行为者与违规机会的交互，经济动机、个人道德和合法性感知仍相关但受行为者环境影响。文章进而识别渔业执法研究的四个方向：(生物)经济学文献、法律与“blue crime”文献、渔业执法新技术文献，以及执法机构组织与执法风格文献，后者基于丰富模型和多维模型，与三代合规研究的假设和发现相呼应，即从威慑经沟通到nudges：沟通意味着合规是协商而非强加的，nudges则通过正向强化或间接暗示鼓励自愿合规。

papers.title: Cumulative thermal stress predicts functional change in coral reef fish communities
papers.authors: Markey, Anthony C.; Fordham, Damien A.; Stuart-Smith, Rick D.; Edgar, Graham J.; Brown, Christopher J.; Mellin, Camille
papers.journal: Proceedings of the Royal Society B: Biological Sciences
papers.abstract: Abstract Marine heatwaves are altering coral reef fish communities through a combination of direct impacts of thermal stress and indirect impacts that degrade coral habitats. Impacts may vary for species in different functional groups (e.g. herbivore replacement of corallivores), altering the functional composition of fish communities that is critical to reef resilience. However, our understanding of trait-based responses of fish communities to marine heatwaves is inadequate, and mostly inferred from local scales and low numbers of species. Here, we use a Bayesian joint species distribution model based on data for 500 fish species from 286 sites surveyed across northern Australia to evaluate the impacts of marine heatwaves on species probability of occurrence and their interactions with four functional traits. The effects of degree heating weeks and coral loss on individual species probability of occurrence had the highest total and proportionally negative responses, respectively. Thermal affinity's positive response to cumulative heat stress (i.e. degree heating weeks) was the strongest trait effect. Community-level analyses predicted losses in habitat specialists, large-bodied fishes, corallivores and pelagic feeders along a gradient of marine heatwave stress. The loss and restructuring of functional diversity suggest that heatwaves will continue eroding fish-dependent ecological roles and associated ecosystem services.
papers.summary_cn: 研究利用基于澳大利亚北部286个站点500种鱼类的贝叶斯联合物种分布模型，评估海洋热浪对珊瑚礁鱼类出现概率及其与四个功能性状交互作用的影响。累积热应激（degree heating weeks）和珊瑚损失分别对单个物种出现概率产生最大的总负效应和比例负效应，热亲和性对累积热应激的正响应是最强的性状效应。群落水平分析预测，沿热浪胁迫梯度，栖息地专性种、大型鱼、珊瑚食性鱼和中上层摄食者将减少，功能多样性的丧失与重构表明热浪将持续侵蚀鱼类依赖的生态角色及相关生态系统服务。

papers.title: Comparing fish brains
papers.authors: Le Bras, Alexandra
papers.summary_cn: 该文比较不同鱼类脑部结构，属神经生物学范畴，与渔业资源、养殖或管理无直接关联。非渔业相关。

papers.title: Comparative analysis of the biochemical composition of commercial fish species and justification of the technology for producing fish paste enriched with omega-3
papers.authors: Borodulin, D. M.; Ustinova, Yu. V.
papers.abstract: Fish and fish products are an integral part of a balanced human diet, serving as a source of complete animal protein, polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs), vitamins (D, B12), and essential minerals (iodine, selenium, phosphorus). In this regard, the aim of the research is to conduct a comparative analysis of the biochemical composition and nutritional value of commercial fish species in order to subsequently substantiate and develop a formulation for a fish paste enriched with omega-3 PUFAs, while assessing the effect of cavitation processing on the quality of the finished product. The article presents the results of a comparative analysis of the biochemical composition and nutritional value of commercial fish (pollock, cod, mackerel), which serves as the basis for justifying the selection of a combined fish raw material. This approach makes it possible to balance the protein-lipid ratio, improve the organoleptic properties, and ensure the functional orientation of the developed ready-to-consume product – a fish paste enriched with omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids. The product formulation has been developed using mathematical modeling in the “MultiMit Expert” system. Measurements of the structural and mechanical viscosity using the ST-2 structure meter and the SV-100 viscometer show that the fish paste exhibits typical pseudoplastic behavior for paste-like products and requires greater force to create the same deformation. Studies using the Oxitest device show that the experimental sample of fish paste, produced using cavitation treatment of the water-fat emulsion, had higher oxidative stability compared to the control sample. It has been established that applying cavitation treatment to an aqueous-fat emulsion (60 s, 80 % power, 120 W) promotes a more uniform distribution of the lipid phase in the protein base, which is confirmed by an improvement in the structural-mechanical properties (a 21.5 % reduction in ultimate shear stress, a 16.1 % increase in elastic deformation) and an increase in the product’s oxidative stability (an increase in the induction period by 19.8 %). The developed formulation of the enriched omega-3 fish paste makes it possible to produce a product with a rich amino acid and fatty acid composition, which makes it attractive to consumers in terms of its functional properties.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了狭鳕、鳕鱼和鲭鱼等商业鱼种的生化组成与营养价值，以期为富含omega-3多不饱和脂肪酸（PUFA）的鱼酱配方开发提供依据。采用MultiMit Expert系统进行数学建模优化配方，并评估空化处理（60 s、80%功率、120 W）对水脂乳液的改性效果。结果表明，空化处理促进了脂相在蛋白基质中的均匀分布，极限剪切应力降低21.5%、弹性变形增加16.1%，氧化诱导期延长19.8%，产品氧化稳定性显著提高。所开发鱼酱兼具丰富的氨基酸与脂肪酸组成及良好的功能特性。

papers.title: Microplastic Contamination of Marine and Freshwater Fish in Nigeria: Occurrence, Particle Characteristics, Distribution, Ecological Implications and Human-health Concerns
papers.authors: Aborisade, Abiodun Bukunmi; Ajayi, Funmilayo Juliana; Adetutu, Adewale
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: Nigeria combines a large burden of mismanaged plastic waste with strong dietary reliance on fish, which makes the contamination of fish by microplastics a question of ecological and public-health relevance. Field studies on Nigerian fish have multiplied since the first report from a municipal water-supply lake, yet earlier syntheses either predate most of this evidence or pool fish with water, sediment, salt and other matrices. This critical narrative review evaluates what the fish-specific evidence supports. Literature published from 2004 onward was identified through international bibliographic databases, a regional African journal platform, institutional sources and citation tracking, and each study was appraised qualitatively for sampling design, contamination control, polymer confirmation, reporting units, taxonomic reliability and exposure assumptions. Microplastics have been reported in fish from coastal waters, lagoons, estuaries, rivers, reservoirs, burrow pits and markets across most geopolitical zones, with fibres, filaments and fragments of polyethylene, polypropylene and polyethylene terephthalate recurring most often. Reported burdens span several orders of magnitude, a spread driven at least as much by differences in tissue analysed, lower size limits, units and identification practice as by environmental gradients. Several high values rest on visual counting without spectroscopic confirmation or procedural blanks, and some studies report taxa whose occurrence in the sampled waters requires verification. Links between particle burdens and habitat, feeding guild, season and trophic position are plausible but inconsistent and derive mainly from small, single-season samples. Laboratory work on African catfish demonstrates oxidative, hepatic, haematological and behavioural responses at exposures far above most field concentrations, whereas field biomarker studies remain correlative and confounded by co-occurring contaminants. Dietary intake estimates differ by about six orders of magnitude because they rest on incompatible assumptions about edible tissue, consumption and normalisation. The evidence supports the conclusion that Nigerian fish are widely exposed to microplastics, but claims of population-level ecological harm or quantifiable human-health risk remain unsubstantiated. Harmonised, spectroscopically confirmed monitoring of edible tissues, processed fish and aquaculture products is the most pressing need.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统评估了尼日利亚鱼类微塑料污染的鱼类特异性证据，通过国际文献数据库、非洲区域期刊平台及引文追踪检索2004年以来文献，并对采样设计、污染控制、聚合物确证、报告单位、分类可靠性和暴露假设进行定性评价。研究发现，微塑料已在尼日利亚多数地缘政治区的沿海水域、潟湖、河口、河流、水库、坑塘和市场鱼类中被报道，以聚乙烯、聚丙烯和聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯的纤维、丝状物和碎片最为常见；但报道的负荷跨越数个数量级，差异至少同样源于组织类型、下限粒径、单位和鉴定方法的不同。若干高值依赖无光谱确证或程序空白的目视计数，粒径负荷与生境、摄食 guild、季节和营养级的关系虽合理但不一致，非洲鲶鱼实验室研究显示的氧化、肝脏、血液和行为响应暴露浓度远高于多数野外浓度，膳食摄入估算因可食组织、消费量和归一化假设不兼容而相差约六个数量级。证据支持尼日利亚鱼类广泛暴露于微塑料的结论，但种群水平生态危害或可量化人类健康风险的主张仍缺乏确证，亟需对可食组织、加工鱼品和水产养殖产品开展统一、光谱确证的监测。

papers.title: Perspectives for Integral Utilization of Crickets in Aquaculture
papers.authors: Alvarez-Alvarez, Oscar Rodolfo; Garcia-Clark, Jesus Guadalupe; Fraijo-Valenzuela, Aldo; Rodriguez-Anaya, Libia Zulema; Díaz-Tenorio, Lourdes Mariana; Gortáres-Moroyoqui, Pablo; Gonzalez-Galaviz, Jose Reyes
papers.abstract: Cricket meal is increasingly considered a sustainable alternative to fishmeal in aquaculture, although its performance depends on the effective use of nutritional and functional components. This review examines evidence on including cricket meal in aquafeeds and the factors that may limit or enhance its application. Species-dependent responses to fishmeal replacement are discussed in relation to polyunsaturated fatty acid imbalance and chitin content. Strategies to improve lipid functionality include defatting, enriching the cricket’s rearing substrate to promote ω-3 fatty acid bioaccumulation, microbial fatty acid biotransformation, and enzymatic interesterification. The review also evaluates chitin and chitosan as health-promoting compounds with prebiotic, immunomodulatory, antimicrobial, antioxidant, and water-quality-related functions. Finally, fermentation and enzymatic hydrolysis are considered as tools to improve nutrient bioavailability. Overall, the integrated utilization of cricket meal components may increase its nutritional value, functional performance, and suitability as an aquaculture feed ingredient.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述蟋蟀粉作为鱼粉可持续替代品在水产饲料中的应用前景。文章分析了替代效果受养殖物种、多不饱和脂肪酸失衡及几丁质含量的影响，并评述了脱脂、养殖基质富集ω-3、微生物脂肪酸转化和酶法酯交换等改善脂质功能的策略。同时评估了几丁质和壳聚糖的益生、免疫调节、抗菌、抗氧化及水质调节功能，以及发酵和酶解提升营养生物利用度的作用。综合各组分利用可提高蟋蟀粉的营养价值、功能性能及其作为水产饲料原料的适用性。

papers.title: Toward Intelligent and Climate-Resilient Coastal Aquaculture: A Systematic Review Integrating Ecosystem Health, Marine Biotechnology, One Health, Data-Driven Technologies, and the Blue Economy
papers.authors: Jeujanan, Anggelina; Afidah, Fini; Eksan, Moh. Sofyan; Nurhasanah, Yuli; Amahoru, Abd. Haji; Dewi, Shilfi Rohmatika; Asnawi, Raden Ayu Nurul Faizah Azzahra; Dwiputri, Renata Armelya; Natasa, Rina; Hijriyati, Nikita Nur
papers.abstract: Background Coastal aquaculture is increasingly exposed to climate change, water-quality deterioration, disease risk, and demands for sustainable production. Evidence on ecosystem condition, biological resilience, marine biotechnology, One Health, digital technologies, and the blue economy remains fragmented across disciplines. This review integrated these domains within a common resilience framework. Methods Following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 statement, Scopus and PubMed were searched for English-language journal articles published from 2016 to 2 October 2026. Searches identified 5,439 records; 2,686 duplicates were removed, 2,753 unique records were screened, and 283 reports with verified full text were assessed. Twenty-two reports were excluded, leaving 261 studies for descriptive and thematic synthesis across six primary domains. Meta-analysis was not undertaken because of substantial heterogeneity in study designs and outcomes. Results The final synthesis comprised ecosystem, climate, and physical pressures (n = 25); biological, nutritional, molecular, and genetic resilience (n = 70); marine biotechnology and circular bioremediation (n = 32); One Health, biosecurity, and food safety (n = 53); data-driven and intelligent technologies (n = 50); and blue-economy, governance, and adoption (n = 31). Biological resilience, health protection, and intelligent monitoring were the largest evidence areas. Biotechnology supported nutrient removal and resource recovery, while governance, financing, markets, and capacity shaped implementation. Methodological appraisal classified 10.0% of studies as lower concern, 56.7% as some concern, and 33.3% as higher concern. Artificial light at night/light pollution emerged as a plausible but underexamined physical stressor rather than a separately searched exposure. Conclusions Climate-resilient coastal aquaculture is best treated as a coupled ecological, biological, health, technological, and socioeconomic system. Progress requires integrated environmental monitoring, resilient organisms, preventive health management, circular biotechnology, externally validated decision technologies, and enabling governance, with targeted research on nocturnal light environments.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述旨在整合生态系统健康、海洋生物技术、One Health、数据驱动技术与蓝色经济等分散领域，构建气候韧性海岸养殖的统一框架。按PRISMA 2020在Scopus和PubMed检索2016年至2026年10月的文献，最终纳入261项研究，分属六个主题域，因设计与结局异质性大未做meta-analysis。生物韧性、健康防护与智能监测证据最丰富，生物技术支撑营养盐去除与资源回收，治理、融资、市场与能力建设制约实施。人工夜间光照/光污染被视为可能但研究不足的物理胁迫因子。

papers.title: Bridging Extension and industry needs in Northeastern United States aquaculture to strengthen competency development
papers.authors: Silvert, Colby J.; Gordon, Zachary; Asamoah, Brilliant; Badger, Danny; Yue, Ian T.; Pattillo, D. Allen; McIntosh, Dennis
papers.abstract: Aquaculture extension and outreach professionals in the Northeastern United States are working in a sector shaped by evolving industry needs, workforce turnover, and complex position requirements. This study employed a mixed-methods design to converge findings from an extension competency assessment, an aquaculture industry needs assessment, and an evaluation of a professional development program targeting aquaculture extension professionals. Across these data sources, aquaculture extension professionals identified priority gaps in constituent engagement, project management, external funding, meeting facilitation, behavior change, and evaluation. Industry respondents identified disease management and regulatory navigation as the highest-priority extension support topics and reported generally positive satisfaction with extension services. Professional development participants self-reported increased knowledge across meeting facilitation, program evaluation, and engaging underrepresented communities, as well as improved regional connectedness. Findings provide baseline evidence that can inform aquaculture extension onboarding, professional development, and regional network-building. We recommend that aquaculture extension leaders and educators prioritize professional development in facilitation, evaluation, and stakeholder engagement, expand training on disease management and regulatory navigation, strengthen regional networking opportunities, and incorporate industry- and field-based learning experiences into their future extension competency development.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以美国东北部水产养殖推广人员为对象，采用混合方法整合推广能力评估、产业需求评估与专业发展项目评价三方面数据，旨在弥合推广服务与产业需求间的差距。结果显示，推广人员在利益相关者参与、项目管理、外部经费获取、会议引导、行为改变及评估等方面存在优先能力缺口，产业方则将疾病管理与法规应对列为最急需的推广支持主题。作者据此建议优先加强引导、评估与利益相关者参与的专业培训，扩展疾病管理和法规导航培训，并强化区域网络建设。

papers.title: Aquaculture Waste Management, Water Quality, and Methane Emissions: Implications for Environmental Sustainability in Intensive Tilapia Farming
papers.authors: do Carmo Ota, Erika; Souza de Castro Silva, Tarcila; Andre Rodrigues, Laurindo; Tomazi, Michely; Bergier, Ivan; Orrico, Ana Carolina Amorim; Vilela, Ranielle Nogueira da Silva; Inoue, Luís Antônio Kioshi Aoki
papers.abstract: Methane (CH4) emissions from aquaculture can be enhanced by organic waste accumulation and oxygen-limited conditions, yet field-based emission estimates remain scarce, particularly for intensive tilapia production in above-ground tanks in Brazil. This study evaluated how aquaculture waste composition and oxygen availability affect CH4 emissions and quantified emissions from a commercial intensive Nile tilapia production system. A controlled experiment assessed water and sediment characteristics and CH4 emissions during decomposition of feed, feces, and fish carcasses under contrasting residue combinations and aeration conditions. Field measurements quantified diffusive and ebullitive CH4 fluxes from production tanks and a sedimentation pond during 13 sampling campaigns conducted between February 2023 and November 2024. The non-aerated treatment receiving mixed residues showed the highest CH4 emissions, whereas aeration reduced mean flux by approximately 98.8%. At commercial scale, emissions were concentrated in the sedimentation pond and dominated by ebullition, while emissions from aerated production tanks were negligible. Annual CH4 emissions were estimated at 325.9 kg CH4 ha−1 yr−1, corresponding to 8799 kg CO2-eq ha−1 yr−1 and 0.147 kg CO2-eq kg−1 fish produced during the nursery phase. These findings identify oxygen availability and waste accumulation as key targets for CH4 mitigation through aeration and improved residue management, providing insights into strategies to reduce the environmental impact and support the sustainability of intensive tilapia production.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过受控实验与商业养殖场现场监测，评估了废弃物组成与氧气条件对集约化尼罗罗非鱼养殖CH4排放的影响。受控实验中混合废弃物且不曝气处理CH4排放最高，曝气可使平均通量降低约98.8%。商业规模下排放集中于 sedimentation pond 且以 ebullition 为主，曝气生产池排放可忽略，年排放量估算为325.9 kg CH4 ha−1 yr−1。结果表明氧气供应与废弃物积累是CH4减排的关键调控靶点。

papers.title: Numerical Investigation of Tank Geometry and Hydraulic Forcing to Increase Ammonia Water Renewal Efficiency in Stratified Aquaculture Earth Tanks
papers.authors: Ashraf, Muhammad Adnan; Carvalho, Rita F.; Furtado, Pedro
papers.abstract: In aquaculture, efficient water renewal systems are critical to ensuring water quality and preventing ammonia buildup. The streamfunction-vorticity formulation is utilized in a two-dimensional vertical (2DV) finite element model to simulate buoyancy-driven water renewal and ammonia transport in laboratory-scale aquaculture tanks based on the Figueira semi-intensive fish ponds used in the SISdATA project. The model integrates incompressible flow with ammonia advection-diffusion using the Boussinesq approximation and employs Streamline Upwind/Petrov-Galerkin (SUPG) stabilization and an operator-splitting scheme to ensure numerical stability under advection-dominated transport conditions. To isolate the effect of geometry on renewal performance, five tank configurations with the same length (Lx=2.5 m) and progressively increasing water depths from 0.0227 to 0.350 m were investigated. The corresponding inlet opening heights ranged from 0.00454 to 0.070 m, while the Reynolds and Peclet numbers were maintained constant. Deeper tanks resulted in lower inlet velocities at a given discharge, delayed penetration of the polluted layer by the circulation, and increased the relative importance of circulation-controlled renewal compared with direct jet-driven flushing. Under baseline conditions, the 83% ammonia removal time ranged from 48 min for Tank1 to 208 min for Tank4, while the deepest configuration, Tank5, achieved 83% removal in 91 min because of enhanced late-stage recirculation. Hydraulic scaling further showed that maintaining a constant inlet velocity reduced the renewal time of Tank5 to 75 min, whereas fixed inlet and outlet opening conditions generally favoured the shallowest configuration. A constant-volume analysis demonstrated that decreasing the tank aspect ratio from 110.13 to 0.46 increased the 83% renewal time from 48 to 353 min. The results demonstrate that water renewal efficiency is governed by the combined effects of tank geometry, hydraulic boundary conditions, and aspect ratio. The proposed model provides a numerical tool for optimizing aquaculture tank design and hydraulic operation to improve ammonia removal and water quality.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究采用二维垂向有限元模型（streamfunction-vorticity 格式，结合 Boussinesq 近似与 SUPG 稳定化）模拟实验室尺度分层水产养殖土池中浮力驱动的换水与氨氮输运，考察池体几何与水力条件对换水效率的影响。在保持 Reynolds 数与 Peclet 数不变的条件下，比较了五种水深递增（0.0227–0.350 m）的池型，发现较深池体入口流速较低、循环水层穿透污染层延迟，换水更多依赖环流而非射流冲刷；83% 氨氮去除时间由最浅池的 48 min 增至 208 min，而最深池因后期再循环增强为 91 min。水力缩放表明保持入口流速恒定可将最深池换水时间缩短至 75 min，而固定进/出口开口条件总体有利于最浅池型；长宽比由 110.13 降至 0.46 时，83% 换水时间由 48 min 延长至 353 min。结果表明换水效率受池体几何、水力边界条件与长宽比共同控制，该模型可为养殖池设计与水力运行优化提供数值工具。

papers.title: Using Discarded Shellfish From Aquaculture as Food for Rearing Juvenile Gloomy Octopus, Octopus tetricus
papers.authors: Spreitzenbarth, Stefan; Alder, Al; MacKechnie, Fiona; McKay, William; Nahmad‐Rohen, Luis; Roberts, Sophie M.; Jeffs, Andrew
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT A key bottleneck in the development of octopus aquaculture is the absence of formulated feeds that are readily consumed and fulfil their nutritional requirements. Until efficacious formulated feeds are developed, sustainably‐sourced natural seafood diets provide a potential viable alternative for octopus aquaculture. To investigate this alternative, this study measured feed intake, growth and biochemical composition of juvenile Octopus tetricus when fed bivalves discarded from shellfish aquaculture. Three dietary treatments were tested over 56 days: (1) whole thawed bivalves (natural feed), (2) bound pellet made from chopped bivalves bound with gelatine and transglutaminase (GO pellet) and (3) bound pellet made from chopped bivalves and krill meal, bound with gelatine and transglutaminase (GOK pellet). Overall, the mean specific feeding rate (wet weight) among octopus was highest in the natural feed (12.1 ± 1.5% BW day −1 ) regardless of time, indicating inferior palatability in the two bound pelleted feeds. Mean specific growth rates were higher from Day 0–28 (1.8 ± 0.2% BW day −1 ) than from Day 29–56 (1.0 ± 0.2% BW day −1 ) independently of dietary treatment. Mean feed efficiency (23.3 ± 3.3%) and feed conversion (5.5 ± 0.9) were similar among treatments for the whole experiment. The biochemical profile of octopuses was similar among treatment aside from a 30% increase in lipid content in arm tissue for octopuses fed with the natural feed. The results show that discarded bivalves from commercial aquaculture are an effective feed for juvenile O . tetricus providing fast growth and good feed conversion. While consumption and growth were reduced with the bound pelleted feeds, these wet seafood‐based feeds hold promise as a route to begin to develop formulated feeds for octopuses while utilising an otherwise wasted resource, especially if the palatability of these bound pelleted feeds can be improved.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在探究以贝类养殖废弃的双壳类作为 juvenile Octopus tetricus 饲料的可行性，以应对章鱼 aquaculture 中缺乏适用配合饲料的瓶颈。试验设置三种日粮处理（整只解冻双壳类、明胶-转谷氨酰胺酶黏合贝类颗粒饲料 GO、添加磷虾粉的 GOK 颗粒饲料），进行 56 天投喂试验，测定摄食率、生长及生化组成。结果显示，天然饵料的特定摄食率最高（12.1% BW day⁻¹），表明两种黏合颗粒饲料适口性较差；各处理间饲料效率和转化率无显著差异，但天然饵料组腕部组织脂质含量高出约 30%。研究表明，商业养殖废弃双壳类是培育 juvenile O. tetricus 的有效饲料，可提供较快生长和良好饲料转化，而黏合颗粒饲料虽摄食与生长降低，仍为利用废弃资源开发章鱼配合饲料提供了可行途径。

papers.title: Securing Long‐Chain Omega‐3 Fatty Acid Supply for Sustainable Aquaculture Development and Human Nutrition
papers.authors: Kaushik, Sadasivam; Tocher, Douglas R.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT There is increasing awareness of combatting lifestyle diseases through improved nutrition and the important role that adequate intake of omega‐3 long‐chain PUFA has in promoting human health and development. Given the role and strategic importance of aquaculture in overall seafood production and in the supply of omega‐3 long‐chain PUFA to human consumers, this article reviews the possible differences between terrestrial and aquatic systems at different trophic levels in terms of long‐chain PUFA, and the importance of dietary fats and essential fatty acids, particularly omega‐3 long‐chain PUFA, in aquaculture nutrition and as human food. Given that most farmed fish and shrimp depend on dietary sources of PUFA for optimal growth and physiological well‐being, a synthetic and systematic review of available data on dietary EFA requirements in different groups of fish is made. Besides growth, dietary PUFA have physiological and metabolic roles for ensuring membrane integrity, reproduction, immunity and health. Additionally, omega‐3 long‐chain PUFA are critical for ensuring the nutritional value of aquatic foods for consumers. Thus, the review also addresses current challenges associated with the reduced use of fish oil in aquafeeds and explores strategies to maintain the nutritional value of farmed fish. These include finishing diets, selective breeding for enhanced biosynthesis and optimised feed formulations capable of supporting both aquaculture productivity and human nutritional needs. Compared to terrestrial food webs, aquatic ecosystems are unique in providing EPA and DHA through microalgae from low marine trophic levels. Exploitation of these in a judicious manner addresses the challenges of sustainability of aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了水产与陆生系统在不同营养级上长链PUFA的差异，以及膳食脂肪和必需脂肪酸（尤其是omega-3长链PUFA）在水产养殖营养和人类食品中的重要作用。由于多数养殖鱼类和虾类依赖膳食PUFA满足生长和生理需求，作者系统梳理了不同鱼类群体的膳食EFA需求量数据，并指出PUFA除促进生长外，还在膜完整性、繁殖、免疫和健康方面具有生理代谢功能。针对鱼油在饲料中用量减少的挑战，文章探讨了维持养殖鱼营养价值的策略，包括终育饲料（finishing diets）、选育增强生物合成能力及优化饲料配方。与陆生食物网相比，水生生态系统通过低营养级微藻独特地提供EPA和DHA，合理开发利用有助于解决水产养殖可持续性问题。

papers.title: Response of coral reef to marine heatwaves: spatiotemporal heterogeneity in geomorphology, water depth, and community dynamics
papers.authors: Li, Weiqi; Zuo, Xiuling
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨珊瑚礁对海洋热浪的响应，重点关注地貌、水深和群落动态的时空异质性。由于摘要缺失，仅能从标题推断其采用时空分析框架评估热浪对珊瑚礁生态系统的差异化影响。

papers.title: Environmental Drivers and Trends of Alexandrium catenella and Paralytic Shellfish Toxins in Monterey Bay, California, from 2001 to 2025
papers.authors: Radan, Regina L.; Kudela, Raphael M.
papers.abstract: Alexandrium catenella, a harmful algal species responsible for paralytic shellfish poisoning (PSP), is frequently found along the California coast. Although it is prevalent, the environmental and climatic variables underlying long-term variability in A. catenella abundance, bloom occurrence, and paralytic shellfish toxins (PSTs) in Monterey Bay, California, remain poorly understood. This study analyzed a 24-year dataset (2001–2025) collected weekly at the Santa Cruz Municipal Wharf in Santa Cruz, California. Principal component analysis (PCA) and generalized linear models (GLMs) were used to examine the relationships among environmental variables, basin-scale climate indices, and the presence of A. catenella and PSTs. Year-round (annual and seasonal (spring/summer, fall, winter) models indicated that the occurrence of A. catenella was associated with warmer, lower-nutrient conditions and lower discharge rates from the San Lorenzo River. Long-term variations in A. catenella and PST occurrences were also influenced by basin-scale climate patterns, particularly the PDO-ONI and NPGO climate modes. These results show that the dynamics of A. catenella in Monterey Bay are affected by environmental conditions, seasonal oceanographic variability, and large-scale climate processes.
papers.summary_cn: 基于2001–2025年Santa Cruz市政码头每周采样数据，采用PCA和GLMs分析Monterey Bay中Alexandrium catenella及PSTs的长期变化与环境、气候因子的关系。全年及季节模型显示，A. catenella出现与较暖、低营养条件及San Lorenzo河低流量相关。其长期变化还受PDO-ONI和NPGO等basin-scale气候模态影响，表明该有害藻华动态受局地环境、季节海洋学变率与大尺度气候过程共同驱动。

papers.authors: Schall, Benjamin J.; Chipps, Steven. R.
papers.abstract: Abstract Stable isotope analysis (SIA) of eye lenses can provide a retrospective view of resource use over a fish's life. This tool can be valuable for studying long‐term isotopic changes in non‐game species that typically receive limited research emphasis. We assessed shifts in isotope composition of Blue Sucker ( Cycleptus elongatus ) from eye lenses of fish ( n = 39) collected from the James River, South Dakota, that ranged in total length from 315 to 821 mm and age from 1 to 41 years. We assessed the chronology of δ 13 C and δ 15 N values from individual fish lens layers and modelled population‐level trends across the observed lens diameter range using Bayesian general additive models. We assessed changes in δ 13 C and δ 15 N isotope values of juvenile (<2 years) Blue Sucker lens layers over time and across the two‐year, grand mean (April–October) discharge of the James River using Bayesian linear models. Lens diameter was linearly related to fish length and exponentially related to age. The mean population‐level trend in δ 13 C values increased by ~3‰ as eye lens diameter increased above 2 mm, whereas δ 15 N values were consistent across the range of lens diameters (within ~1‰). Juvenile mean posterior estimated δ 13 C values generally decreased over time. As river discharge increased, the juvenile mean posterior estimated δ 13 C values decreased by 5‰ across the range of observed discharge values (8.0–224.0 m 3 /s), while changes in δ 15 N values were notably low at ~1‰. Lower δ 13 C values for younger fish (e.g., smaller lens diameters) during high river discharge likely indicate increased residence time of juveniles in floodplain habitats. These results demonstrate that eye lens SIA can provide insight into changing habitat use by long‐lived, vulnerable fish.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用眼晶状体稳定同位素分析（SIA）回溯蓝吸口鱼（Cycleptus elongatus）生活史中的资源利用变化，样本取自南达科他州James River，共39尾（体长315–821 mm，年龄1–41龄）。通过贝叶斯广义加性模型和线性模型分析δ13C和δ15N值的个体 chronology 及种群趋势，发现晶状体直径与体长呈线性关系、与年龄呈指数关系；种群水平δ13C值随晶状体直径增大而升高约3‰，δ15N值则保持稳定。幼鱼δ13C值随时间下降，且随河流流量增加（8.0–224.0 m³/s）下降约5‰，表明高流量期间幼鱼更多利用洪泛区栖息地。眼晶状体SIA可有效揭示长寿命、易危鱼类的栖息地利用变化。

papers.title: A novel PD-L1/BTLA checkpoint constrains CD4⁺ T cell–driven antibacterial humoral immunity via immunometabolic reprogramming in teleost fish
papers.authors: Hu, Chongbin; Hong, Yun; Wang, Jie; Fan, Dongdong; Lin, Aifu; Xiang, Lixin; Chen, Ye; Shao, Jianzhong
papers.summary_cn: 该研究在硬骨鱼中鉴定出一种新型PD-L1/BTLA免疫检查点，揭示其通过免疫代谢重编程限制CD4⁺ T细胞驱动的抗菌体液免疫。非渔业相关。

papers.title: Comparison of Fish Communities and Abundance Over Various Existing and Added Habitats in Nebraska Reservoirs
papers.authors: Schriener, William; Wuellner, Melissa R.; Koupal, Keith D.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Physical structures, constructed from either natural or artificial materials, are added to aquatic systems to provide habitat for fish. Attraction to new structures is well documented, but few studies have compared attraction on added structures to existing or bare areas in multiple reservoirs or species. Thus, the objective of this study was to compare species richness and diversity and abundances of target taxa over newly added structures constructed of different materials to those over nearest existing available habitat and an open site with no apparent habitat structures within three reservoirs where sampling was conducted across seasons and years. Cedar brush piles and Georgia cube complexes were placed in into three reservoirs in October 2020. Existing physical habitats and areas devoid of any physical structure were also selected near added structures. Sampling was conducted in spring, summer, and fall 2021 and 2022 using boat‐mounted electrofishing. Richness and diversity were generally higher over existing or added structure than over open habitat. However, none of our target taxa showed consistent association to a single habitat type between reservoirs, and seasonal differences in habitat use were common. Our results point towards the need to understand the inherent factors, such as existing habitat availability, the recipient fish community, and abiotic factors on the outcomes of adding physical habitat structure in reservoirs. Continuous monitoring over multiple years beyond the timeframe of this research is recommended to provide information on the longevity of benefits to fishes and to decide when habitat structures may need to be replaced.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了内布拉斯加三座水库中新增人工栖息结构（Cedar brush piles 与 Georgia cube complexes）、现有栖息地及无结构开阔水域的鱼类群落与目标类群丰度，于2021—2022年春秋冬三季采用船载电捕采样。结果显示，现有或新增结构处的物种丰富度和多样性总体高于开阔水域，但目标类群与单一栖息类型的关联在水库间不一致，栖息地利用的季节差异普遍存在。作者建议关注现有栖息地可用性、受体鱼类群落及非生物因素对投放效果的影响，并开展多年持续监测以评估效益持久性。

papers.title: Shark Diversity, Bycatch, and Conservation Importance in the Northeastern Mediterranean Sea
papers.authors: Turan, Cemal
papers.abstract: Sharks are among the most threatened marine vertebrates in the Mediterranean Sea, where sustained fishing pressure has raised increasing conservation concerns. This study assessed shark bycatch composition, occurrence, spatial distribution, and conservation status in commercial bottom-trawl operations conducted in İskenderun, Mersin, and Antalya Bays in the northeastern Mediterranean Sea during 2019–2020. Of 91 commercial trawl operations examined, 21 yielded shark bycatch, comprising 147 individuals from 12 species with a combined wet weight of 404.76 kg. Mustelus mustelus was the most numerically abundant species, accounting for 52 individuals recorded across eight shark-positive hauls. Other species of conservation concern, including the Critically Endangered Squatina oculata, S. aculeata, and Centrophorus granulosus, were also recorded. Species composition and species-specific catch per unit effort (CPUE) varied among sampled locations and associated depth and bottom-habitat conditions. However, CPUE values were calculated from shark-positive hauls and therefore represent observed catch rates rather than estimates of population abundance or standardized catch rates across all commercial operations. Furthermore, the unbalanced sampling design and confounding among region, season, depth, and habitat precluded assessment of their independent effects on shark occurrence. The recorded assemblage included species classified as Critically Endangered, Endangered, or Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List, highlighting the conservation relevance of incidental shark captures in active commercial bottom-trawl fisheries. These findings provide a descriptive baseline for future standardized monitoring and support continued efforts to improve species-level monitoring and evaluate bycatch mitigation measures in northeastern Mediterranean demersal fisheries.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2019–2020年东北地中海伊斯肯德伦湾、梅尔辛湾和安塔利亚湾的商业底拖网作业，评估鲨鱼兼捕的物种组成、出现率、空间分布及保护状况。91次拖网作业中21次出现鲨鱼兼捕，共记录12种147尾、总湿重404.76 kg，其中Mustelus mustelus数量最多（52尾）。兼捕种类包含IUCN红色名录极危的Squatina oculata、S. aculeata和Centrophorus granulosus，凸显商业底拖网兼捕鲨鱼的保护意义。由于采样设计不平衡及区域、季节、深度与生境因素混杂，CPUE仅反映鲨鱼阳性拖网的观测捕获率，不能作为种群丰度估计；研究为后续标准化监测和兼捕减缓措施评估提供了描述性基线。

papers.title: Seasonal dynamics of proteomes and microbial communities in the marginal coral Favia speciosa in Dongshan, China
papers.authors: Lin, Zhenyue; Wang, Qifang; Wang, Jiajia; Zheng, Xinqing; Wang, Lu; Wang, Wei; Cai, Ling; Chen, Jianming
papers.summary_cn: 该研究以中国东山边缘珊瑚Favia speciosa为对象，关注其蛋白质组与微生物群落的季节性动态，但摘要缺失，具体方法、结果与结论无法获知。

papers.title: Effect of dietary supplementation with Clostridium butyricum on growth, intestinal microbiota, metabolome and transcriptome in a hybrid fish ( Megalobrama amblycephala ♀ ×  Culter alburnus ♂)
papers.authors: Liu, Yunyun; Chen, Shandong; Ma, Yiting; Zhu, Wenting; Xi, Hongbo; Yuan, Ye; Zhou, Zexun; Li, Yongchun; Shen, Zhongyuan; Wang, Chongqing
papers.abstract: Abstract This study investigated the effects of dietary supplementation with Clostridium butyricum on the growth performance, intestinal microbiota, metabolome and transcriptome of a hybrid fish ( Megalobrama amblycephala ♀ × Culter alburnus♂ ). Experimental fish were diet supplemented with C . butyricum at 0 (control group [CG]), 4.02 × 10 8 (L), 1.66 × 10 9 CFU/kg (T), respectively, for 8 weeks feeding. The results showed that the growth performance of fish followed the trend of T > L > CG. Compared to group CG, the microbial community structure in group T shifted significantly. The relative abundance of Fusobacteriota and Cetobacterium was higher while that of Pseudomonadota , Bacillota and Plesiomonas was lower. The predicted functional abundances of biotin metabolism, D‐alanine metabolism and propanoate metabolism in the intestinal microbiota were higher in group T than in group CG. Besides, 131 DEMs were identified and mainly enriched in glycerophospholipid metabolism and beta‐alanine metabolism. In addition, transcriptome analysis showed 1479 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were identified and mainly enriched in pentose and glucuronate interconversions, peroxisome and protein digestion and absorption. Correlation analysis showed that the dominant bacterium Cetobacterium was positively associated with fish growth performance and glycerophospholipid metabolites. These findings suggested that dietary supplementation with C. butyricum reshaped intestinal microbiota structure and influenced lipid, carbohydrate and protein metabolism, as well as the expression of genes related to carbohydrates and lipids, which may provide insights into the microbiota‐host interactions that regulate growth in hybrid fish.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨饲料添加丁酸梭菌（Clostridium butyricum）对杂交鱼（团头鲂♀×翘嘴鲌♂）生长、肠道菌群、代谢组及转录组的影响，设置0、4.02×10⁸、1.66×10⁹ CFU/kg三个添加水平饲喂8周。结果表明，生长性能随添加量呈T>L>CG趋势，高剂量组肠道菌群结构显著改变，Fusobacteriota与Cetobacterium相对丰度升高，Pseudomonadota、Bacillota及Plesiomonas降低。代谢组与转录组分析分别鉴定出131个差异代谢物（富集于甘油磷脂与β-丙氨酸代谢）和1479个差异表达基因（富集于戊糖与葡萄糖醛酸互变、过氧化物酶体及蛋白质消化吸收通路），且Cetobacterium与生长性能及甘油磷脂代谢物正相关。研究提示丁酸梭菌可通过重塑肠道菌群、调控脂质/碳水化合物/蛋白质代谢及宿主基因表达促进杂交鱼生长。

papers.title: Predicting Fishing Grounds With Dimensionality Reduction and SHAP Analysis: The Case of Jumbo Flying Squid ( Dosidicus gigas ) Off Peru
papers.authors: Zhang, Tianjiao; Guan, Li; Yang, Zhuo; Yu, Wei; Yuan, Hongchun
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The jumbo squid ( Dosidicus gigas ), a pelagic cephalopod of significant economic and ecological importance off the coast of Peru, is highly sensitive to marine environmental shifts. This study synthesized jumbo squid fishery logbook data with vertical variables (0–147 m depth) and two large‐scale climate indices, the Pacific Decadal Oscillation (PDO) and the Niño 1 + 2 sea surface temperature anomaly, from 2014 to 2021. We assessed K ‐means clustering for vertical oceanographic data dimensionality reduction and trained and evaluated five tree‐based regression models using the SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) framework for Dosidicus gigas distribution prediction and model interpretability. Our results demonstrated that K ‐means clustering identified three representative depth groupings from the environmental profiles, reducing the depth‐dependent features from 140 to 15 and generally maintained or improved predictive performance while substantially reducing computational time, with random forest (RF) and gradient boosting regression tree (GBRT) providing the strongest overall accuracy. Subsequent SHAP analysis identified near‐surface dissolved oxygen, the Niño 1 + 2 index, and the PDO index as the most influential predictors of Dosidicus gigas distribution during the study period. By reducing feature redundancy while maintaining model performance and improving computational efficiency, the framework provides a practical and interpretable strategy for simplifying complex vertical environmental data while facilitating the characterization of environmental associations underlying fishery habitat.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在利用降维与SHAP分析预测秘鲁外海茎柔鱼（Dosidicus gigas）渔场。研究整合2014–2021年渔业日志数据、0–147 m垂直环境变量及PDO和Niño 1+2海温异常指数，采用K-means聚类对垂直海洋数据进行降维，并训练五种树基回归模型结合SHAP框架进行分布预测与模型解释。结果表明，K-means聚类将深度依赖特征从140个减至15个，在保持或提升预测性能的同时显著降低计算时间，随机森林（RF）和梯度提升回归树（GBRT）精度最高。SHAP分析识别出近表层溶解氧、Niño 1+2指数和PDO指数为研究期间茎柔鱼分布的最主要预测因子。

papers.title: Microplastic-Induced Gut Microbiome–Immune Crosstalk in Nile Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus): Molecular Mechanisms, Biomarkers, Multi-Omics Insights and Mitigation Strategies for Sustainable Aquaculture
papers.authors: Shah, Masood; Naveed, Usman; Sarwar, Tahreem; Tahir, Maryam; Bakhsh, Allah; Faseeha, Inshrah; Ashraf, Zahra; Kousar, Adeela
papers.journal: Haya: The Saudi Journal of Life Sciences
papers.abstract: Microplastics (MPs) are widespread pollutants in freshwater aquaculture systems, entering through the degradation of pond linings and nets, contaminated aquafeeds, agricultural runoff and atmospheric deposition. Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) an omnivorous and intensively farmed fish, is heavily exposed to MPs however, the interaction between MPs, gut microbiota and mucosal immunity in this species has not been comprehensively assessed. In this review, we summarize recent evidence on the sources, uptake and accumulation of MPs and on how MP exposure causes gut dysbiosis, characterized by decreased alpha diversity, increased abundance of Proteobacteria and reduced levels of beneficial Firmicutes and Fusobacteria, which may affect short chain fatty acid biosynthesis. We then examine how dysbiosis and barrier dysfunction are linked to activation of the TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB, MAPK, JAK/STAT, Nrf2/Keap1 and NLRP3 inflammasome pathways and to oxidative and histopathological damage in the intestine and liver. Special attention is given to age dependent susceptibility, as juvenile fish show dysregulated inflammatory genes under conditions in which no effects are observed in adults. Candidate molecular, biochemical, hematological and non-invasive mucus-based biomarkers are discussed alongside the feasibility of multi omics approaches (metagenomics, transcriptomics, proteomics and metabolomics) for resolving host microbiota environment interactions. Mitigation strategies, including multi species probiotics, algal supplements, engineered biochar, feed management and biodegradable materials, are also evaluated. Key knowledge gaps remain in chronic low dose exposure, mixture effects, nanoplastics, reversibility of dysbiosis and methodological standardization. Addressing these gaps will be essential for developing resilient and sustainable tilapia aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 微塑料（MPs）通过池塘衬膜和网具降解、受污染饲料、农业径流及大气沉降等途径进入淡水养殖系统，尼罗罗非鱼作为集约化养殖的杂食性鱼类暴露风险较高，但其MPs-肠道菌群-黏膜免疫互作尚未得到系统评估。本文综述了MPs的来源、摄取与蓄积及其引发的肠道菌群失调（α多样性下降、Proteobacteria增多、有益Firmicutes和Fusobacteria减少，可能影响短链脂肪酸合成），并探讨了菌群失调与屏障功能障碍同TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB、MAPK、JAK/STAT、Nrf2/Keap1及NLRP3炎症小体通路激活及肠肝氧化损伤和组织病理损伤的关联。幼鱼在成鱼无效应的暴露条件下即表现炎症基因失调，提示年龄依赖性易感性；文章还讨论了候选分子、生化、血液及无创黏液生物标志物和多组学方法的应用前景，并评估了多菌种益生菌、藻类补充剂、工程生物炭、饲料管理及可降解材料等缓解策略。

papers.title: Policy Support and Farmers’ Ecological Aquaculture Behavior: The Mediating Role of Ecological Awareness
papers.authors: Jiang, Shuyang; Hu, Yanfu
papers.abstract: Promoting farmers’ adoption of ecological aquaculture practices is important for the environmental sustainability and green transformation of aquaculture. Using survey data from 278 aquaculture farmers in Zhangzhou, Fujian Province, China, this study examines the relationship between policy support and farmers’ ecological aquaculture behavior. Policy support is measured across three dimensions—financial and credit support, agricultural insurance support, and technical and knowledge support—and the potential mediating role of ecological awareness is further examined. The results show that policy support is significantly and positively associated with farmers’ ecological aquaculture behavior, and each of the three dimensions also exhibits a significant positive association when examined separately. Further analysis indicates that policy support is significantly and positively associated with ecological awareness, which plays a significant partial mediating role in the relationship between policy support and farmers’ ecological aquaculture behavior. These findings suggest that promoting the environmental sustainability of aquaculture requires attention to farmers’ financial, risk-related, and technical constraints, as well as to the role of ecological awareness in linking policy support to actual production behavior.
papers.summary_cn: 基于福建漳州278户养殖渔民的调查数据，研究考察了政策支持（金融信贷支持、农业保险支持、技术与知识支持三个维度）与渔民生态养殖行为的关系，并检验生态意识的中介作用。结果表明，政策支持及其各维度均与生态养殖行为显著正相关，生态意识在其中发挥显著的部分中介作用。研究提示，推动水产养殖绿色转型需同时关注渔民在资金、风险和技术方面的约束以及生态意识的培育。

papers.title: A legal strategy for state fish and wildlife agencies: A comprehensive review
papers.authors: Kisonak, Lane; Batcheller, Gordon R.
papers.summary_cn: 该文围绕州级鱼类与野生动物管理机构的法律策略展开综合评述，属渔业管理政策范畴，但因缺乏摘要无法提炼具体研究方法与发现。

papers.title: A Fish-Oriented Heavy Metal Pollution Index for the Danube River
papers.authors: Bezdan, Atila; Bezdan, Jovana
papers.abstract: The Heavy Metal Pollution Index (HPI) usually includes the metals that have a regulatory standard rather than those most relevant to fish. Its usual weights also give most influence to the metals with the strictest standards. This study developed a fish-oriented HPI for the Danube River. A data-coverage screen and an expert evaluation with the PAPRIKA method selected eight metals: Cd, Pb, Hg, Cu, Ni, Zn, As and Cr. They were combined with equal weights so that each selected metal contributes to the index. The index was calculated for 6467 sampling events at 43 stations in eight countries (1998–2022), and values below detection limits were estimated by multiple imputation. A generalised additive mixed model showed that the index increased about fourfold from the upper to the lower Danube and tended to decline over time. The downstream increase persisted under most alternative methods. In a Serbian reach surveyed for fish in 2022, the index in 2020–2022 was in the upper third of the basin, mainly because of Ni and Cu, and the fish community was dominated by eurytopic and non-native species. Selecting metals by their relevance to fish, and weighting them so that this selection matters, offers a transferable approach for fish-relevant contamination indices in large rivers.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对传统重金属污染指数（HPI）侧重监管标准而非鱼类相关性的问题，构建了面向鱼类的多瑙河HPI。通过数据覆盖筛选与PAPRIKA专家评估法选定Cd、Pb、Hg、Cu、Ni、Zn、As、Cr八种金属并等权合成，基于1998–2022年8国43个站点6467次采样数据计算指数，检出限以下数据采用多重插补处理。广义加性混合模型显示指数从多瑙河上游至下游约增长四倍，且随时间呈下降趋势；塞尔维亚河段2020–2022年指数居全流域前三分之一，主要受Ni和Cu驱动，鱼类群落以广适性和非本地种为主。该基于鱼类相关性选金属并等权赋值的思路可为大河鱼类相关污染指数提供可移植方法。

papers.title: Carbon footprint and energy-related performance indicators of Mediterranean and Black Sea trawl fisheries
papers.authors: Russo, Tommaso; Labriola, Maria Silvia; Ferrà, Carmen; Tassetti, Anna Nora; Marsaglia, Luca; Rinalduzzi, Sofia; Sala, Antonello
papers.abstract: Abstract Spatially explicit information on fuel consumption and energy efficiency is essential for evaluating the climate-related and economic performance of trawl fisheries, yet such data are rarely available at regional scales. This Data Descriptor presents four harmonised spatial datasets describing fuel consumption, fuel costs, and energy-related performance indicators for Mediterranean and Black Sea trawl fisheries during 2013 to 2022. The datasets integrate fleet-segment economic data from the EU Annual Economic Report with spatially resolved fishing effort and landings from the Fisheries Dependent Information database, using a reproducible framework that allocates fleet-segment fuel consumption and costs to spatial fishing grounds according to the distribution of fishing effort and landings. Indicators include Energy Consumption, Energy Costs, Fuel Use Intensity, Energy Use Intensity, and Fuel Efficiency, reported on a 0.5° c-square grid. The four products provide energy indicators at increasing levels of aggregation, ranging from datasets disaggregated by fishing technique, gear type, and vessel length to datasets summarised across all trawl fleet segments within each c-square grid. Spatial patterns of energy consumption were independently validated using Automatic Identification System data combined with empirically derived fuel-consumption relationships to reconstruct fuel use. These datasets provide a consistent spatial representation of energy use to support spatial analyses, modelling applications, and assessments of energy efficiency and decarbonisation strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究构建了2013–2022年地中海与黑海拖网渔业四个协调的空间数据集，整合欧盟年度经济报告的船队经济数据与渔业依赖信息数据库的空间捕捞努力量和上岸量，将船队燃油消耗与成本按捕捞努力量分布分配至0.5°网格。指标涵盖能耗、能源成本、燃油使用强度、能源使用强度及燃油效率，并按捕捞技术、渔具类型和船长分级汇总。能耗空间格局经AIS数据结合经验燃油消耗关系独立验证，可为能效评估与脱碳策略的空间分析提供一致的数据支撑。

papers.title: A shared vision: regional data harmonization for resilient small-scale fisheries in the Western Indian Ocean
papers.authors: Mbaru, Emmanuel; Tilley, Alexander; Longobardi, Lorenzo; Gardella, Giacomo; Tembo, Japhet; Thoya, Pascal; Khalfan, Zahor; Tuda, Arthur; Hamza, Altarturi; Leopold, Marc
papers.abstract: Effective fisheries management in the Western Indian Ocean (WIO) is currently hindered by a lack of timely, harmonized data, which undermines the formulation of evidence-based policies. To address this gap, this study utilizes the Integrated Data Harmonization Framework (IDHF) to: (1) examine gaps and limitations in existing digital data collection systems in the region; (2) identify challenges and solutions for harmonizing small-scale fisheries (SSF) data; and (3) develop a strategic roadmap for national and regional data integration. While high-quality data is essential for sustainable governance, stakeholders perceived existing fisheries data systems in the region as performing inadequately, with a predominant focus on conventional catch metrics and insufficient attention to socio-economic indicators such as market value chains, prices, and costs. Consequently, these systems fail to provide the real-time insights necessary to track stock exploitation or evaluate the effectiveness of management measures. Key obstacles include technical and methodological inconsistencies, data access and trust issues, resource and capacity deficits, institutional and policy barriers, and lack of incentives for data providers. To overcome these obstacles, the study proposes establishing standardized frameworks and legal protocols for information exchange, alongside efforts to strengthen technical and financial capacity and integrate community-based monitoring. By leveraging digital tools to streamline data flow, the provided roadmap offers a clear path toward standardized data-sharing guidelines. Ultimately, these recommendations aim to foster institutional collaboration and improve decision-making to ensure the long-term sustainability of fishery resources across the WIO region.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对西印度洋（WIO）小规模渔业管理缺乏及时、统一数据的问题，运用Integrated Data Harmonization Framework（IDHF）评估了区域现有数字数据采集系统的缺口与局限，识别了SSF数据协调面临的挑战与解决方案，并制定了国家和区域数据整合的战略路线图。利益相关方普遍认为现有数据系统表现不足，过度侧重传统捕捞指标而忽视市场价值链、价格和成本等社会经济指标，难以提供追踪stock exploitation或评估管理措施效果的实时信息。主要障碍包括技术方法不一致、数据获取与信任问题、资源能力不足、制度政策壁垒及数据提供者缺乏激励。研究建议建立标准化信息交换框架与法律协议，加强技术与资金能力并整合社区监测，以促进机构协作和WIO区域渔业资源的长期可持续性。

papers.title: Water and endangered fish in the Klamath River basin revisited: Does old age or Upper Klamath Lake surface elevation and water quality affect adult Lost River Sucker and Shortnose Sucker survival? A response to Kann and Walker
papers.authors: Krause, Jacob R; Janney, Eric C; Burdick, Summer M; Caldwell, John; Hayes, Brian S
papers.journal: North American Journal of Fisheries Management
papers.abstract: Lay Summary Our update responds to recent scientific critiques and again finds no evidence that lake levels or water conditions influence adult sucker survival. This reaffirms our prior work (Krause et al., 2022) and suggests that recent declines in adult survival may reflect an aging population.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究回应了Kann和Walker对Klamath River流域濒危鱼类研究的批评，重新检验了Upper Klamath Lake水位与水质对成年Lost River Sucker和Shortnose Sucker存活率的影响。分析未发现湖泊水位或水环境条件与成鱼存活率之间存在关联，重申了Krause等（2022）的结论，并提示近期成鱼存活率下降可能反映种群老龄化。

papers.authors: Giulietti, Lucilla; Storesund, Julia E.; Bruvold, Are Sæle; Karlsbakk, Egil; Mæhle, Stig; Slotte, Aril; Nøttestad, Leif; Cipriani, Paolo; Bao, Miguel; Wienerroither, Rupert
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.summary_cn: 该研究聚焦于东北大西洋中诱导鱼肉软化病的寄生虫 *Kudoa thyrsites*（刺胞动物门，黏体动物），旨在揭示其在大尺度空间上的分布格局。由于摘要缺失，具体方法与结果无法获知，建议查阅全文以了解采样设计与空间分布特征。

papers.title: Viral Profiles in Aquaculture Fish from Kazakhstan: A Metagenomic Survey
papers.authors: Sabyrzhan, Temirlan; Nuralibekov, Sardor; Abdybekova, Aida; Kumar, Marat; Karamendin, Kobey; Kassymbekov, Yermukhammet; Suleimenova, Symbat; Khan, Yelizaveta; Yessentureyeva, Meruyert; Zhaksylykova, Ainur
papers.abstract: Viral diversity in aquaculture fish from Kazakhstan remains poorly characterized. This study investigated candidate virus-associated sequences in ten pooled tissue libraries representing four commercially important fish groups: silver carp, grass carp, sturgeon, and rainbow trout. RNA-enriched libraries were sequenced using an Illumina MiSeq platform, and viral assignments were evaluated through a metagenomic analysis pipeline. Of 21 initially identified taxonomic bins, eight were retained for fish-focused analyses. The most prominent finding was an Orthoreovirus-like sequence signal concentrated in two rainbow trout libraries from the Almaty region. A 2356-nt partial L1-region sequence showed 99.96% nucleotide identity to a previously reported piscine orthoreovirus 3 (PRV-3) reference, and phylogenetic analysis supported its placement among PRV-3 sequences. Candidate viral taxonomic profiles differed between the sampled sturgeon and rainbow trout libraries (PERMANOVA R2 = 0.455, exact p = 0.0286), although host species, sampling location, and tissue type were confounded. Taxonomic filtering also substantially influenced the observed diversity estimates. These findings provide preliminary evidence of candidate viral diversity in Kazakhstan’s aquaculture fish and identify PRV-3-like sequences in rainbow trout as a priority for further investigation. Broader sampling, targeted molecular confirmation, and additional genomic characterization are needed to clarify the distribution and potential clinical significance of these viruses.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在填补哈萨克斯坦养殖鱼类病毒多样性数据的空白，采用Illumina MiSeq对银鲤、草鱼、鲟鱼和虹鳟四个商业鱼种共10个混合组织文库进行宏基因组测序分析。最突出的发现是Almaty地区两个虹鳟文库中检出类Orthoreovirus信号，其2356-nt部分L1区序列与已报道的piscine orthoreovirus 3（PRV-3）参考序列核苷酸一致性达99.96%，系统发育分析支持其归入PRV-3分支。鲟鱼与虹鳟文库的候选病毒分类谱存在差异（PERMANOVA R2=0.455，p=0.0286），但宿主种类、采样地点与组织类型存在混杂，且分类过滤对多样性估计影响显著。研究提示哈萨克斯坦养殖鱼存在候选病毒多样性，虹鳟中PRV-3样序列值得优先开展靶向分子确认与基因组表征。

papers.title: Towards a situated engagement with coastal futures: Aquaculture, limits to growth, and anticipatory ruinations in Divtasvuodna/Tysfjord
papers.authors: Cossette-Laneville, Èva
papers.journal: Environment and Planning E: Nature and Space
papers.abstract: In contrast to its modest beginning in the 1970s, the Norwegian aquaculture industry is increasingly advocated by state officials and industry actors as vital to Norway's future, both in terms of economic growth and mainstay of coastal settlements. However, these views assume unity in terms of interests and values, often disregarding the lived realities on the ground. Based on fieldwork in Divtasvuodna/Tysfjord, Sápmi/northern Norway, this paper argues for a situated engagement with the way coastal futures are imagined, and how dominant discourses on emerging technologies in the industry may influence these visions. Drawing on Kasia Paprocki's concept of anticipatory ruination, I explore how the aquaculture industry anticipates future threats which are then used to legitimise its operations and emerging technologies as an instrument for more sustainable futures. This paper observes how this process unfolds in Divtasvuodna/Tysfjord and the way it is represented, manifested, and simultaneously contested by local people. The article shows ambivalent responses regarding the aquaculture industry's future role, contrasting with state and industry-led growth goals. While aquaculture is seen as important for maintaining a certain way of life, the reliance on a capital- and technology-intensive industry also brings uncertainties and insecurities. The research further argues for the need to recentre local agency and highlight the values, worldviews, and relationships that underpin everyday engagements with place.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于挪威北部Sápmi地区Divtasvuodna/Tysfjord的田野调查，探讨沿海未来的想象方式及水产养殖业主导话语对地方愿景的影响，运用“anticipatory ruination”概念分析行业如何以预期威胁 legitimise 其运营与新兴技术。研究发现，当地人对水产养殖业的未来角色态度矛盾：一方面认可其对维持特定生活方式的重要性，另一方面对资本与技术密集型产业的依赖带来不确定性与不安全感，与国家和行业主导的增长目标形成反差。作者主张重新聚焦地方能动性，重视支撑日常地方实践的价值观、世界观与关系。

papers.title: Comparative assessment of Open-Sea and Integrated Mangrove Aquaculture Systems (IMAS) for Asian seabass (<i>Lates calcarifer</i>) culture: implications for growth performance, physicochemical characteristics and mangrove cover assessment
papers.authors: Jeyaashriee, Kingston; Edward, L. Loveson; Athithan, Saminathan; Ranjith, Lakshmanan
papers.abstract: The present study compared the growth performance, feed utilization, water quality, primary productivity and sediment characteristics of Asian seabass (Lates calcarifer) cultured in an Open-Sea Cage culture system (OSC) and two Integrated Mangrove Aquaculture Systems (MP1 and MP2). Asian seabass were stocked at 10 fish m⁻³ in six HAPAs within each culture system and reared for 60 days. Growth, feed-utilization indices, water-quality parameters, primary productivity and sediment characteristics were monitored throughout the culture period. Body weight increased progressively in all systems, with significantly higher final weight in MP2 (27.01±0.34 g) than in MP1 (25.83±0.30 g) and OSC (23.22±0.11 g). MP2 recorded the highest weight gain, specific growth rate, feed conversion efficiency and protein efficiency ratio, while feed conversion ratio was lowest. Water-quality and productivity characteristics differed significantly among systems and sampling periods, with MP2 showing higher gross and net primary productivity and chlorophyll-a. Sediment characteristics also differed significantly with MP2 recording higher organic carbon, organic matter, total nitrogen and carbon stock. The findings highlight IMAS as a promising production-with-ecological-conservation approach enhancing aquaculture performance while retaining mangrove-based ecosystem functions, thereby supporting environmentally responsible seafood production and progress towards the SDGs.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了开放海域网箱（OSC）与两种红树林综合养殖系统（MP1、MP2）养殖尖吻鲈（Lates calcarifer）的生长性能、饲料利用、水质、初级生产力和沉积物特征，养殖密度10尾/m³，周期60天。MP2终末体重（27.01 g）显著高于MP1（25.83 g）和OSC（23.22 g），且增重、特定生长率、饲料转化效率和蛋白质效率比最高、饲料转化率最低。MP2的总初级生产力、净初级生产力和叶绿素a较高，沉积物有机碳、有机质、总氮及碳储量也较高。结果表明IMAS可在维持红树林生态系统功能的同时提升养殖表现，是一种兼顾生产与生态保护的有前景模式。

papers.title: Photovoltaic Shading Alters Water Quality and Sustains Diatom-Dominated Microbial Communities in Shrimp–Crab Aquaculture Ponds
papers.authors: Dongping, Zhang; Shaolei, Cai; Junhao, Zhang; Dongsheng, Chen; Ramzan, Muhammad Naeem; Raza, Bilal; Encai, Bao
papers.abstract: Fishery–photovoltaic systems are expanding rapidly in coastal China, yet their effects on pond water quality and microbial communities remain poorly understood. We compared three PV-shaded and three unshaded (NPV) earthen ponds co-culturing Pacific white shrimp (Litopenaeus vannamei) and mud crab (Scylla paramamosain) in August and September 2025. Water quality measurements and 16S and 18S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing were conducted on 60 samples. PV ponds had lower temperature (28.9 vs. 31.2 °C), turbidity (31.6 vs. 40.9 NTU), dissolved oxygen (5.76 vs. 6.91 mg L−1), and ammonium, nitrite, phosphate, total nitrogen and total phosphorus concentrations. Shading explained 8.0% and 10.4% of bacterial and eukaryotic community variation respectively, while alpha diversity remained largely unchanged. Diatom relative abundance was higher under shading (46.2% vs. 26.7%), whereas dinoflagellate abundance was lower. From August to September, NPV communities shifted from diatom to ciliate dominance, with ciliate abundance increasing from 2.1% to 45.4% and Vibrio from 0.6% to 9.8%. In contrast, diatom abundance remained stable and Vibrio remained below 2.5% in PV ponds. Shaded communities exhibited lower dispersion and broader niche breadth, although assembly processes did not differ between treatments. Cross-kingdom networks contained fewer bacteria–eukaryote associations under shading, but cohesion and resampled network topology remained comparable. Overall, PV shading was associated with cooler, less nutrient-rich water and persistent diatom dominance; however, reduced dissolved oxygen highlights the importance of aeration management in fishery–PV systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了光伏遮荫与无遮荫的虾蟹混养塘（Litopenaeus vannamei 与 Scylla paramamosain）在2025年8—9月的水质及微生物群落差异，基于60份样品的16S/18S rRNA基因扩增子测序。光伏塘水温、浊度、溶解氧及铵盐、亚硝酸盐、磷酸盐、总氮、总磷均较低，遮荫分别解释细菌和真核群落变异的8.0%和10.4%，α多样性基本不变。遮荫下硅藻相对丰度较高（46.2% vs. 26.7%），甲藻较低；无遮荫塘群落由硅藻转向纤毛虫优势（2.1%→45.4%），Vibrio由0.6%升至9.8%，而光伏塘硅藻稳定、Vibrio低于2.5%。遮荫群落离散度更低、生态位更宽，跨界网络细菌—真核关联较少但凝聚力相当；溶解氧降低提示 fishery–PV 系统需重视增氧管理。

papers.title: Effects of Fish-derived Liquid Fertilizer on Growth of Wolffia globosa during the Monsoon Season
papers.authors: Jaroenchai, Chutinan
papers.abstract: Introduction Wolffia globosa has been considered a functional food formulation due to its excellent nutritional value and rapid growth. Organic liquid fertilizer from fish (OLF) has been used as a source of nutrients for plant growth. However, there is limited information regarding the use of OLF for the cultivation of W. globosa . This research aimed to cultivate W. globosa using OLF during the monsoon season. Methods Two outdoor experiments were conducted during the monsoon of 2025. Experiment 1 comprised eight treatments of OLF, being 0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, and 3.5 mL/L. The plant was grown on rainwater in 11-L plastic containers covered with 50% black shade cloth and harvested at 11 days. Experiment 2 resembled the cultivation system in small-scale farms and comprised three treatments: 1.5, 2.5, and 3.5 mL/L, with OLF added during the experiment. OLF was made from fish waste collected from a local supermarket. The plant was grown on tap water in open 1.2-m diameter cement ponds. Biomass (g) was monitored every five days for 30 days. Daily rainfall was collected during the two experiments. Results Biomass gain was lower in Experiment 1 (1.8-2.4 times the starting mass) than in Experiment 2 (2.6-4.1 times the starting mass). Biomass was greater at higher rates of OLF in both experiments, although differences were not always statistically significant;biomass per unit area (g/m 2 ), average daily biomass gain (g/day), and daily productivity (g/m 2 /day) were greater at higher rates in Experiment 2. Biomass per unit area exceeded 2 kg/m 2 in treatment 3.5 mL/L after 30 days. In the three treatments, average daily biomass gain was the highest at 15 days (48.85-66.76 g/day), while daily productivity was the highest at five days (89.08-105.77 g/m 2 /day). Discussion OLF as high as 3.5 mL/L could fertilize W. globosa under the conditions of this study. Conclusion It is practical to cultivate W. globosa using OLF without changing media for a 30-day period. However, farmers may harvest the plant at 15 days, as average daily biomass gain reached a peak, and then restart the whole process of cultivation with the new media.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估鱼源有机液体肥料（OLF）在季风季节培养浮萍Wolffia globosa的效果，通过两个户外实验（容器实验设0–3.5 mL/L共8个浓度，水泥池实验设1.5、2.5、3.5 mL/L）监测生物量变化。结果表明，生物量随OLF浓度升高而增加，水泥池实验中3.5 mL/L处理30天后单位面积生物量超过2 kg/m²，平均日增重在第15天达峰（48.85–66.76 g/day），日生产力在第5天最高（89.08–105.77 g/m²/day）。作者认为3.5 mL/L OLF可在不换水条件下培养W. globosa达30天，但建议农户在第15天日增重达峰时收获并重新开始培养。
